planete.a:
The Sun is referred to as the star at the center of our solar system. It is a sphere, around which the Earth rotates in an elliptical orbit. Therefore, the distance between the Earth and the Sun is not always the same. The mass of the Sun amounts to about 339,000 times that of the Earth and is more than 700 times the size of our planets combined. Its diameter counts 863,730 miles (1,390,000 kms). For an earthly observer, the Sun, rising in the east and setting in the west, seems to follow a uniform course. However, this subjective observation is incorrect. In fact, the course of the Sun moves across the equator to a northern and a southern extremity, thereby creating the seasons in the non-tropical areas on Earth. After the northerly spring-time equinox, the Sun shifts north from the equator and appears higher in the sky.

On June 21st the Sun reaches the highest point of the year. Thus, north of the equator, we experience the longest day and the shortest night; the course which the Sun describes on this day is named the tropic of Cancer. From there, the path of the Sun is headed back towards the equator and past the autumn-equinox, where it moves for two quarters below our horizon. The days become shorter until December 22nd--the shortest day of the year. Then the Sun, after bordering the Tropic of Capricorn on December 22nd, heads north again.

Its influence on our planet differs according to the season. We see this in various natural manifestations, i.e., spring--blossoms; Summer--green of the plants and yellow of the corn; Autumn--the colorful leaves; Winter--bare branches.

Mythology depicts Helios as the sun-god. There are also accounts of Apollo as the god of storm, fire, and light--the divine son of the Sun and therewith the provider of life. Apollo is the bearer of the healing force, and he also brings illumination--with his rays he kills the dark creatures of the underworld. Dionysos represents the dark side of this light-god, the night side of our being.

The Sun is considered male, warm, and dry. It symbolizes the ego, the core of life, vitality (especially the heart), the concept of self-confidence as well as charismatic powers. Those whose Sun is harmoniously placed will be well received and do not need to make much with words. Their appearance speaks for them. Something else is emitted when a sunny person enters a room.

The Sun also represents our basic vitality and our potential for physical malfunction, inherited in every person. The relationship between father and son or daughter can be depicted by the relative placement of the Sun. The summit of life is symbolized by the Sun as well as the success which one aims to achieve. The Sun finds its related power in the zodiac sign of Leo, the lion.
planete.b:
It is technically incorrect to say the Moon orbits the Earth. The two bodies move around a common center of gravity called a barycenter. Because the Earth is a much larger body, the barycenter is not far below the surface of our planet. The average distance of the Moon to the planet Earth is 238,613 miles (384,000 kms). The equatorial diameter of the Moon is 2,160 miles and of the Earth is 7,926 miles.

The Moon moves in an undulating motion around the apparent course of the Sun. One can distinguish between the rising and the falling Moon nodes. In the first half of its motion--from new Moon to full Moon, it is called waxing; in the second half--from full Moon to new Moon, it's called waning.

Since early times, there has been a special foretelling when a dying crescent is seen shortly before sunrise, followed by the new moon crescent rising in the west just after sundown. This changing crescent heralded new beginnings and sometimes new phases, just as is expected from a Sun/Moon conjunction.

Close to the crescent, Venus is often found as a Morning- or Evening-Star. This image of Venus and the new formed crescent Moon had a tremendous impact on humanity--leading even to the story of the immaculate conception. In many catholic churches today, we can still find the Virgin Mary positioned on a crescent.

As the Moon shows itself in various ways, so too do its attached deities. There is for instance Artemis, the virginal goddess of the hunt; Hera, the goddess of maternity; and Demeter, goddess of agriculture who symbolizes the caring mother. Persephone can be compared to the waning Moon; and Hekate, the demonic Moon deity, represents the new Moon.

With regard to its psychological influence on a person, the position of the Moon is assessed not only in terms of its zodiac degree, but also according to the phase it was in at the time of birth. It may be an important factor if the Moon is waxing or waning, or if there is a full or a new Moon.

In a horoscope, the Moon represents cultural and ancestral aspects that shape your instinctive behavior. Because such feelings spring from the unconscious mind, they have a connection to past lives and early cultural conditioning (related to the Moon's matriarchal or nurturing influence, that in early years leaves a deep impression on your subconscious). The Moon is considered female and is strongly associated with fertility and intuitive feelings. Receptive and intuitive people often have a strong Moon placement.

The Moon also symbolizes the home, the family, and the mother. It also reflects the horoscope bearer's resonance-the way a person's feelings vibrate with themselves and others. There is an old saying that refers to a person with an excellent Moon as being well received. In physical terms, the Moon is often associated with body fluids, the stomach, and memory. In the zodiac, the Moon is attached to Cancer.
planete.c:
Mercury is positioned closest to the Sun, and after the moon, it is the fastest moving planet. It is rarely seen from Earth because the bright sunlight obscures it. Thus, Mercury is a Morning- and Evening-Star. Mercury rounds the Sun at an average distance of 36 million miles (58 million kms.). Its diameter is 3007 miles (4840 kms.), and it has an orbital duration of 87 days, 23 hours, 15 minutes and 46 seconds. Its bodily volume is less than one twentieth that of Earth's. With its closeness to our solar star, the maximum arc distance that Mercury can be seen from the Sun is about 28 degrees.

In mythology, Hermes/Mercury was closely related to the Sun-deity Helios/Apollo. His task was to bring the wishes of humanity before the gods and inform humanity of the will of the gods. This required a versatile, perceptive and yet sly mind, gifted of with the powers of observation. Hermes/Mercury is seen as the most human of all gods. Consequently, he is most likely to be lured into temptation.

Mercury symbolizes rational thought and intellect, the gift of mediation, common sense, the ability to verbalize, and the tracking of news. Mercury is the messenger; with his mental briskness and his rhetorical abilities he is able to react accordingly to any given circumstance. Mercury is the physical animator that has an association with the nervous system of the body and, relatedly, with the transportation and communications system within society.

Astrological Mercury, placed harmoniously, will always find the right word at the right time. However, if Mercury's position is challenged in one's horoscope, it symbolizes the inclination to criticism and haste. Nervousness and a tendency towards a compulsive pursuit of something might also be indicated.

Morning-Star Mercury in an astrological sense symbolizes a kind of leadership through the hours of daylight. It represents the day's actualities, traces chances of communication, and refers to good opportunities in a practical life. By and large, all mental activities are encouraged. Morning-Star Mercury is attached to the sign of Gemini (the Twins).

Evening-Star Mercury leads us through dark or hidden realms, taking precautions against the occurrence of shady events in life, thereby overcoming the fearful dark. Thus, it embodies a beneficial effect--the preparation, the harvesting of one's achievements, and the securing of such events. Mercury as an Evening-Star is attached to the sign of Virgo.
planete.d:
Venus is the next primary planet in our solar system. The maximum perceived angle from the Sun is no more than 48 degrees and like Mercury, it is only seen as a Morning- or Evening-Star. However, no other star is of such a shining and beautiful appearance. The light is often so brilliant and white that one can read a newspaper by night at certain places on the Earth.

Venus completes its orbit around the Sun in 224 days, 16 hours, 49 minutes and 8 seconds. Its orbit is the most circular of all planets. Its average distance to the Sun is 67 million miles (108,000,000 kms), and it has a of diameter 7629 miles (12,230 kms). Its size is closest to that of the Earth's.

In mythology, the twofold appearance of Venus as the Morning- and Evening-Star is emphasized over and over again. Phosphoros is the Morning-Star and Hesporos the Evening-Star. Aphrodite/Venus is considered an enticing creature, even to the extent that Aries/Mars submits to her. Being the daughter of Jupiter/Zeus she is born out of the ocean's foam, symbolizing heavenly love. She is the deity who reigns over the realm of instinctive, sensual pleasures.

Venus represents the feminine nature, the appreciation of love and harmony, as well as a sense for the arts. In the horoscope, she bears witness for the need of culture, tact, and manners. Venus is supposed to bring some form of luck, but one should be careful in this respect. One might be lured by her into a tempting abyss.

With a harmonious horoscope position, one might find that good fortune and a friendly manner insures some success. A desire to provide happiness can spawn generous feedback--after all, the appreciation of love and a sense of harmony are perhaps the most immediate forms of happiness human beings are able to experience. Venus can, of course, be amorous, and the sensual world of pleasure is often on the agenda.

It is important to distinguish Venus as being either the Morning-Star or the Evening-Star at one's birth. Morning-Star Venus is located clockwise ahead of the Sun in a chart and counterclockwise for the Evening-Star. In the morning, Venus represents female creativity, denoting further the beauty in everyday life (a comfortable home and relaxing nighttime leisure activities). It embodies the impressions of nature, sentiments regarding reality, and an accommodating form of love. The Morning-Star Venus finds its attachment in the zodiac sign of Taurus.

Evening-Star Venus symbolizes female devotion. Venus represents the ability of a person to be soaked up by some form of togetherness; it also represents female prudence and the female spirit, as well as a refined sense of the arts. It can even invoke a tempestuous desire for jewelry and style. Sometimes she symbolizes the dark, mysterious female--the sorceress of love. Evening-Star Venus is attached to the sign of Libra.
planete.e:
Mars can be called the neighboring planet, its erratic orbit enclosing our planet Earth. Much of the surface of Mars is reddish-ochre in hue, and it is a small planet whose diameter is no more than 4225 miles (6800 kms). The average solar distance amounts to 141 million miles (228 million kms). Its orbital time is 686 days, 22hrs, 10 min. and 31 sec.

In mythology, Aries/Mars is the god of all battles, as well as the god of spring. Thus his symbols are the spear and plough. Of these two, the former is strongly kept alive in human memory. A blind dare-devil, he risks any fight. In case of defeat, he is helpless and requires further divine help.

Aries/Mars is a fighter like no other, but the reason for the fight must be explained to him by others like Zeus/Jupiter or Aphrodite/Venus. These represent the two rational poles of Aries/Mars. He has to be redeemed from his pugnacity, but this can only be achieved by Aphrodite/Venus.

In astrology, Mars is the life-force that allows things to exist within the physical world. Within human beings, this energy can be quite individualistic. It is also the energy that enables people to fight for survival; hence, its association with aggression. In a chart, Mars is referred to as the action and desire principle. Mars can indicate the level of assertion and defense of an individual. It shows us how we can apply energy to accomplish tasks. Mars represents your desires and aspirations for emotional, physical, mental, and spiritual things which stimulate activity. Prompted by desire, we reach out to obtain the object or thing in question.

Mars is attached to the sign Aries (the Ram) and partially to the sign of Scorpio. In Scorpio, Mars reigns together with Pluto--which is considered to be a higher vibration of Mars and represents the energies and power of the masses. The fight between the masses (Pluto) and individuality (Mars) becomes apparent in Scorpio, where nearly everything deals with borderline experiences of humanity. Mars represents the karma we have concerning our overall life energy force, and it represents the health of the body--which is the temple of the Soul. Mars can also stand for the male factor or karma we have with ourselves concerning men.
planete.f:
Jupiter is the most massive planet in our solar system. Its diameter is eleven times that of Earth's, equaling 88,730 miles (143,200 kms). Its mass amounts to 318 times that of the Earth's, creating a major gravitational force. Its solar orbital journey takes 11 years, 314 days, 20 hours, 2 minutes and 7 seconds. Its average distance from the Sun is 483.6 million miles (718.3 million kms).

Although Jupiter spends an average of about one year in any zodiac sign, it often spends a disproportionate amount of time in some of them. Jupiter appears to have more moons than other planetary bodies, totaling at least 15. After Venus, Jupiter is the brightest planet in the sky. Observed from Earth, it emits a warm light, so that many hopes and wishes are often connected to it.

In mythology Zeus/Jupiter seeks reason and fairness in disputes. He is benevolent to all who help others and conform and penalizes those who do not. The mythical deity Zeus/Jupiter does have a dark side. Vanity is involved in many of his love-affairs, and he may show arrogance, arbitrary delight, and boundless ignorance. This deity generally insists on preference and privileges.

As the largest planet in the solar system, Jupiter is symbolically related to expansiveness, optimism, generosity, a love of freedom, and new experiences. The energies of this planet allow you to grow through impositions and challenges. It also provides a relationship with the universe in the form of religion and philosophy, and it provides a sense of legal justice--whether manmade or natural. Jupiter is considered to be the most benefic of all the planets and finds its attachment in the sign of Sagittarius.

A Jupiter that is challenged can promote arrogance, lawlessness, carelessness, and bigotry. The placement of Jupiter in a chart can give rise to over-indulgence-in the case of food, it is obesity. Some of this is reflected in a lack of confidence and/or humility. The key here is to achieve a balance given all of the energies involved.

A harmoniously placed Jupiter will assist a person to rise above the norm and be able to find success, not in speculation, but in managing the tasks at hand. The promotion of ideas and a flair for languages may also be present. Kindness and compassion usually prevail, along with a strong sense of justice.
planete.g:
Saturn is the second-largest planet in our solar system. Its diameter at the equator measures about 74,600 miles (120,700 kms), whereas the distance at the poles is only 66,800 miles (107,500 kms). Its volume is 755 times that of Earth. The average solar distance is 886.7 million miles (1427 million kms). The orbital time is 29.46 years. It moves slowly through the zodiac and has an average stay of 2-1/2 years in any sign. With the naked eye it is not very visible, and its light seems leaden. Saturn was given the Greek name Kronos, the planet of time's destiny. It is the prudent wanderer in the nightly sky and seems to be willing to concentrate its distant power on itself.

In mythology Kronos (or Cronus)/Saturn is the god who swallowed his children because he feared they would kill him. He had killed his own father (Uranus) in order to gain power. However, the children are not killed as they are later regurgitated, two of them being Pluto and Ceres. Fear is the driving force behind his actions, which can only be defeated and overcome when all is under control. During the time when Kronos ruled over the gods, men were first created, and this was called the Golden Age.

Saturn represents experience, tradition, examination of the new, the course of time, and everything that needs time, as well as patience. It is called the planet of fate. Saturn concentrates everything, even until the bitter end, no matter what is finally left. Here, the serious task and moving forward even under trouble and strife are symbolized.

The most common energy Saturn is known for is perhaps restriction. However, this often occurs due the natural law of cause and effect--which Saturn likes to manage. If it signifies obstacles and restriction, it is usually due to an individual having an incorrect personal goal or it is due to a karmic reaction which has been imposed. Saturn is the Lord of Karma (Karma can be positive or negative as a result of promoting or interfering with someone else's free will. It is also a debt to oneself, derived from actions that are aligned to cause and effect). Accordingly, Saturn's placement in your chart can indicate the areas in life that you need to work on.

A Saturn harmoniously positioned will consolidate events in a certain way. The Saturn energy that is commonly seen as "The Restrictor" may also show a long term positive effect. This is because it ultimately provides for control and maturation, and it prevents events from getting out of hand. Due to the length of time that Saturn spends in any one sign, an assessment of that sign is associated more with its respective generation. This may be one reason why certain age groups understand each other particularly well and share a similar way of life. Saturn is attached to the sign of Capricorn.
planete.h:
Uranus was the first planet to be discovered in modern times. Its detection broke the sanctified planetary "seven" of previous times, and critics used the occurrence to put astrology into question yet again. Uranus was discovered on March 13th, 1781. Its orbital cycle is 84.01 years. Uranus has the brightness of a class 6 star, and with the naked eye it is only visible under certain circumstances--namely while in opposition to the Sun. Its average diameter is 34,700 miles (55,800 kms). Its volume is approximately 85 times that of Earth's. Uranus stays an average of seven years in each of the twelve signs of the zodiac, thus making its orbit seven times longer than that of Jupiter's.

In mythology Uranus was god of the sky and the father of Saturn, whom he created with Gaea, the deity of Earth. A third of the children she gave birth to were ugly monsters. In hatred of these monsters Kronos/Saturn unmanned his father and freed the band of Uranides, enabling them to appear in the real world. Uranus seems to both originate out of and create out of nothing.

In part, Uranus is considered a higher vibration of Mercury. It represents electrifying energy, sudden changes, independence, and the freedom to experience the new. As such, it symbolizes the destruction of the old and the brushing aside of experience and tradition. Therefore, Uranus stands for originality, reforms, advanced technologies, and revolutionary processes. Uranus is strengthened in the first and eleventh houses of a horoscope and is attached to the sign of Aquarius.

The bohemian and sometimes surreal energies of this planet can induce a dramatic switch from one extreme to another. This can result in impatience, shock, unease, and insecurity. If Uranus is strong in your chart, you should be aware of constant stress that can act upon your nervous system. Earthquakes and the creation of new technology often occur with Uranus' influence, and many engineers and scientists have a strong placement of this planet. Even the most sexually active, or even inactive, people appear to influenced by Uranian energy. Thus, the effects of Uranus in individual charts can vary significantly, sometimes in distinctly different ways. Ultimately, we should recognize that the influence of Uranus can symbolize change in our lives, which can provide for new freedoms, as well as unique experiences and purpose.

For more information on Uranus, the following book offers some interesting views:

Uranus, Freedom from the Known, Llewellyn Publications, ISBN -87542-297-7, by Jeff Green.
planete.i:
The discovery of Neptune happened more-or-less by accident. Uranus, already discovered in 1781, was noted as moving in a rather erratic fashion, i.e., not following its predicted path. Something was presumably pulling it out of position. The mathematicians, Le Verrier and J.C. Adams worked out where this new planetary body must be. Le Verrier was only 2.5 degrees out. J Galle then discovered Neptune as a result of using Le Verrier's calculations. The deviating force came from Neptune, which was finally sighted by Galle. Neptune's orbit around the Sun has the appearance of a minor deviating circle, and she can be considered as a heightened Venus.

Its orbit lasts 164.8 years. The equatorial diameter is 30,200 miles (48,600 kms). Its volume is approximately 60 times that of Earth's. Through a telescope with an enlargement of 300 times, Neptune can be seen as a small disc.

When Zeus became king of the gods, he gave an empire to each of his brothers. All of the sea was made subject to Poseidon/Neptune. The ocean represents an unknown world of existence, yet the source of physical life. It is hard to classify Neptune not only in mythology, but in astrology as well. In the world of Poseidon/Neptune there are still many opportunities, but they can be difficult to grasp.

Neptune is sometimes considered to be a higher octave of Venus. This planet represents the psychic visionary gateway to higher realms. As it is very difficult to absorb and express this energy via the limitations of the surface conscious mind, it often appears as mystical, inspiring fantasy or diffusing reality. It is the unripened fantasy that gives Neptune its "Veil of Illusion" characteristic. For some, the inability to cope with physical reality forces a self-induced isolation. In the zodiac, Neptune is attached to the sign of Pisces.

Neptune stays approximately 14 years in one sign and should be considered from a generational standpoint. It will, of course, have a special characteristic if it is aspected by any of the primary planets--the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus or Mars. Neptune's energy is significantly enhanced if it is positioned close to the Ascendant, Midheaven (MC), or in the twelfth house.
planete.j:
The planet Pluto was identified by Clyde W. Tombaugh in Arizona on February 18, 1930 (the time seems to differ according to different sources). Its position had previously been predicted by Percival Lowell. Pluto is currently the furthermost known object. Its orbital journey around the Sun takes 247.69 years. Thus, twenty Earth years equate to one month on Pluto, or expressed the other way round, Pluto stays approximately 20 years in any one sign. Its axial rotation is about six and a half Earth days. Pluto's brightness equals that of a star of the 15th class. It is smaller than Earth and the smallest planet of our system.

In earlier astronomical literature, Pluto was given a diameter of 4038 miles (6500 kms), but following later measurements, Pluto was found to be much smaller--its diameter being approximately 1800 miles (3000 kms). Pluto is orbited by a Moon, which is named after the ferryman of the Greek myth, Charon, who carried the shades of the dead across the river Styx into Hades.

In 1999, International Astronomical Union considered re-classifying Pluto as a minor planet (or trans-Neptunian object number one), due to the very eccentric orbit of this icy satellite. This eccentric orbit actually takes Pluto inside the orbit of Neptune for a short period of its path.

When Zeus became king of the gods, he gave an empire to each of his brothers. All of the underworld was made subject to Plouton/Pluto. In mythology, the kingdom of his brother, Neptune, was the primeval stream, called Oceanus. This primal river is surrounded only by the banks of Hades/Pluto, the Underworld. Translated into psychological concepts, it is often mentioned that everything originates out of a primeval source--the individual slowly emerges from it as well (in a sense, still embedded in the collective). Thus, Hades/Pluto may also be seen as the symbol for power and its influence on the masses.

Pluto is considered to be a higher octave of Mars, and it finds its attachment next to Mars in the sign of Scorpio. It expresses a subconscious intent in the horoscope, yet Pluto is now more commonly known for its power of transformation. With its long cycle through each zodiac sign, its position in a chart by house and primary planetary aspect is far more important.

Pluto's aspect to the Moon and other bodies can indicate lessons gained from past lives and what lessons need to be learned in this life. Pluto depicts the higher order of our spiritual evolution and a purifying element between dimensions--a heavenly gate that throws back negative energy to its source and not necessarily immediately. In order to perceive Pluto's far reaching effect for each individual, it is recommended that the reader obtains Jeff Green's book Pluto, the Evolutionary Journey of the Soul.

planeteSigne.a|Bélier:
As the first sign, Aries represents the commencement of the zodiac cycle, initiating new beginnings. Your character is somewhat frank, forthright, energetic, and impulsive. This aggressive potential allows you to be straightforward in your approach to life. Arians sizzle with creativity and are always ready for action. They often have strong recuperative powers from any illness or accident.

Aries is a quite active cardinal fire sign and is ruled by Mars -- the planet of desire, action, and survival instincts. Combining such energies usually results in your being adventurous, self-sufficient, impetuous, action-oriented, and not always sensitive to the feelings of others. This may lead to an erratic and impatient behavior, since you want to initiate new projects but leave the completion up to someone else. Your hardheaded approach suggests you dislike taking advice from others; this may cause you some difficulties.

Try to take care that you do not overwhelm others with your high energy. If you can apply a little prudence and common sense, you can avoid rash behavior. To a large degree your strength lies in the fact that you never give up. Setbacks never discourage you, and you constantly look for new means of expression.

The cardinal quality of this sign confers an enterprising spirit, in which any current assignment is often supplanted by new ones. Swayed by personal desires, you generally have an overwhelming urge to prove yourself in life. As a result, you like to make fast decisions and dislike lengthy discussions, preferring action to inaction. You are very ambitious: wanting the best, being first, and taking charge in life without obligation to others. Any strong leadership qualities will advance you when you learn to adapt yourself to the needs of those around you. By being more caring, considerate, and sensitive toward others, you can achieve a great deal here. Try to obtain a balance between the task, the team, and the individual.
planeteSigne.a|Taureau:
The sign of Taurus implies a fixed earthly quality, reflected in a steady, persistent nature. Either great physical strength or the association with personal feelings of security is emphasized. A sense of reliability and good practical ability are usually expressed.

Ruled by Venus, there is often an appreciation of possessions that provide comfort in the material world, particularly with those that stimulate your sense of touch. You love the good things in life and often strive to acquire material objects. You have a taste for quality accouterments and are easily influenced by the appearance of others.

You generally like to take a long-term view and can be conservative and cautious following middle-age. Taureans are anchored to their convictions, being quite stubborn, and you despise being contradicted or crossed. Slow to anger, all hell can break loose when you crack. However, depending upon other aspects in the birth chart, most Taureans are warmhearted, trustworthy, and very loyal.

There is a tendency to worry about security, both emotionally and financially. In such cases, you will strive to create a sound arrangement in your work and family environment. Establishing emotional security works in a similar manner to that of material things. Accordingly, you prefer to avoid any form of commitment until you are certain that the relationship can be of practical use to you. Once relationships are formed, you stand steadfast by your friends in times of crises. In such cases, jealousy or too much emphasis on trust might be a trait to guard against, negating the desired security you seek to achieve.

For some Taureans, the appreciation of comfort and pleasure can lead to a certain amount of self-indulgence and even laziness. You may be not be aware of inner motivations and not too bothered with self-recognition. However, you possess an exceptionally strong will, sometimes too strong. If this sense of will is constructively channeled, it will enable you to plan effectively for years in advance. Thus, your possessive instincts steer you determinedly toward your goal, and your efforts usually meet with success.
planeteSigne.a|Gémeaux:
Geminians usually have quite an active left brain, depicting a logical, surface-conscious type of mind. You generally like variety, living in the present, meeting others, and being sociable. As Gemini is ruled by Mercury, communication in a practical or verbal form is a major expression of this sign. It also symbolizes communication through the five senses -- touch, smell, sight, sound, and taste. Accordingly, you rarely venture beyond the five senses because a significant focus for you is toward tangible sense and knowledge. Socially, you may be very popular, particularly as you are often a good entertainer and an articulate companion. However, you may not enjoy being tied down to one locality or human being.

Unless contrasted elsewhere, you are not generally very emotional, which may suggest that you lack sympathy and empathy. Part of this is rooted in your own sense of individuality. It is important that you distinguish yourself from your immediate environment. You avoid any kind of dependency and conventional constraints, often bending the rules to suit yourself. Gemini can display a dual nature in that one the one hand, you want to resist strong attachments that demand your attention in ways that limit your freedom, yet you also want to be involved with more than one activity or person at a time. This dual focus often enhances your nervous energy. You should realize that self-fulfillment cannot be achieved without some form of cooperation. This is also tied to a realization that an individual's fate is connected to the whole of humanity's.

The intellectual nature of this mutable air sign suggests greater public involvement through lecturing, addressing meetings, chat-shows, editorials, etc. In extreme cases, there can be an obsession to impress others with a gossipy opinion. With such a talent for discourse, Geminians are often involved in journalism and the media in general. One of the greatest skills portrayed by many Geminians is the ability to manipulate a conversation -- with or without knowledge of the subject at hand.

The practical side of this sign tends to be more service-oriented, involving the use of the hands in conjunction with processing information to keep up with a chosen skill. A classic example is that of a locksmith who enjoys the freedom to get about, obtain data on the latest variety of key structures, and be able to maintain a sense of independence.

Emotionally, there is a tendency to repeat certain patterns, which can make your relationships difficult without a deeper awareness and a desire for change. Any love of travel will be due to the change of scenery it offers. Although you are not particularly drawn by the idea of great wealth, money is attractive to you because it provides you with the feeling of being able to do what you want. You should try to control any nervous energy that may be present. Mind and body relaxation techniques would help, as well as eating slowly. This would assist you in keeping your composure in moments of great nervous tension.
planeteSigne.a|Cancer:
The water sign of Cancer (the Crab) implies a sensitive, intuitive, tenacious, and parental nature. It can also represent a moody, worrywart type of individual. Of all the signs, it exerts the greatest influence on culture, the home, and family. Ruled by the Moon, your emotions are very complex. You can give the impression of being a pillar of strength at one moment and that of being very vulnerable and overly emotional the next. Over-sensitivity usually results in a fear of being ridiculed. Accordingly, most Cancerians, hide such vulnerability by placing a hard shell around themselves -- just as the Crab has a physical shell. Very few people manage to lift this shell. To protect yourself from injury in this area, you may voluntarily go into isolation at times. This isolation may conflict with your need for a warm home life with certain people close to you. For you, a sense of wholeness or completeness in life can only come when you are able to live out your protective instinct for those around you.

Your highly developed drive to attain personal security will clearly influence your material and domestic structure so as to provide that security and stability. The fact that Cancer is a cardinal sign allows you to be quite enterprising in either commercial or domestic activities. For some, an inherent nurturing instinct also extends to ideas and projects that involve some form of development. Many nurses often have a healthy dose of Cancerian energy in their chart.

Your diplomatic talents are admirable, often enabling you to achieve what you want. However, when you think someone is treading on your toes, you may act quite illogically and be unable to cooperate with others. Security is very important to you, and you are prepared to go to any lengths to attain it. When the maintenance of this security requires a risk to be taken, you will do so -- but preferably with someone else's money! In such cases, however, your strong sense of responsibility will ensure that you proceed with the utmost caution.

Your heart is really in the right place, but the influence of a ruling Moon in this sign can make you seem affectionate and open at one moment and yet sentimental, reserved, and withdrawn the next. Depending on the house and sign in which the Moon resides, you can be extremely naive and stubborn.

Family tradition and history are quite important. You like the place you call home, probably having a good memory for the events that took place there long ago. If you are too sentimental and touchy, it is likely that you are also clannish. Try to be aware that any negative traits you exhibit are often the result of your essential needs not being accommodated. Try to nurture your own growth, so as to set the pace to expand outwards.
planeteSigne.a|Lion:
Your birth under the fixed sign of Leo suggests a magnanimous and proud nature. In the zodiac, Leo symbolizes the individual's struggle for personal development -- specifically in the house where Leo starts (the cusp). Leo is a fire sign, and it is ruled by the Sun -- the provider of life-sustaining energy. It is the Sun's duty to give warmth, light, and life. In our solar system the Sun is the hub for each of the orbiting bodies of planets.

You like to be at the center of everybody's attention, and while you radiate your energy outward, you love to receive admiration or affection. It is therefore easy to flatter you and for you to have favorites. You can be quite faithful and honorable, but at times vain and bossy. A position of power may heighten your self-confidence even further. You may come into a position of leadership, which might require much responsibility on your part. As a fixed and active fire sign, people born under this sign show a tendency to adopt the dominant role in partner relationships. Leonian women who defend their children can be as vicious as a lioness defending her cubs.

Home life and personal independence are always important issues for you. You need to be creative, both on a spiritual and a physical level. The sign of Leo is assigned to the heart. This means that you can give with both hands: your time, your money, and your knowledge -- without sparing a minute to think of yourself. Your guardian angel seems to appear just when the need arises. New opportunities open up for you in exactly those moments when you feel no solution is in sight. Just as the Sun brightens the darkest corner, you are pulled out into the light.

You are intensely drawn to the opposite sex. However, it is advisable for you to keep your fiery, love-thirsty temperament under control or you could get hurt. Quite subconsciously, you may tend toward an opinion in which the outcome justifies the means. Wealth is important to you as a means of getting closer to what you have in mind. Be careful not to appear too trusting, since you tend to believe that others are just as honest as yourself. If this is the case, try to develop your intuition.

You do not like repeating things. When you have grasped what a conversation is about, you may become very stubborn without due consideration to other people's needs. You may also have a highly developed sense of drama, so great that the disguised role you initially played gradually becomes a reality for you. Self-esteem is an essential ingredient in your life. On a higher level, you are probably prepared to do everything in the manner that you feel is correct, even if this means foregoing public applause. If you are drawn into a restrictive situation, you run the risk of denying or neglecting your job. You are courageous and prepared to take risks, but you never go about things in an unfair way. If success is on your side, you are omnipotent, but you may have difficulty in admitting any inferiority. If you have not yet learned how to be humble, it is very important for you to do so.
planeteSigne.a|Vierge:
For those born under the earth sign of Virgo, work may play the central role in your existence. Such work is often of a service or health-related nature. If this is not so and ill health befalls you, perhaps you should consider a task in life that suits your temperament and soul's desire. Since the planet Mercury is assigned to Virgo, you are essentially searching for knowledge that will allow your ideals to be put to practical use. You have a sense of pride in achievements and little or no patience with beauty that has no function.

You are diligent, analytical, meticulous, and industrious, although at times you may be finicky, worrisome, and a procrastinator. You like to create order from chaos and may analyze your surroundings down to the smallest detail. At times you may get so caught up in the details that you can't see the forest for the trees. With experience, you can learn to differentiate between essential facts and trivial details. Yet, you should avoid the tendency to mistake your efficient intellectual capacities for divine knowledge.

You should also be careful that you do not narrow your focus too much. You may find it impossible to talk of anything but your job and lose all interest in things unconnected with your working environment. As you become more experienced, you may learn that people do not have to exhaust their bodies with anxiety, worry, suffering, and too much work -- this can lead to health problems. Nonetheless, you have an excellent natural resistance to illness. Natural foods taken in the correct combination will greatly help you. On the other hand, if anxiety and concern over health runs high, you are likely to be something of a hypochondriac.

Virgo is an earth sign, and so you appreciate material progress. Like most earth signs, you have a fear of poverty and this may contribute to some of your worry. You love good food and value practical physical comforts. Nobody can surpass your perfectionism. Eloquence impresses you, particularly when well-chosen words are put together like gems on a necklace. Such words sound like a symphony to your ears, and you prefer this kind of attention to other less sophisticated signs of affection.

The skeptics and the critics of this world often have some Virgo energy about them. Your individual sense of pride and humor can be revealed in a satirical way. You may like to tease others and in extreme cases, take on an Athena type of personality, becoming impatient and condescending to those of a more sentimental nature. You like to use reason to understand the world and despise bias and bigotry.
planeteSigne.a|Balance:
If there is significant word that suits Libra, it is "harmony." Its ruler, Venus, emanates an appreciation for charm, grace, diplomacy and artistic matters. On the other hand, indecisiveness, dependency, fickleness, and apathy may be present. Many Librians have a charming appearance as well as a longing for fame and recognition. Sophisticated as you are, some will never abandon their basic principles merely to get support from others. You may have learned from experience that such manipulative behavior can eventually lead to humiliation. If any indecision is present, it is generally because you easily see both sides of a situation.

Libra is an air sign and as such highlights your intellect. You constantly seek knowledge, new ideas, and mental stimulation. You have the gift of being able to analyze all the social happenings in your surroundings. You also have a strong interest in all aspects of psychology and relationships with the opposite sex. Thus, you find it easy to advise others and try to help them solve their personal problems. You often play the role of an intermediary or go-between. You seldom give vent to your anger because you want peace and love in your life. You can portray calm judgment, even when crossed. After longer periods of time, you can remember exactly who said what and why, and you may be prepared to use this knowledge against the people involved.

A close partnership is important to you and serves to help you actualize your goals of self-realization and contentment. Somehow, though, you should be careful to keep your individuality even in such a relationship. You are strongly motivated by the needs of others, and so others rarely see you as selfish.

Libra is a cardinal sign and as such you are adventurous and live for today. However, since you don't enjoy isolation, you will generally seek the company and cooperation of others. You will have a lot of social connections and contact with the general public. Thus, you show a preference for employment in the judiciary, public relations, or in a career field that requires you to work closely with others. You might also be connected with the performing arts. Given your marked sense of justice, you expect your associates to work just as hard as you do yourself. The more experienced you become, the harder you tend to work.
planeteSigne.a|Scorpion:
It is said that there is no pain like Scorpion pain -- simply because of the intense energy that often accompanies this sign. In many respects, Scorpio is the most powerful and intense sign of the zodiac. This can be attributed to the fact that Scorpio is jointly governed by Mars and Pluto, while Uranus, the planet of spontaneous energies, is also raised in this sign. This is the only sign in the zodiac with three symbols: the Scorpion, the Serpent and the Phoenix. They symbolize the satanic, the wise, and the exalted -- reflecting emotions that reach from hell to heaven. Thus, Scorpio represents a broad span of transformative emotions generated by its ability to rise through the essence of these symbols.

Strong and intense sexual needs are depicted by this sign. You are probably not so much drawn to pleasure, but to a climatic ego-transformation that goes beyond words. Some may consider this to be a form of Kundalini release, while others a simple healing process. Being highly intuitive, it is hard to deceive you. Any bonding that lacks emotional intensity and drama will probably not survive, no matter how seductive the mate is. On the other hand, you might prefer to be in some form of relationship than be without one. When Cupid's dart finds its mark, the intense emotions you offer have no equal. In love, you can be very self-sacrificing and will fight fiercely when you or your loved ones are hurt. The Scorpio type who has yet to start to rise through the symbols often likes power games in sex, such as dominance and submission. The aforementioned may, of course, be modified significantly by other factors in your chart, such as Saturn in the eighth house.

As a discrete person, you will immediately drop anyone who betrays your secrets. You give and expect no mercy in a conflict situation, and anyone who wishes to injure you in some way should be aware of your passion for revenge. Scorpios are often strong and muscular or sleek and fast. You may exhibit a distinguished appearance and possess a mystical look in your eyes. Such an appearance can enable you to be very charismatic. Your sensitivity and intuition are strong enough to allow you to read the thoughts of others. You also have a deep understanding of death and do not fear it.

A lack of control over your intense passions may lead to possessiveness, jealousy, and even violence. For good or ill, no sign is as powerful as Scorpio. Because you focus all of your energies on a task, it is quite important that you set off on the right track -- especially since you take life so seriously. Your perfectionist desire towards tasks makes it hard for you to delegate responsibility, which can eventually lead to burnout. However, you do have incredible stamina and see most things through to a conclusion. You do not care about praise from others and would rather rely on your own assessment. You are strong willed and have a highly developed emotional drive and sense of purpose. Your life is often a constant battle to control your extraordinary drive by using your willpower creatively. Although you detest weakness in yourself or others, you are often quite sympathetic and willing to help those in need. In turn, you immediately expect them to stand on their own two feet without further assistance.

You love mysteries and have a probing truth-behind-the-truth ability. Thus, you are particularly talented when it comes to discovery, science, and research. You are a passionate defender of justice, even when faced with disaster. This is because Scorpio is a fixed sign. You may relate more to having a reactive mind during your early years, but with time a developed consciousness negates any harsh criticism of others due to poor judgment. Diplomacy is not a natural characteristic, but it can be developed. You generally prefer to receive a constructive and honest opinion, yet you would rather keep silent than temper your feelings and opinions. In conclusion, if life is still intense and painful, the more you focus on your positive traits, the less room there will be for the emotions that hold you back and create such pain. When you eventually realize the transformational path you are taking, there is invariably a special teacher who can help you further.
planeteSigne.a|Sagittaire:
Sagittarius is a mutable fire sign representing directness, freedom, and adventure. You are generally honest, open, yet argumentative and have a dislike for petty details. Its symbol is the arrow, which once fired will find its target. This often applies to seeking out new experiences such as new lifestyles or adventures. You are very ambitious and have an open and communicative mind. Your ability to think positively will be of great help in reaching your goals. Here you can rely on the ruler of Sagittarius, which is Jupiter, to provide assistance, if it becomes necessary. This is because Jupiter represents expansion.

You have an inherently responsible nature and concern yourself with the welfare of society, as well as your own. You tend to keep your finger on the pulse of public opinion, which gives you the ability to predict the future with sometimes prophetic accuracy. You enjoy traveling to exotic lands, whether in reality or just in your imagination. You appreciate it when your work and abilities are recognized by others, and your highly developed creativity enables you to broaden your horizons and develop your personality. You should look to the house where your Sun lies to determine the area of life in which to expand your experiences.

You may possess quite a philosophical nature. Given this, you are fully aware that the phenomena of civilization are the result of human thought and activity. You are prepared to venture where others would never dream of going. You want to understand, experience, and test everything in your search for stimulation and excitement.

Your freedom and independence is important to you. If Sagittarius finds himself in jail, he will be the first to plan and execute an escape! You are not particularly cautious and tend to make hasty decisions. Your straightforward approach means that all of your affairs are strictly above board. Your partner should be thick-skinned, since you tend to tell it how it is. You show no mercy in conflict situations, but gain few points from others because you also tend to lose your repose very easily. Excess anxiety may lead to depression and a loss of stamina. Your independent nature probably means that you have a disdain for housework. However, you can be a desirable, charming, and relaxed partner. For you, learning restraint will allow you to refocus your energies toward inspiration and wisdom.
planeteSigne.a|Capricorne:
The sea-goat sign of Capricorn primarily represents social foundations, authority, perfection, and respect. As a cardinal earth sign, common sense will be dear to you. Any practical skill will be developed through your own readings and conversations, rather than through formal tuition. You use your natural caution when experimenting with and realizing the things you have heard, seen, or experienced. There is usually no desire to study for the sake of studying. You feel a strong need to be busy and to accomplish great feats, to take on special responsibilities, and to acquire practical material possessions. The aforementioned needs will make themselves strongly felt whether you find yourself working in business, politics, or in a social or intellectual area. A special intuition will help you in your struggle for independence and the fulfillment of your economic needs. Financial independence is important due to a fear of being without the necessities. You will never be content with living a hand-to-mouth existence or with being in any kind of debt.

Saturn is the ruler of Capricorn, and thus you may have a tendency to seek social approval and will want to maintain a good reputation. You may feel restricted, sentimental, lonely and melancholy. You are a sensitive being and feel a strong need for recognition. You demand loyalty, but may not easily give it in return. Although imbued with a strongly reserved nature, you do not normally worry. However, when you do it comes from a tendency to allow the most irrelevant thought or activity to grow like a pessimistic cancer throughout your mind. It is important to plug any cracks in your psyche to prevent this growth of anxiety.

You are tenacious and down to earth, with a liking for structure and justice, and you believe firmly that an order is to be followed. An adept problem solver, you will always find a solution for even the most difficult dilemma. You are organized and methodical but may show a tendency to become a bit of a dragon at home. This is because you feel that your home must be well-organized and function perfectly.

You are ambitious and seek out positions of authority or leadership. If the Sun and Saturn are well aspected, your self-confidence is strong but with a realistic and cautious focus. The attainment of high goals can be a constant struggle if you do not learn to sidestep some of the obstacles you encounter, rather than meeting every one of them head on. You are prepared to work hard, and you realize that success will lead to the fulfillment of your material desires. Your plans and efforts to reach these goals are well-structured because there is a feeling that the universe owes you something. Material things are very important to you and because Capricorn is associated with longevity, you fear becoming dependent on others in old age. Others may mistake your longing for security as greed or feel you are a miser. If you were healthy as a child you may well live to a great age. There is often much responsibility demanded of you at a young age, but in later years there is a tendency to return to youthful pursuits.
planeteSigne.a|Verseau:
The symbol of Aquarius is the waterbearer -- water streams from the waterbearer's jug, depicting a higher conscious knowledge that is to be shared with humanity. There is a misperception by some people who consider Aquarius to be a water sign, but its true element is air. The higher ego focus is to help humanity -- in contrast to the opposite sign Leo whose ego focus is the individual. This sign's intention is to promote change in science, politics, and literature and to establish friendships between communities and countries (We-are-the-world).

Aquarius is ruled by Uranus, the planet of change and new experiences. Many new experiences are those of friendships, which are very important to you. The person you choose as a friend can be sure of your kinship and loyalty. As a fixed, active air sign, you can be eccentric, decisive, and strong-willed. Unless contradicted elsewhere in your chart, you are not very emotional and generally prefer to have friends rather than lovers. You have good friendships with members of both sexes and will maintain the relationships even if you have found a partner. Sometimes you feel that others lack the necessary understanding of your ideas and this frustrates you. As a result, you may start an argument to demand a response from others. You can be obsessive about finding the truth. Sometimes you even go so far as to banish people from your life merely because they do not reach your own perceptive level.

You are neither pretentious nor condescending, and you have a dislike for cheap imitations and hypercritical behavior. As you draw your security from being with others, you are fairly dependent on a specific type of surrounding. You will probably never experience loneliness; Uranus makes sure that you enjoy meeting new people and exchanging ideas. Your herd instincts will constantly lead you to other people, if they do not come to you of their own accord. You love the beauty of nature but want to admire it from a comfortable and safe position. You feel a desire for material wealth without being too forceful in that direction. You prefer to be a spectator at sporting events, rather than taking part yourself. Your interests tend to be intellectual rather than physical.

Your calm exterior may be deceptive. Sometimes your worries might make you feel ill and miserable. You take your work very seriously and are thus often nervous and worried. It is best for you to work with others or in an organization that works for a public cause. Such employment gives you the opportunity to use your excellent memory, intuition, and knowledge. It also enables you to express your humanitarian nature. Aquarius is often associated with a love of freedom, which may be expressed in some way by assisting those disadvantaged in society. People trust and admire you for your interest and concern when dealing with others' problems. Your sympathy is impersonal and your understanding rational, but once your interest has been seized, you prove to be an inexhaustible worker.

Although this sign is often connected with the intellect, the type of reasoning you exhibit will depend on the placements of Uranus and Mercury in your chart, together with how they are aspected. Your quest is to project warmth and integrate feelings into the world, i.e., engender shared feelings as part of a larger collective.
planeteSigne.a|Poissons:
Born under Pisces, your Sun sign is that of the two fishes -- where one fish symbolizes the personality and the other the soul. The linked cord may imply a fusion of the entities or a separation. This sign has a very strong Neptunian influence, which denotes a transcendence of the ego and a connection with the source of all life. This energy is not often expressed well in the physical world, the result of which is that you experience illusion, deception, and not a few lively fantasies. For some Pisces, though, a messianic quality is naturally applied.

As a mutable, passive water sign, you are the most sensitive, compassionate, sympathetic, and understanding of all the Sun signs. You have a strong need to feel loved. You may not be very ambitious simply because you dislike asserting yourself. This can lead to manipulation by others, something with which you will eventually have to come to terms. In the aim toward perfection you quickly become disillusioned. Courage is one aspect that will help, and a form of loving-assertion will go a long way -- an area you can easily develop. This process may be slow, but patience is something of a gift for you.

Jupiter is a co-ruler of Pisces and acts like a guardian angel. Jupiter can energize your life-force while helping you maintain your sense of purpose and being. Your charm, sense of humor, and sympathetic nature can open many doors. However, your easygoing and friendly personality may tempt you to let things take their own course, which will exasperate others who are more practically inclined. The paradox of this sign is demonstrated by the fact that you may also be industrious and exacting. You want to broaden your horizon and be at one with all living things. Your feelings are deep and tender, but sometimes you turn a blind eye to the shortcomings of people you like to have around you.

The arrogant, impatient egotists of the world often cause much grief to many Pisceans, since they never seem to understand the true gifts of this sign. Their influence upon you may generate insecurity. However, you will find relief in alleviating the suffering of others. Neptune imparts a great sensitivity for all human trauma. In extreme cases, Pisceans may seek out certain afflicted individuals, but never really want them to get better. This is to prop up their own security. In general, you have an instinctive feeling for the problems and painful consequences that words and deeds can have upon people. You are more than prepared to work as a volunteer, even in appalling working conditions, where you can relieve the burden of others (often at your own expense).

The indecisive side of your nature has much to do with an internal clash of feelings and your desire to avoid conflict, making it difficult for you to integrate your energies into any life direction. You may often feel tired, which offers you an excuse to avoid physical exertion or sporting activities. You would generally prefer to suffer an injustice than to stand up for your rights. But, once you do lose your temper, you may become so upset that nothing and no one can calm you. Therefore, you may leave the impression that you are stubborn or uncommunicative.

Your moods can swing between total optimism and the blackest pessimism. Perhaps there is a fatalistic streak in your character. Learn to realize that you are not helplessly tied to a fate over which you can exercise no influence. You must try to view the big picture to fully take advantage of available opportunities. Do not get confused if it is not clear how things interrelate. Trying to rein in your thoughts is more likely to make you unhappy. Seek advice without becoming too dependent on the source. Once you grasp a situation, you will find greater self-realization and even the most mundane things will seem bright and beautiful. Recognize that self-realization can only be achieved if your physical requirements are not a constant source of anxiety.

Much of the area of growth for you lies in the ability to effectively process the vibrations that emanate beyond this dimension. Meditation and psychic development could offer significant benefits. You may find that a latent instinct, such as an artistic ability, could come to the fore. A capability to understand your needs in a close relationship may develop. Once you have found your own identity, you are even more loving, giving, and prepared to make appropriate sacrifices for others. It should be noted that much of this description will be subdued if the Moon and Mars are strongly placed within your chart.
planeteSigne.b|Bélier:
This indicates an excitable and impetuous disposition. Feelings are enthusiastic, instinctive, and directly expressed. Self-sufficiency and decisiveness may lead you to jump to conclusions. The need for independence is quite strong and if the Moon is not well-aspected, relationships can be rather short-lived. This independence may extend to a periodic need for a new and fresh relationship, particularly for men. You generally insist on doing things your own way, often refusing to accept interference from others. As with all fire signs, little thought is generally given before making an emotional response, since emotions tend to be strongly felt and spring from your surface conscious mind. Relatedly, you can be rather sensitive towards the reactions of other people, taking them quite personally.

There is an unconventional nature to this expression that constantly probes the environment for new adventures. When you identify something you like, you become involved, but this involvement may sometimes be short-lived. You are very sure of yourself, depending more on your own perception and intuition rather than listening to what others have to say. Your decisiveness works well with major issues, but you tend to grieve over minor concerns; you often end up nit-picking if you are distracted by them. Such events may induce outbursts of temper, but these too are usually short-lived. Overall, you should try to become more aware of the end result(s) of your actions.
planeteSigne.b|Taureau:
This indicates a stable, possessive, and self-centered disposition. Feelings revolve around emotional stability in conjunction with financial and material security. The Moon is exalted in this sign, and your emotions have the opportunity for more balance in that you show a lot of common sense in dealing with economic and domestic concerns. There is an affection for earthly things and a quest for material comforts; you enjoy an unfettered, comfortable lifestyle with unchangeable habits. Your response to life is robust, and you often act in a practical and reliable manner. You have an ability to renovate, rather than innovate, and you usually finish one task before starting another.

Generally, you are quite conservative and conventional. There is a love for family and often a certain nostalgia connected with your early upbringing. If the Moon receives some challenging aspects from other areas of your chart, you should be aware of avaricious and stubborn feelings. You should also take care regarding any fixation with material luxury. Laziness or a fondness for good food could undermine your health and lead to obesity. Try to be aware of excessive possessiveness and take steps to control this. In any event, you need a secure home environment to attain inner peace.
planeteSigne.b|Gémeaux:
This indicates a sharp, lively, yet superficial disposition. Emotions can be somewhat restless because you need continual mental stimulation. This combination is not the sort that dwells on feelings or sentiment, but instead uses emotions to generate ideas and concepts. It is the resultant opportunities that excite you -- be it a game, product, or leisure pursuit. You like to keep your mind active, and it is a quick, inventive, and excitable mind. You may be a bookworm or enjoy crafts; possibly you have too many interests with such an active lifestyle. Such involvements can be superficial, lacking a fundamental base.

You like to communicate your ideas and thoughts to others, possibly exhausting some of your companions with constant gab. There is an inclination to tell others what they want to hear, rather than impart your own view. Accordingly, you could be tangled up in politics or sales if other aspects of your chart imply this. For the more restless type, you may move house often and spend a lot of time traveling. If the Moon is harmoniously aspected and other factors in your horoscope show practical talents, your inventiveness will enable you to overcome many practical problems both in career and in domestic situations. If the aspects of the Moon are of a more challenging nature, your feelings may cloud your judgment. A lack of concentration and/or a lack of heart may give the impression that you are somewhat superficial and inconsistent.
planeteSigne.b|Cancer:
This indicates an intuitive, emotional and sentimental disposition. Feelings can be sensitive, sympathetic and friendly. The Moon is assigned to Cancer, and Cancer reflects a vibrant, homey nature. You may feel a strong link to your mother, family, and home environment. There is an active nostalgia, especially towards your upbringing and environment. Intuition is also strong -- you somehow know things without being informed -- and it serves as a connection to your psychic ability. A vivid imagination is often present that influences your lifestyle. Your feelings run deep and can be rather intense, yet you protect them. An accentuated emotional sensitivity means that you are easily hurt, and because you have a retentive memory regarding emotional pain, you guard yourself by placing an emotional barrier or shell around you. Others may see as you as being shy.

You may be drawn into a profession where a lot of nurturing is needed -- such as a nursing, cooking, or childcare. A secure home situation as well as a stable partnership is crucial for you to feel content. You do not generally become involved in excessive physical activities, preferring sensual pleasures instead. If the Moon in Cancer is challenged from other parts of your chart, you may experience extreme mood swings and exhibit a tendency to overprotect your children, who are in turn suffocated by your love. Impressionability and laziness may also be evident. Most individuals with this Moon sign run the risk of being imposed upon and spending too much time worrying.
planeteSigne.b|Lion:
This indicates a generous, dignified, and loyal disposition. Feelings can be proud, dramatic, yet self-centered. This is reflected in your need to be at the center of attention: being admired, valued, and receiving a lot of love. Giving and receiving love can give you a lot of pleasure. Emotionally proud, you can be easily hurt by the indiscreet words or actions of another person. If you need to gain attention, you may dramatize your emotions in order to convey that you are an indispensable individual. Your receptiveness for flattery may depict a form of childish self-adulation. While you generally react to life in an honorable way, you can sometimes border on being pompous.

You are probably rather traditional, especially with regard to administering authority. To you, life is for enjoyment and pleasure -- not duty and obligations. You like parties, sport, entertainment, and romantic adventures. You prefer to live in a stylish home where you can relax after scheduled work. You like to be in charge, especially in the home. You want the best for your children and require much of their affection. If the ego is strong, stubborn behavior is usually evident. Your tendency to dramatize everything may become overwhelming unless you earnestly try to improve yourself. Your need to love and be loved will generally mean that you have a lot to give.
planeteSigne.b|Vierge:
This indicates a trustworthy, industrious, and sometimes fussy disposition. Feelings can be methodical, anxious, and reserved. Practical talents may abound, and you execute them through hard and exacting work. You show a marked curiosity in many areas and can devote your mind to methodical details. You prefer to work behind closed doors and like to be of service to others. You only inquire about personal matters when it is absolutely necessary. Unless the Moon is afflicted, you can be fastidious regarding personal hygiene and home cleanliness. You are very careful about what you eat and might also be very concerned about your health. You may be a good cook, whereby the nutritional content of the food is of as much importance to you as is its taste.

Virgoan Moon people often seem withdrawn; making new friends is not one of their easier tasks, probably because they are highly self-consciousness. As a worry-wart, your mind is too active during a crisis and therefore unable to get any peace or rest. If the Moon in this sign has a challenging aspect, you may tend to lend too much importance to trivial matters which could lead to intolerant and critical behavior. Trying to perfect every tiny detail may make you blind to other larger factors. Unless emotions are balanced, your nervous system may suffer in some way. Once committed to a relationship, you can dedicate yourself with unblinking service and will tend to see the relationship through quite rough seas if necessary.
planeteSigne.b|Balance:
This indicates an amiable and equitable disposition. You are perhaps artistically inclined and appreciative, but do not necessarily possess creative aspects. You are helpful and pleasant to others in order to be appreciated. You do not like vulgarity, and inharmonious relationships unsettle you, sometimes producing negative consequences for your physical well-being. Accordingly, you are very sensitive to the actions and reactions of others, particular to partners or close friends. Your appearance and gestures are usually elegant, and your home will be tastefully decorated and often serve as a meeting place for social events.

Your consideration and helpfulness towards others may have the disadvantage of your being easily manipulated, especially if the matter or action at hand has not been given due consideration. A well-aspected Moon enables you to deal adeptly with the general public. It also indicates a good relationship with your parents, particularly your mother. If the Moon in Libra is challenged, it is possible to sacrifice your independence for the sake of emotional security.
planeteSigne.b|Scorpion:
In many respects, Scorpio is the most powerful and intense sign of the zodiac. A lunar position here indicates an deep, secretive, and highly emotional disposition. Such a combination is quite enigmatic, since lunar feelings are not easily expressed in this intense, transformative sign. Hence, a Scorpio Moon is not generally regarded as harmonious and is referred to as a fall position. As a child, there were probably often a lot of experiences that were frightening to you and are emphasized in your highly strung nature.

Being prone to emotional excess, you may act in an aggressive and possessive manner. In extreme cases, the level of vindictiveness can be really cruel. You react instantly to personal insults and rarely forget them. This combination gives credence to the statement that there is no pain like Scorpio pain -- simply because of the intense feelings created.

On occasion, you feel you would like to transform your home environment and to control others in a subtle way. You can be very stubborn and feel that your requirements should have priority. However, once you have found a clear direction and the right motivation, no sacrifice is too big for you if it helps you to reach personal goals. Much of the growth you can achieve in life is through the forgiveness of yourself and others.
planeteSigne.b|Sagittaire:
This indicates an optimistic, cheerful, yet restless disposition. There is much idealism reflected here -- often you reach for the stars without your feet being planted firmly on the ground. There is something of the philosopher-clown about you which makes you well liked in mixed company. Your easygoing and unpossessive nature may not make you a good marriage candidate for those who have a strong desire to be wanted. Your longing for freedom and independence may take you off to many places, and if Uranus aspects the Moon, you could move to another country.

You will not tolerate being told what you should believe in, preferring to ascertain your own awareness of things. If the Moon in Sagittarius receives challenging aspects, there could be carelessness and extravagance. You should avoid adopting a self-centered, narrow minded, or inflated viewpoint. On the plus side, you may identify with specific social ideologies and show tolerance for other people's views.
planeteSigne.b|Capricorne:
This indicates an emotionally unresponsive, ambitious, yet cautious disposition. This is a challenging Moon position because the Moon in Capricorn is in detriment. With a cautious and reserved disposition, you may appear to others to be cold and aloof. You take life very seriously and tend to identify with material rather than spiritual values. You can work with conviction and ambition, but your struggle for success only relates to a good job and financial security. Your active quest for material riches, power, and status both for you and those close to you may mean that you act in a biased and selfish manner when adopting a highly responsible social position.

The feelings of the Moon are dulled in this sign, and the senses are redirected towards proving oneself with some ambitious struggle. You may have had to take on responsibilities quite early in life and lacked the love and sympathy of a nurturing parent. In relationships, there is often too much perfection surrounding partnership requirements. There are many single individuals with this Moon placement. If the Moon in Capricorn is challenged, you may tend to strive for a position of power at any cost, showing no consideration for the situations of others. In extreme cases you can be critical, petty and callous, resenting anyone who seems more popular and talented. There is a likelihood of becoming chronically depressed if your material desires are not fulfilled. If you find yourself with an absence of love, in that a true loving relationship seems to elude you, go quietly within (meditate) and seek the essence of love that is innate within all of us.
planeteSigne.b|Verseau:
This indicates an independent, humane, yet unconventional disposition. You behave in a friendly but impersonal manner, and as you don't generally understand the emotional needs of others, you probably have unusual friends and avoid those who might emotionally entrap you. You do not want to be burdened with passionate outbursts. Your domestic circumstances will probably be unconventional, where you demand the freedom to come and go as you please. Even if you are single, there is a tendency to seek friends rather than lovers. There may be a number of different group activities with which you like to be involved.

On a humanistic level, you may have the ability to intuitively recognize the needs of others, and sometimes such intuition flashes to the surface. The challenging aspect of this Moon position may be a tendency toward emotional rigidity or a dire need for freedom at any price. You may fear strong emotional ties because you feel that these might jeopardize your personal independence. Some Aquarian Moons are obstinate and like to shock others.
planeteSigne.b|Poissons:
This indicates a very sensitive, emotional, yet kind and sacrificing disposition. You often have a naturally developed empathetic sense which allows you to access the feelings of people around you. Such sensitivity can make you feel emotionally vulnerable, such that you subsequently isolate yourself as a form of protection. You are usually lovable and sympathetic; these qualities emanate from your receptiveness towards others. However, being easily offended, you should be careful not to develop any form of paranoia under certain circumstances. As an incurable romantic, you may have vivid dreams and fantasies. Some fantasies may be expressed through poetry, music, or other artistic mediums.

There is a strange ambivalence about you -- one moment you can be optimistic and happy, but within a short period, plunge into a deep depression with all manner of fears, phobias, and in extreme cases, paranoia. Many of the disappointments in life can be addressed by embracing some form of faith in yourself. Try to seek out a benevolent spiritual teacher who can assist you in times of crisis. Psychic gifts are usually present and should be developed. There is much about this placement that requires careful consideration of other horoscope components to determine the focus in life.
planeteSigne.c|Bélier:
This normally conveys a fast but sometimes superficial mind. Your decisive and adaptable thought processes enable you to develop a number of new ideas. However, many of these ideas can be rashly conceived and hence, not very practical. If you were to analyze various scenarios more patiently and thoroughly, such proposals that you offer might have added merit. This is even more important when dealing with engineering or logical concepts.

Due to a dislike of repetition, sustained concentration and interest may elude you. You are capable of informing others how a task should be performed, but often unable to carry it out yourself. You are more concerned with expressing personal ideas than listening to others. This is because your motive is to ensure that a decision is made quickly, without an exhaustively long decision making process. You should try to learn to listen to others, for if you remain intellectually selfish and stubborn, others will turn against you.
planeteSigne.c|Taureau:
This normally conveys a methodical and practical mind. Much of what you learn is from experience. You may be slow to knowledge or understanding, but once you gain it, it is not easily changed. You may not exhibit a brilliant or original intellect, but you have an abundance of common sense and human understanding. Therefore, you are adept in organizational matters but reluctant to express your point of view, not being fond of conflicts and arguments. You will enter a debate only when your security and financial interests are in jeopardy. Your ability to consider only those factors which have a practical influence on your actions provides you with great powers of concentration.
