You just ignore anything that has the potential to burden you. If you follow this behavior to extremes you may turn a blind eye to important factors.

Harmoniously aspected, this position of Mercury may indicate an artistic ability conveyed with intellectual understanding. On the other hand, you may be a gifted mathematician or physicist who is able to methodically unravel certain concepts. If Mercury has challenging aspects in this sign, be aware of your biased, materialistic, and miserly characteristics, since these may become dominant.
planeteSigne.c|Gémeaux:
This normally conveys a sharp, nimble, yet cunning mind. Mercury is in home territory here where, to you, everything can be rationalized. Unless contradicted elsewhere in your chart, feelings have very little to do with most problems, and logic is the answer to everything. This is because Mercury in Gemini is concerned more with facts than with personal views. Everything must have a simple explanation -- metaphysics may seem rather alien to you. Your mind is quite inventive; you have a clever knack of wriggling out of most difficulties!

You can exhibit brilliance at gathering a smattering of knowledge, but may be poor at synthesizing certain ideas into an overall philosophy. You pick up the tiniest of details, noting arrangements and looking for snags and cracks in the logical order. A finely tuned nervous system makes it difficult for you to ignore outside distractions. Excessive exposure to diverse and hectic impressions that are processed concurrently within your mind may wear away at your nerves, resulting in exhaustion, confusion, and possibly irritability. Thus, you need times of withdrawal and isolation to regain an inner peace.

If Mercury in Gemini is strongly challenged, you may be garrulous, fickle, and too unemotional, which may give others a reason to criticize you. Harmoniously aspected it may exert a strong influence, and you may well have the ability to develop logical thinking to its highest degree. If well educated, you are able to express yourself concisely and convincingly both orally and in written form. You are flexible, free of prejudice, and impersonal in your ability to recognize the truth.
planeteSigne.c|Cancer:
This normally conveys a passive, receptive, and emotional mind. You can also be the world's greatest story teller! Thought processes are primarily subject to your emotions in a somewhat sentimental fashion. Your memory is quite retentive, and you have an unusual ability for consuming details about the past. This may involve general history, collectibles, genealogy, etc., or on a more emotional level, patriotism. Such attention to detail may cause you to neglect other points of view, which can often lead to narrow-mindedness, intolerance, and irrational thought. If Mercury receives a particularly challenging aspect, you may even behave dishonestly, although you will not consciously perceive it. There may be a tendency to bore people with heavy sagas of your past.

Being extremely sensitive, your intuition can surprise others. You can communicate subtleties that are not apparent to many people, but the more rationally inclined will dismiss you as being illogical. You are very uncomfortable in the company of those who are not synchronized with you. You can communicate a lot of sympathy and compassion to those who need it, but dislike conflict situations, and you will quietly withdraw from the scene. Much of this is due to the fact that you may be exceptionally receptive to the vibrations and opinions prevalent in your surroundings. You are vulnerable and may perceive, rightly or wrongly, that everything that is said or done around you is directed at you personally. Your thoughts are usually of a domestic nature, particularly with someone who shares the scene. You show good business sense in everything related to food, household items, consumer goods, and property.
planeteSigne.c|Lion:
This normally conveys a charismatic, yet somewhat fixedly opinionated mind. Your strong-willed nature and ambitious intellect often provide great powers of concentration. This is because Mercury is inspired by Leo's ruler, the Sun, which brings strength and vitality to thoughts and speech. You like to flex your mind so that others consider you an expert in selected areas, and your fresh theatrical style assists greatly here. However, if you permit this talent to go too far it may lead to arrogance and a misuse of knowledge.

Your intellectual self-confidence is expressed by your healthily optimistic approach to problem solving. Nevertheless, you may have a tendency to treat matters in a general fashion, giving insufficient attention to detail, or you may ignore issues which are not of burning interest. Leo is a fixed sign -- meaning, you take your time forming an opinion and will not thereafter be easily swayed. Once objectives are formed, you keep a firm grip on these, which enables you to realize them. If Mercury is not well aspected here, a conceited, bombastic, and patronizing attitude may emerge.
planeteSigne.c|Vierge:
This normally conveys a probing, systematic, and yet skeptical mind. Yours is the mind that exercises detail to a point at which others may regard as over-exacting. Your intellect is very analytical and superimposed with a practical perspective. Quick to learn, you must, however, concentrate more than most in order to retain this knowledge. Your mind hardly stops working; you may focus on research, training, human physiology or psychology, and complicated tasks which require a high degree of accuracy. Others may see you as a person who is studious, undemonstrative, and possessing a dry wit.

You are very work oriented and may thus lead a slightly isolated life, preferring not to waste time with idle gossip. An interest in and a natural flair for grammar enable you to make good use of language structures, and you generally insist on correct grammar and semantics. Thus you may be suited to any profession which demands a talent in these areas. You might even be picking these paragraphs apart! If Mercury is not well-aspected, you may be rigid, over-critical, and sarcastic. Some may be fanatical about health and tidiness.
planeteSigne.c|Balance:
This normally conveys a contemplative, reasoning, yet somewhat wavering mind. There is often a focus here with intellectual concerns regarding the psychology of human relationships. If such interests predominate, you have a preference to be involved in such areas as astrology, psychology, sociology, and judicial matters. You have a strong sense of justice and are therefore honest and candid. If Mercury is not well-aspected, insincerity, tactlessness, and a tendency to be easily influenced may occur.

Any indecisiveness is normally the result of a desire to weigh all sides of a situation before reaching a decision. You strive for fairness and harmony -- both of which are reflected in your thought process. When a decision is made, it is generally evenhanded and thoughtful. A high level of mutual understanding and satisfactory relationships with others are important to you. You show a preference for cooperating with people on an intellectual level. Others generally find it easy for you to understand them because you are always interested in their ideas. Grace, fluency, and charm are characteristics you like to portray and see in others. You are not generally attracted to heavy physical work and would rather use your hands for more artistic purposes.
planeteSigne.c|Scorpion:
This normally conveys an intense, penetrating, and perceptive mind. As the vibrations of this sign range from hell to heaven, an individual interpretation of Mercury in Scorpio can be rather subjective. Basic qualities, however, indicate that intuitive thought plays a major role in your life. You love mysteries and are very perceptive; capable of a profound understanding, you often question human motivation. A positive expression here is that people can do anything they want in life providing the motive is a good one.

You are not one to hide your opinion because you are not prepared to bend the truth to protect the feelings of others. You want to express exactly what you think and feel, or you would rather keep quiet. If there is one sign in which Mercury resides where it is important not to tease the owner, it is primarily here, as you can respond very aggressively, particularly in youth. With such intense thought processes, you may be drawn to investigative work, sometimes of an intangible nature. As Scorpio contains inherent transformative processes, some use this energy to improve the mind and embrace a mystical awareness of which others probably never conceive. If Mercury is under stress, intense arguments, vitriolic criticism, despicable rumors, and scandals often abound. Sexual motives may influence thoughts, or events in life may be scattered with intrigue and conspiracy.
planeteSigne.c|Sagittaire:
This normally conveys an independent yet changeable mind. The fiery nature of this sign can create rapid thoughts, but they may not be sustained in any one area. Freedom of expression is one focus, which may manifest in resentment of overt authority. You express yourself candidly and generally present an accurate account of what you think. Your thoughts rarely differ significantly from traditional values or current moral views. In such cases, you may be an admired figure in the community where you reside.

You like to think of yourself as an example of honesty, but whether you really are or not depends on the position of Mercury in relation to other horoscope factors. On occasion you are so concerned with distant goals and high flying ideas, that you neglect matters at hand. If you conform excessively to social values, you may become a hypocrite because your set of moral values represents only the minimum level of morality which society finds acceptable. You must learn that an opinion is not necessarily correct just because it is widely accepted.

Mercury is not exactly at home in this sign and may express itself by a stronger interest in convictions rather than in facts. Although at times this approach may seem to work, problems can arise if insufficient attention is paid to practical details and logical thought structures. Much of this focus on beliefs is connected to a humanistic philosophy, especially with those who possess a strong social sense. Some may be more concerned with religion, law, and teaching in higher education.
planeteSigne.c|Capricorne:
This normally conveys an ambitious, quick, practical, and ordered mind. Capricorn is an earth sign, and Mercury in this sign indicates an interest in ideas of a more practical nature. This planet may align itself within this sign to produce a cool, calculating, disciplined, and rational mind. With an excellent memory, you discard superficial information and reject gossip in order to focus on real issues. However, if you are too reserved, your lack of humor and rigidity will likely make you unpopular in many social circles. You are probably quite conservative and supportive of the existing social structure. Many successful business people have this placement in their charts.

There are some who need to guard against depression because even though the mind is steady, their moods may swing rather excessively. If this applies to you, such a contrast may torment you with unjustifiable fears. If Mercury receives challenging aspects in this sign, you may become greedy in your search for wealth. Be careful not to be too obsessive by piling up material riches without due consideration for the interests of people around you. In a few cases, religious bigotry, excessive judgment, or a despotic character may manifest. You may also exhibit a stingy, selfish nature.
planeteSigne.c|Verseau:
This normally conveys an unemotional yet intuitive mind. You tend to see things objectively, having principles that are honest and unprejudiced. As a realist, you will venture into new experiences that broaden the mind. Truth and honesty are integral ingredients in your life and for some can become obsessive. You have little time for established ideas if they don't coincide with facts or with personal experiences. Herein lies the secret of your originality -- the ability to perceive things impersonally and objectively means that you are not easily deceived by circumstance. Thus you should be able to accept things that others would find nerve-racking or incomprehensible. You may exhibit a preference for working with other people, and therefore you could take part in group activities or organizations.

You may be inherently aware that reason forms the basis of consciousness throughout the universe and that your own consciousness is merely a minute fragment of this whole. As you tap into these resources, your sense of intuition stretches beyond the usual forms of perception -- enabling you to receive impulses from subconscious areas. As Saturn is also assigned to Aquarius, you are capable of intellectual synthesis as a talented natural scientist. Your ability to see a larger picture emphasizes your humanitarian thoughts and strengthens your interest in the spiritual development of humanity. On the other hand, if Mercury is not well-aspected, the mind can be erratic and confused.
planeteSigne.c|Poissons:
This normally conveys an impressionable, sympathetic, and intuitive mind. You possess a lively imagination and the ability to recall situations and experiences with absolute accuracy. Many occurrences or suggestions often influence your mind because you subconsciously adapt yourself to the moods and feelings of those who are close to you. You are intuitive rather than rational, sometimes missing the detail but grasping the overall point. You learn more easily from observing and absorbing than you do from a conventional education in which formal study is often a struggle. You have great sympathy for your friends and their problems, particularly when you have experienced similar situations.

Your intuitive and sensitive nature often indicates your talent as a medium. However, sometimes your feelings may cause you difficulties. Pisces is not a static sign, and mood swings can lead to similar swings in your intellect and in your relationships. You may also have a tendency to daydream and may sometimes be absentminded. You may become isolated and insecure because you like to be silent and keep your innermost feelings to yourself. If Mercury is well-aspected, the heightened levels of sensitivity and receptivity connected with this position will give you some artistic talent. If Mercury receives challenging aspects, there is a danger of your thoughts being so full of memories, that your perception of reality becomes warped.
planeteSigne.d|Bélier:
Affection tends to be strong, ardent, yet self-seeking. Values tend to revolve around an elusive search for romantic perfection. You appreciate and seek physical beauty in the opposite sex but tend to be more interested in the chase rather than commitment. There are a number of reasons for this. While you yearn for the security of love, your rebellious nature may react against restrictions imposed on your freedom. Your ardor quickly fades. You may not know what love is and believe that it is a mental thing -- separate from one's feelings and merely expressed through the mind. Unless contradicted elsewhere, if and when you do commit to a long-term relationship, you want to be the only one and will protect your involvement aggressively from any intruders.

Much of the above occurs because Aries is ruled by Mars, which tends to dominate Venus in this sign. Hence, there is a fiery and sometimes passionate nature in your relationships. Sadly, this has more to do with obsession rather than love. On a social level, you strive determinedly towards goals and openly compete for the favors of others to attain personal recognition. With your initiative and enterprising nature you bring a certain flair and color to social events. There is generally an interest in sports, meeting new people, and using machines. If Venus is under stress, you could be something of a heartless, promiscuous, pleasure seeking individual, who considers that you can buy love. If this is so, growing old will be a frustrating and lonely experience.
planeteSigne.d|Taureau:
Affection tends to be amorous and tactile, yet rather possessive. Values tend to revolve around security. Venus is at home in Taurus since it is the ruler of this sign. The characteristics Venus symbolizes -- appreciation, values, and affection -- are expressed more readily here. Because security is important, many will wait longer than most for the right partner to enter their lives. Accordingly, you are capable of stable and lasting relationships. Security here is defined not only as material; equally important is a spiritual and emotional faithfulness. You are loyal and honest but may become possessive and jealous when your feelings are at stake. With a highly developed appreciation of physical things, you enjoy intimate physical contact with the one that you love. You are very sensual in a passive way, perceiving sex and nakedness to be very natural.

You enjoy comfort and luxury and prefer to live in an attractive environment, personally striving to decorate your home artistically. Your love of good food is either balanced or excessive. You have a natural sense for beautifying things, including your own appearance. You also have an inherent sense of value for material things and accordingly the talent to acquire objects of artistic and lasting quality. Consequently, money is very important to you. You have an affinity with the soil, the world of flowers and trees, and enjoy gardening and cultivating flowers in your leisure time. You may be drawn to those types of artistic expression where you directly form the materials with your hands. Venus in Taurus is often shown in the charts of artists and sculptors.
planeteSigne.d|Gémeaux:
Affection tends to be charming, courteous, yet changeable. Values tend to revolve around variety. The earthy and physically refining, yet attracting quality of Venus is restrained in the airy and rational environment of Gemini. Love is understood, but not felt. Passion can be elusive and rarely sustained. Your thirst for new experiences and inquisitive nature towards those of the opposite sex tend to make others feel that perhaps you are a flirt. However, do not feel concerned; you are certainly capable of sustaining a long-term relationship and remaining loyal to one person.

You are witty and eloquent and drawn to others who possess a sharp intellect and open mind. It is important for you to have sufficient personal space, where you can pursue certain pleasures and social activities. Your artistic flair is most evident in literary matters. You like poetry, satire, puns, and intellectual word games. You are very obliging and generally get on well with your neighbors and siblings. If Venus is challenged here, you may be a long-winded freeloader, immature, quite fickle, and an obsessive flirt. In very extreme cases, bigamy may occur.
planeteSigne.d|Cancer:
Affection tends to be sympathetic, gentle, and somewhat protective. Values tend to revolve around the home and family. The refining and attracting qualities of Venus are merged toward maternal affection within this sign of growth. Seductive and sensuous energies also emerge to initiate the right kind of partnership that you seek. Heightened feelings of sensitivity and vulnerability generally mean you need to protect your feelings -- often behind a mask or shell. Such sensitivity may affect your moods, which can be unstable at times. You therefore set great store by security, whether in financial or domestic matters, and take great care of your home and the people who live there. You depend on affection, in all its forms, to feel content.

A person with this combination is more likely to become involved in a secret love affair. Your sympathetic, receptive, and nurturing qualities make you extremely attractive to those who are unhappily married. Once involved, tenacity is strong, and therefore you can be too possessive of other people. If you are unable to bestow your affections on another, you may direct your energies toward some humanitarian cause. There is a tendency to have a profound appreciation for spiritual and metaphysical matters. In fact, you are quite psychic but prefer not to publicize this. If Venus is under stress, shyness and self-consciousness are likely. An excessive neediness may be shown in which you are unable to say "no."
planeteSigne.d|Lion:
Affection tends to be genuine, warm, and heartfelt. Values tend to revolve around loyalty. Since you love being admired and exhibit a strong sense of drama, you easily draw the attention of the opposite sex. Your affections, in combination with your sense of values, enable you to form stable and lasting relationships. You love romance and find the odd passionate love affair very exciting. However, you remain completely faithful once you have chosen your partner in life. This may make you rather possessive and jealous if your partner does not provide all the attention that you need so badly.

Your sense of pride often reveals itself in the way you display your appreciation of others, especially members of the family. Wherever you go you like to be at the center of attention. You enjoy the party scene, but should be careful not to overindulge. Because you have the ability to express your feelings dramatically, you may display a natural talent for acting and a deep understanding of art. This may extend to a lively sense of color, as well as a talent for painting, sculpturing, and other artistic pursuits. If Venus receives challenging aspects, you may mistake lust for love or become involved with those who are incapable of reciprocating affections. Some may behave like a primadonna, wanting to be admired and adored by others. Your appearance, however, may leave much to be desired.
planeteSigne.d|Vierge:
Affection tends to be cool and modest and sometimes critical. Values tend to revolve around duty. The energies of Venus in this sign are usually expressed in a somewhat practical manner that is not generally erotic or sentimental, unless contradicted elsewhere in your chart. You like your partner to be someone who can interact on a variety of levels and share your interests. Your expectations of a partnership are extremely high and once committed, you dedicate yourself in a form of mindful service. Your cool reserve, however, may make it difficult for you to fall in love. If the aspects of Venus are not too challenging, you will generally make good friends and associates. You admire and practice good manners, personal hygiene, proper nutrition, and you generally abhor anything to the contrary. Your excellent social skills often serve as a means of hiding your extreme shyness.

Your sympathetic and caring nature for those who are ill could be of assistance in some medical capacity. You also have an understanding for psychological problems if the appropriate energies of Mercury and Venus can be expressed. You may have a tendency to be excessively critical of your own feelings and of those around you. Such people may then become apprehensive and detached from you. This analytical conduct can also make it challenging for you to react intuitively and spontaneously to certain events. For example, you try to appreciate the beauty of a flower by plucking the petals, one by one, yet still find it hard to grasp that the beauty of the flower is rooted in its integral form. You appreciate the practical value of material items, but you are not adverse to acquiring a valuable object that can enhance your status. Such objects may, subconsciously, be love surrogates. If Venus receives some challenging aspects, an obsession for love may lead to sexual excess, and fastidiousness may lead to mental cruelty. In most cases, however, Venus in Virgo needs to learn how to be loving.
planeteSigne.d|Balance:
Affection tends to be hospitable and congenial. Values tend to revolve around harmony and balance. Venus is at home in Libra, so the energies of beauty and harmony are strongly expressed. Partnership and harmonious friendships are of prime importance to you. With this constellation you could be very attractive to the opposite sex and will likely gain a very desirable partner. As a woman, there is often a sensuous aura about you, but you require a substantial amount of intimate affection. In fact, you may have too high an expectation of your partner to be the perfect mate. You appreciate a large social circle of friends and quickly perceive those with whom you can form harmonious relationships. You are very considerate and like to do things that bring happiness to others, leaving them little choice but to like you. There is a well-developed sense of justice and fair play concerning all matters of the heart and platonic friendships. You dislike boisterous behavior and vulgarity and may well follow a strict code of conduct in society.

You are a social creature of habit, preferring social contacts rather than material possessions. You usually obtain both due to your interpersonal skills and business acumen, which assist you in acquiring prosperity. You hate arguments and conflict and will often withdraw to a safe environment. Discordant situations easily render psychological stress, resulting in nervousness and even illness. You should try to find a way to deal with this effectively. Your perception of beauty and powers of aesthetic expression may be highly developed. You may possess some artistic talent, particularly with music. Since you have a talent for public appearances and enjoy being the center of attention, it is of prime importance to you that others are well versed in matters of communal etiquette. With Venus under stress, significant conflict avoidance, laziness, flightiness, over-spending, and a propensity to constantly seek the right mate -- without ever being satisfied -- may be prominent.
planeteSigne.d|Scorpion:
Affection tends to be intense, passionate, and possibly possessive. Values tend to revolve around pleasure and sensation. This is a detrimental position for Venus, where appreciation for affection and beauty shifts to lust and possessiveness. However, in the sign of transformation, there is a significant opportunity to grow through forgiveness and greater awareness of feelings. Much will depend on the aspect Venus makes to other planets. Emotions can be heightened in intimate relationships, where you may tend to react without suitable consideration for your partner's position (maybe losing all sense of tact and discretion). On a higher level, you have elevated ideals and values concerning love and friendship; you are prepared to make great sacrifices for your loved one(s).

Mars is a co-ruler of Scorpio, and it depicts desire. Combining this with the appreciation of Venus can result in intense passion. This is often focused towards sex, and for some manifests in a need to boast about their sexual adventures. Erotic encounters are so intense and personal, that at the time, you are in danger of losing your sense of humor and general perception. The emotional intensity afforded here can project a multi-faceted personality. Appreciation of art and other events may be extremely colored. Love and hate are two expressions of the same energy, and you can easily experience its extremes. Jealously is also a predominant expression here, which can be dissolved more readily by you through forgiveness and unconditional love. If Saturn is aspected or in the eighth house, sexual expression will be tempered. If Uranus is strong or in the seventh house, jealousy may eventually be more tempered towards an open relationship. There is much that can color this particular position. With Venus under extreme stress, domination, cruel acts, and sado-masochism may occur.
planeteSigne.d|Sagittaire:
Affection tends to be demonstrative, but initially cautious. Values tend to revolve around freedom. The kind of beauty and relationship you like should not be complicated, too sophisticated, or artificial. Relationships need to have some balance. You like to be frank and open with your partner and close friends. However, you are quite aware of the need to maintain high principles in a relationship. There is a strong dislike of any emotional possessiveness, which you will probably not put up with. You tend to like the traditional form of courting. New and fresh encounters are preferred, but some manage to find permanence, typically if there is some degree of freedom established. You will try to influence your partner to adopt some of your values in order to share a common foundation. You love to form new relationships while traveling and are particularly drawn to people of a foreign culture. There is no prejudice towards those of different racial backgrounds.

The domestic life may not entirely suit you, since you prefer instead to dedicate yourself to some cause rather than a person. You follow life's path according to perceived ideals and spiritual principles. Unless contradicted elsewhere, many perceive you as a friendly, lively, obliging type of person. As the planet Jupiter is assigned to Sagittarius, you may have extravagant tastes. These might include certain art forms which have a religious, mystical, or philosophic flavor. Certain melodious tones move you in a special way. You enjoy talking to philosophers and academics. You may be an enthusiastic rider, skier, or be involved in some special adventurous activity. There is often a pull to visit exotic countries and experience the unusual. Tours are not for you, for you are an independent adventurer and want to make your own plans. If Venus is challenged here, you may be rather selfish, capable of deceptive affairs, and somewhat apathetic.
planeteSigne.d|Capricorne:
Affection tends to be somewhat restricted and delegated to a lower priority. Values tend to revolve around loyalty and financial security. The ruler of Capricorn, Saturn, tends to squeeze much of the affection and appreciation out of Venus. It seems to be too easy for this type of person to fall into a gloomy and dull existence. You are very cautious about commitment in a relationship and will more likely yield to financial or career improvement choices. At times, you seem to run the gauntlet of maintaining your cash balance. You may therefore seek a favorable association to provide you with material and emotional security. You like to see and be seen in the right places and dine in fine restaurants. In public you always appear confident and controlled, considering it beneath your dignity to show your feelings to the world at large. Your deliberately cool exterior may stem from a need to feel superior to others, and many will be offended by this apparent snobbism.

You keep a tight grip on your feelings and emotions, but deep within you are very sensitive. Your controlled and cultivated manners may or may not win you much regard. You are also surrounded by a mystic aura of loneliness which may attract others to you. It is as if deep inside your soul yearns to express the embodiment of unconditional love, but your physical consciousness, i.e. that which is attached to your body in the here-and-now, seems to inhibit this. There may be a preference for a partner who is older or younger than yourself. Although you do not like to show it, your inherent feel for fairness and responsibility will make you a loyal partner. On the artistic front you have an exceedingly good feel for form and function. If you combine your artistic sense with your business instinct, you may well become involved with some environmental concern, the preservation of ancient artifacts, or an art gallery. If Venus is challenged, you should be wary of becoming too frosty, blunt, and letting your material interests govern your life.
planeteSigne.d|Verseau:
Affection tends to be somewhat unemotional and detached. Values tend to revolve around friendships and liberty. As Aquarius is an air sign, you delight in meeting people and talking with them. As a result, you have often a wide circle of friends. Even though you enjoy a deep, personal attachment, you are excited by the novelty and perpetuation of romance. The formation of this ideal may not materialize until you are able to love all of humanity as a whole. You may be drawn to Bohemian types, especially those who are intellectually inclined. The universe may subject you to some rather unusual experiences regarding intimate relationships. Many people with Venus in this sign tend to marry in their thirties or forties, or marry again at this time after being restricted in an earlier marriage or relationship.

You are quite tolerant of others' beliefs, even if they conflict with the ones you hold. However, you do not like bad manners, even if you drop the occasional cod yourself. You loathe nothing more than boredom and stereotyped routines. You dislike jealousy and envy, avoiding those who would want to restrict you socially. Those who wish to get close to you must give you adequate personal space. If Venus in Aquarius shows challenging aspects, you may have a tendency towards eccentric promiscuity. A sense of anarchy and a dislike for authority may often stem from your need for unimpeded freedom and a hunger for new experiences. In such cases, relationships may be a hindrance and short-lived.
planeteSigne.d|Poissons:
Affection tends to be sentimental, amorous, and compassionate. Values tend to revolve around trust and your mate. Venus is elevated in Pisces, where the idealism of romance and affection is most developed. Self-sacrifice, sympathy, and trust towards your partner and those in need are an intrinsic part of your nature. However, you will always place the needs of your family first. You feel deeply connected with everything that is alive and have a special talent for understanding other people's feelings. This form of empathy can connect you deeply to other people. Perhaps the cumulative experience of other lives has gifted your soul with the ability to deal with all forms of human existence.

However, be careful that your placid, compassionate, and understanding nature is not exploited. Even though you may suffer at the hands of scoundrels and lechers, you are amazingly forgiving. On the other hand, if you are jilted in love, you can be deeply heartbroken and disillusioned. Your intuition and inspiration is the source for your creative skills in the fields of art, poetry, and music. Venus in Pisces is often found in the charts of many poets, painters, composers, and sculptors. If you are drawn to these areas, you should continue to be active. If Venus receives challenging aspects you may be devious, secretive, lazy, oversensitive, melancholy, and have too much dependence on family and friends. Emotional dependency may place you in manipulative situations. Devoid of purpose and ambition, you meander along in a dream world.
planeteSigne.e|Bélier:
Your life force tends to burst forth with exuberant energy for which you need to find an appropriate outlet. Without it, you can become quickly frustrated and could lose your temper. However, any anger is short-lived, and you soon forget quarrels. Even though Mars can be greatly strengthened in this sign, much of this dynamic energy will be significantly influenced by its aspects to other planets. You may have a strong desire to assert yourself through some show of force. This is often revealed in a competitive way as in sports and games where you can compare your strengths with your rivals. There can also be a preference for using or working with machines, such as fast cars or other vehicles. (Are you the one who wants to be away first when the traffic lights change?)

This Martian energy often reveals courage for initiatory action, even to the point of impulsiveness. A wish to master this characteristic awakens your entrepreneurial spirit and enables you to express creative and ingenious schemes. You have a talent to emerge as the leader in social groups, providing you seize the initiative and can stimulate others into cooperating. You love to act first in virtually everything. However, you may lack endurance; you cannot always maintain your interest long enough to finish a project. Perhaps in youth, there was an insufficient learning experience in seeing tasks through to completion. Sexual expression and desire usually run high, and you may learn much from the Tantra!

You have a mind of your own and a desire to be independent -- preferring to be open, frank, and direct. You don't allow for contradiction or interference. An impulsive nature suggests you should start to think before you act in order to achieve success. If your impatience leads to recklessness, dangerous situations may arise. You may need to protect yourself from being too self-centered, insensitive, aggressive, and uncontrolled. By learning to be more considerate and patient you will be able to work well with many of the conditions presented to you.
planeteSigne.e|Taureau:
Mars finds itself in something of a predicament here, for the physical yet steadfast energy of Taurus appears to subdue the fiery, driving desire of this planet. Your life force tends to be somewhat diverse, being compliant, obstinate, reclusive, charitable or acquisitive, from one moment to the next. The driving power of Mars can therefore be limited by material obstacles. The earthy expression of Taurus as aligned with physical matter cannot react as quickly as Mars would sometimes like. This is why desires are slowly aroused in this combination and not easily extinguished.

You tend to place a great deal of importance on financial matters, expending a lot of energy towards the acquisition of money and material wealth. Much of this has to do with material security. You possess a practical and dogged determination that won't admit defeat and usually produces some success. Methodical and slow, you possess an incredible endurance and obstinacy once you have decided on a way of dealing with the tasks at hand. Anger is slowly aroused, but once your breaking-point is reached, all hell breaks loose! On the other hand, you can be very good at calming someone else who is having a tantrum.

There is often a high degree of manual dexterity, where you handle your tools with care and precision. You produce objects that are both beautiful and of lasting quality, preferring to work with firm durable materials like metal and stone. A well-aspected Mars infers a capable and passionate lover who easily satisfies the opposite sex. If Mars is challengingly positioned, you may be exceedingly active (or inactive) in sensual affairs and attach too much importance to money. In any event, relationships may be rather stormy as you tend to channel a lot of energy in this direction, but you can also be inconsistent.
planeteSigne.e|Gémeaux:
With the planet Mars in Gemini you are intellectually active and aggressive. You possess keen critical thinking skills and are clever with technical and mechanical things. Resourcefulness and imagination are among your strengths, though you lack endurance unless this is evened out by other factors in your horoscope. You might also show a preference for debates and intellectual discussion. If Mars is displayed tensely, you enjoy contradiction; nonetheless, you are not easily irritated. Your art of speaking may tend towards sarcasm and directness.

Reporters, critics, and journalists often have Mars in Gemini. Because of your inherently active nature, this Mars position may lead to constant changes in your career activity. You may also work on many projects at once.
planeteSigne.e|Cancer:
In the sign of Cancer, Mars experiences its fall. Your Martian energies here make it difficult for you to adequately manifest your desires because the planet Mars and the sign of Cancer draw from completely different energy forms. You do not like to assert yourself and would rather offer warm sympathy to people to whom you feel connected. If anger is ever expressed, you immediately request forgiveness.

As a male, you will be amazed by your paternal character traits. Your sense of family and culture is appreciated and valued by many women. Do not try to compensate for any nonexistent macho behavior, for you will only be received with contempt and disdain. It is simply not your expression in this life.

As a female with this positioning of Mars, you prefer men who radiate warmth, romance, and sensitivity. You would rather see a man cry than sweat from working out with weights. Ungainly male expression turns you off. You need someone whom you can curl up with in front of the fireplace and talk about having children.
planeteSigne.e|Lion:
With the planet Mars under the sign of Leo, you possess energy, willpower, and creative talent. Because these abilities are mostly shown in dramatic forms, many actors have Mars in the sign of Leo. Just as with Aries, Mars shows the positive entrepreneurial spirit, although here determination and endurance are stronger, since Leo is also a fixed sign ("It's my way or the highway."). With Mars in Leo, you have natural leadership abilities, and your self-confident appearance helps others to trust you. You always want to be in the front row, and you usually are. In affairs which really mean something to you, you try and outdo everyone else. Your beliefs and views are presented forcefully -- this often brings forth opposition from those who believe otherwise.

You could feel yourself pulled towards members of the opposite sex if they recognize and appreciate your vital physical energy. You have a desire to enhance your prestige and thrive on the acquisition of wealth. You enjoy finding pleasure in glowing relationships although you need to be aware of excessive jealousy and possessiveness.

Men with the planet Mars in Leo radiate vitality and manliness; they may also be very proud. Be careful of the complications which can arise from this false pride. If Mars is positioned challengingly, you should also be careful of self-centered tendencies and pretentious behavior which can lead to a desire to dominate others. Do not think that you are infallible.
planeteSigne.e|Vierge:
With Mars in Virgo you possess an efficient capability in those areas of work which require attention to detail. Experienced craftsmen, such as precision engineers, often have Mars in an earth sign, especially in Virgo. Mars can apply itself here in decisive and dexterous ways if you enjoy working with precision tools. Health is also attributed to Virgo, and you could be talented in some area of medicine. Surgeons often have Mars in this position of their horoscopes.

You like to proceed carefully and systematically in your undertakings. You insist on a well-organized work atmosphere. You will attempt little without solidly planning it first. You would prefer to come across as an exacting person. Sometimes your perfectionist attitudes make it difficult for you to produce finished products. Protect yourself from exaggerated, overly-involved and overly-critical actions, particularly when it comes to matters of method and accuracy. A bit more tolerance would be good for you.

If Mars is challengingly positioned in Virgo, it may lead to differences of opinion in the work place which could even reach the point of endangering cooperation. Strangely, when you are critical of others, you are dumbfounded by their anger or unpleasant reaction.
planeteSigne.e|Balance:
With the planet Mars in the sign of Libra, you feel a strong need for social harmony, but it is achieved through desire rather than force. In Libra, Mars finds its detriment because it is assigned to the opposite sign, Aries. Your desire for recognition from and collaboration with others may be limited by a feeling that you are being got at.

Much effort may be focused on making friends and establishing a sense of rapport and trust. This is because you enjoy attention and feel best when you work together with others. You enjoy a steady relationship with the opposite sex, and you may seek a powerful and energetic partner. Sometimes you mistake your own needs and ambitions for those of others.

Under Libra, the aggressive and self-centered desire of Mars manifests itself as either charm and fineness or listlessness and laziness. Anger is rarely expressed here, but it will ultimately depend on its aspects to other planets. You relate to a certain social grace, discipline, and caution. Your strong sense of justice can become enraged when you see someone else wronged. You are convinced that unfair treatment is a sign of moral weakness, which at some point could also affect you. Try to avoid taking a short term solution to issues as it will invariably compound them.
planeteSigne.e|Scorpion:
This shows a powerful intensity of feeling and furnishes the capability of great courage, seriousness, and concentration. The secret of this energy lies in the higher vibration of Pluto, which rules Scorpio. Relatedly, for many, Mars in Scorpio is sex, sex, sex. This focus may lead to the lowest of moral deviations, but with a conscious awareness, it may also foster the ability to elevate oneself to that of making love from the heart.

Since your desires run very deep, sensitive reactions, possessiveness, jealousy, and vengeful feelings are signs that a spiritual transformation is necessary. Although you can certainly hold a grudge, you should attempt to find a different way to vent your anger and learn to forgive others. Focus on your positive traits and take responsibility for your anger.

Because it is extremely difficult for you to stay neutral or indifferent when dealing with others, you tend to make everyone into either a friend or a foe. You are reserved and do not let your intentions known without sufficient reason. You should protect yourself from being too coarse or thoughtless. Pay close attention to the feelings of others who are not gifted with your strength. Perhaps you should learn not to take things quite so seriously and personally. Try to be an observer.

You are able to draw attention due to your ingenuity and daring manner, particularly in difficult situations. You stand behind your principles and can be uncompromising in arguments. Try to resist the temptation of an "all or nothing" or "now or never" attitude. This disposition can prove fatal in some relationships and make it difficult to reconcile feelings within you.
planeteSigne.e|Sagittaire:
This suggests strong philosophical convictions, great enthusiasm, and possible inconsistency. You start out eagerly with new ventures but become bored with them halfway through. Much of this is due to a youthful approach to things and a strongly independent nature. Your eager desire to act on your principles sometimes makes others defensive. If your stance is dogmatic, you may make yourself unpopular. You are capable of being fun-loving, so it would be better to develop this characteristic.

You may love sports and games, and especially the outdoors. You are honest and open and have a sense of fair play in sports and other competitive areas. You compete forcefully, and with dedication, but dirty tactics are beneath you. On the other hand, you use the rules as much as possible to your advantage. Travel means a great deal to you because you require thrilling changes and love to examine new territory.

You like to participate in any discussion about justice, religion, philosophy, or higher education. You stick mostly to conventional guidelines but can be rather aggressively self-righteous. If Mars is adversely placed in this sign, you should be aware of a tendency towards sarcasm, undiplomatic behavior, bombastic speech, and selfishness. These ways of being will prevent you from achieving your goal of finding a true form of happiness.
planeteSigne.e|Capricorne:
You like to appear in control and dislike wasting energy or time on anything irrelevant. Mars in Capricorn applies much of its energy in the form of career ambition. In life, the focus is placed on materialistic comforts rather than sensual expression (found more in Scorpio and Taurus). Your ambition is for recognition, and you need to be able to operate efficiently. You behave thoughtfully, always keeping in mind a requirement to accomplish tangible results.

As Mars is exalted in Capricorn, you are able to carry out lengthy tasks and can pace yourself until they are completed. This is because you generally display a talent for organization and discipline. The influence of Capricorn provides a significant amount of self-control. Since you have strong practical reasoning abilities, you are capable of decisive action. You abhor laziness and lethargy and can put a plan into action without regard for human feelings. When provoked, you are capable of a cold anger.

If you have children, you will need to balance your career with the necessary attention they will require to insure they succeed according to your desires. You become extremely upset if any family member shows a tendency towards apathy and/or an unruly lifestyle. If Mars is challenged in Capricorn, you should be careful not to manipulate others to advance yourself and gain material wealth. Capricorn is ruled by Saturn, the Lord of Karma, and inappropriate motives could be problematic if you lose sight of human values.
planeteSigne.e|Verseau:
This suggests you need to feel independent in order for your originality to run free. You are capable of a sensibility that is controlled by reason, but this can fluctuate often when emotions are involved. You may be active in the field of mechanics, computers, or electronics. Some may find fulfillment with humanitarian work or scientific research. A greater opportunity awaits you with teamwork rather than an individual effort.

Mars in Aquarius represents a reforming tendency which you like to implement in your affairs. You are your own person and do not concern yourself with conformity if it does not connect to your logical and practical experience. Tradition is only recognized if it has earned your respect. You have difficulties performing tasks if you're not allowed to work in your own way and learn through personal mistakes. Thus, you may not work well under authority.

If you reject proven methods before considering a better way to go about something, you may find yourself losing more liberty than you are really prepared to accept. A well-aspected Mars should allow you to maintain a balance between unique social concepts and the actions necessary for implementing a task. If Mars is adversely placed in Aquarius, you may reject the status quo without attempting to change it. Learn to cooperate with friends and groups.
planeteSigne.e|Poissons:
Aggressive traits of Mars are usually lessened in the mutable-water sign of Pisces. Desires are strong when it comes to emotions, which are fed from the depths of your consciousness. Because these desires can be vivid and uncontrollable, they are easily released in realms of fantasy. Your high sensitivity and strong emotions are such that if you don't take time for rest and relaxation, you may become so sad that you would like go off into a corner and break out in tears.

You may find it hard to release anger, which causes you to become testy and irritable. This pent up anger turns to resentment and masks your feelings. Try not to mourn over past conflicts, and do not let your excessive sensitivity stand in the way of building self-confidence and the ability to act immediately and decisively. You dislike direct confrontations, electing to express your displeasures and complaints in a subtle manner. You prefer to scheme and act behind other people's backs in order to avoid direct confrontation with your adversaries.

You may fall in love too easily, perhaps because you are manipulated more readily than most. Try to find an understanding partner who will work with you to promote your mode of expression at your desired pace.
planeteSigne.f|Bélier:
This suggests high optimism, particularly when you feel free to pursue a chosen goal without hindrance. Much of how Jupiter (and the outer planets) expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter in the sign of Aries can display a reforming spirit with an interest in many areas of the conscious mind. This may be inconsistent or short lived on a personal level, but probably not so in terms of understanding social conscience and change. If you possess a great deal of enthusiasm and self-confidence, you will gain the respect and encouragement of others. The positive initiative also provides the capability for you to act in some leadership role.

If Jupiter is positioned with difficult aspects in Aries, you could expect too much from yourself and act in a stubborn, infantile manner. People might find you too picky about certain things and yet rather daring in other activities. Be careful that you do not waste your resources, and try to build up your patience and caution in the area of finance.
planeteSigne.f|Taureau:
This suggests moderate to high optimism with a belief that success is achieved through persistence. You prefer to accumulate ideas and activities in order to allow them to build upon one another. Much of how Jupiter (and the outer planets) expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter in Taurus provides the capability to not only attain material and financial wealth for yourself, but also for others. You see money as a prerequisite to acquiring material pleasures and comforts -- in short, the beautiful things in life. However, you will only feel free once the basic essentials (like food, shelter, money, emotional security, etc.) are attended to. If you are highly developed spiritually, you may also be intensely aware that financial means can be used to change your social and material surroundings.

If Jupiter is challengingly aspected under Taurus, you should avoid excess and waste. You may need to be more cognizant of the predicament and needs of others. You should also be aware of the necessity to preserve earth's resources by acting with more wisdom than has been shown in the past. You probably identify with certain moral principles. There could be a focus on business interests, and you would like to belong to a higher echelon in society. However, you should be careful that you don't earn disdain from those less well off. You could also agitate other generations with your showy, overdone self-righteousness.
planeteSigne.f|Gémeaux:
This suggests moderate to high optimism but expressed in many unique ways. You believe that success is always possible and that people do not have to work too hard to obtain it. Much of how Jupiter (and the outer planets) expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter in Gemini suggests broadmindedness, but also skepticism in certain intangible areas. However, the more spiritually inclined person will open the right doors of communication and be provided with special social contacts. This may bring advantages with travel, writing, or social affairs. Traveling speakers often have Jupiter in this sign. With Jupiter under stress, superficial behavior, snobbery, and bragging could occur.

You may be involved with publishing, service professions, importing and exporting, or the communications industry. Your intellectual perception is constantly alert, which leads you to higher levels of development. It could be that you prefer unconventional forms of study, or self study, rather than conventional education. Your intellectual perception allows you to catch on to the patterns and trends of social, political, and historical developments. You may feel trapped when you do not know certain facts and set free once they are known.
planeteSigne.f|Cancer:
This infers a generous, kind, and good humored nature -- although you may be cautiously optimistic. You enjoy good food, its preparation, and domestic affairs generally. Be careful that this gastronomic passion does not add excessive weight and become a detriment to your health. If Jupiter is afflicted, you may inordinately hold on to those you consider emotionally important.

If Jupiter is well positioned, you may have a very warm heart. You may offer your home as a refuge where friends in need can stay while getting back on their feet. Your bustling household could resemble a mission with so many people coming together under one roof. You enjoy taking care of the world. To your family and neighbors you are kind and generous. However, avoid indulging yourself in idealistic preoccupations which could conflict with basic, practical thinking.

You probably feel comfortable only in familiar territory and align yourself with traditional values. You may possess a good business sense, and should this be the case, you are likely to succeed because you are good at encouraging others.
planeteSigne.f|Lion:
This suggests a fair degree of optimism, so long as you are personally involved in the activity. Self-confidence and a desire to improve are inherent in this combination. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Physical energy levels could be strong, and you may be quite generous. However, it is likely that you will always expect something in return. You love parties and social get-togethers. If you are prosperous, you may take part in activities which make you feel valued and of a high social position. You believe that success can be achieved through glamour, charisma, and publicity.

The expansive quality of Jupiter in connection with Leo can generate an eccentric self-centeredness that can lead to arrogance and boasting. Learn to derive humility and self-esteem from service to others and from understanding universal laws. If you are partial to games of chance, be aware of compulsive behavior and do not risk losing too much in chancy bets.
planeteSigne.f|Vierge:
The location of this planet suggests a lot of doubt, so optimism is not very high. Jupiter is in detriment in Virgo because the earthy methodical nature of this sign contrasts significantly with the fiery expansionism of Jupiter. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

You value your work and perform many services for others. If you restrict yourself to mundane tasks, fastidiousness, or excessive acceptance of societal norms, you may become quite frustrated. On the other hand, should you become too adventurous, excessively socialize, and take on too much, you may feel insecure or lack stability. Achieving balance may be something you need to learn.

Perhaps you also need to learn to share responsibility and how to be a team player. By securing the assistance of others, you will balance your work load. If honesty and integrity are important to you, they will promote good relationships with those whom you interact with on a daily basis. You enjoy pleasant work circumstances and are valued for your productive service. You require sincerity even in small things and are capable of differentiating between a truth and a falsehood even when given a whole lot of both to sort through.
planeteSigne.f|Balance:
This suggests reasonable optimism -- when things are going well! Unless Uranus is strongly placed, you are not likely to be very independent. Cooperation and joint activity is your modus operandi for success and prosperity. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

With Jupiter well placed, you may be very persuasive when presenting your views to others. Your humanitarian qualities include altruism, hospitality, sympathy, and sincerity. Accordingly, you are well loved and popular. With your perceptiveness you could be a diplomat, mediator, public relations specialist, or even a salesperson of a quality product. You have a talent for expressing yourself convincingly when describing the advantages of certain ideas connected to social programs.

If Jupiter is burdened in Libra you should be aware of self-indulgence and lethargy. Try to refrain from entertaining double moral standards since you could experience rejection. You may dislike any form of loneliness and inconsistently appease others to gain favor. Avoid promising more than you are able to give.
planeteSigne.f|Scorpion:
This suggests reasonable optimism -- once your direction is known! There may be a tendency to seek fulfillment through a deep emotional commitment to tasks. You want to have a more serious involvement with a person or mission than most. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

You may be interested in the more bizarre aspects of life. This interest can vary from investigative work to tapping into the invisible sources of power in the universe in order to expand your consciousness. Superficial knowledge is not enough for you, and you want to find out more about those unexplained mysteries. With Jupiter in Scorpio, it should be easier for you to learn about the world around you.

If there have been events in your life which sometimes overwhelm you, try to understand the nature of these sorrows and learn to let them go. Being able to forgive and learn from such experiences is often an untapped resource of Jupiter in Scorpio. Use your perceptive sensitivity to give life more direction. Be on the lookout for dubious investments in any form, since you could stand to lose a great deal. Your philosophical and ethical views on social manners and principles may be uncompromising. You possess a great deal of sexual charisma, which should be used honorably.
planeteSigne.f|Sagittaire:
This suggests a high level of optimism -- once you feel free from most constraints! For you, success is possible through trying something new and by applying yourself. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter is assigned to Sagittarius and thus is at home in it. Accordingly, the emphases here are on greater freedom and a study of philosophy, religion, and educational matters. You enjoy traveling and are fascinated by strange cultures. If you can manage it, it would be good for you to get out and experience some of the great wide world.

With Jupiter well placed, you may have a strong interest in environmental concerns. This usually extends to thinking of our planet as a whole and how humanity can best work with mother nature. If Jupiter is not well-aspected, there may be a tendency towards excess and exaggeration. In such cases, try to work with your conscious mind to understand the larger picture of such things as cause and effect.
planeteSigne.f|Capricorne:
This suggests a realistic form of optimism in which one earns success the old fashioned way -- through hard work and endurance. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter in Capricorn expresses the potential for a high level of integrity, particularly in ethical and moral affairs. Should you embrace this, you could easily find yourself in positions of responsibility. As a rule you value honor, a solid upbringing, and traditional principles that have been tried and tested. However, on the down side, there may be too much rigidity and miserliness. Stubborn social views and self-righteousness may isolate you from the mainstream of society. If Jupiter is afflicted, there could also be some prejudice against others.

Personal ambitions may be strong and can be fulfilled through your sense of duty to the society in which you are living. A position of power nourishes these needs, but it can cause conflict in your domestic life in terms of spending time with your family. If you manage to succeed in balancing your career and private life, you will be in a position to lead a comparatively problem-free existence.
planeteSigne.f|Verseau:
This suggests a moderate form of optimism in which one earns success with a special combination of personal independence and voluntary cooperation with others. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

With Jupiter in Aquarius, you choose to pursue idealistic activities. A belief in the legitimacy of social class or racial difference is alien to you. For you, tolerance, respect, and cooperation are the necessary ingredients for a successful society. You enjoy having a large circle of friends and have little or no time for those who support social differences, bigotry, and zealous nationalism. You recognize that every individual has a place on this planet where he or she can contribute in his or her own unique way.

If Jupiter is positioned harmoniously in Aquarius, you should have a strong interest in humanitarian efforts, philosophy, and certain new age concepts. Older souls may contribute to the new body of thought connected with the age of Aquarius. Much of this is because you have a good understanding of such things and are open to new ideas. If Jupiter is challengingly aspected in Aquarius, you may be tactless and unpredictable with others. You should be careful of your involvement with those who support revolutionary concepts and extreme views that lack discipline and responsibility.
planeteSigne.f|Poissons:
This suggests an instinctive form of optimism in which you feel that success is earned through the right kinds of thoughts and motives. You have a strong imagination and probably are no stranger to self-sacrifice. Much of how this planet expresses itself in any sign is dependent on aspects to the inner planets and the house position it is in.

Jupiter in Pisces imparts a great depth of feeling, which makes you particularly understanding and sympathetic. You like to stand up for those less fortunate than yourself, and it is possible that you are inclined towards voluntary work. You should be careful that other people do not exploit your generosity and sympathy. You should also learn to help others to become independent, rather than seek self-fulfillment by making life easier for them.

If Jupiter is challenged there could be some self-indulgence, unreliability, and extravagance. A desire to belong to some sacred organization which promotes status may lead you to an obsession for ritualistic behavior. You need to be wary of false gurus, especially those who want to direct your life. Since you are naturally interested spiritual concepts, try to keen an open mind and be guided by your inner conscience.
planeteSigne.g|Bélier:
The Saturn in Aries generation needs to learn how to take an objective view of itself and others. There may be a need to develop and consolidate your focus in life in terms of how best to apply yourself. Aries represents the initial impulse towards an undertaking, while Saturn represents the law of cause and effect. Thus, you will find yourself in problematic situations whose resolution lies in learning how to take an objective view. If you do not learn from these experiences, they could become more painful, and many lessons in life are not learned easily. We are sometimes forced to confront the things that create difficulties in our lives in order that we can grow and move on.

You may not have a developed aesthetic sense and often judge things according to price or appearance. Saturn in Aries can create some tension and defensiveness. You should try to sort things out with others, rather than allowing a struggle to occur within yourself. If you experience this kind of tension, you will likely suffer from headaches. Enhanced self-esteem and constructive dialog with others will assist greatly in avoiding suffering.
planeteSigne.g|Taureau:
The Saturn in Taurus generation needs to learn how to release any obsessive bond with the material in favor of the spirit. There could be karma concerning money, value, self-worth, love, or what is important in this lifecycle. You may appear agnostic to the world, not appreciating the real meaning of love. If this planet is afflicted, you can worry a lot about money and possessions. Also, thriftiness can extend to meanness. Possessive attitudes must go, since they generate worries rather than enjoyment; you will need to learn how to share with others. There has probably been too much emphasis on materialism in past lives.

With Saturn well-placed in Taurus, your desire for material things can manifest in a positive way. In addition you will have stamina, patience, and a strong talent for professional organization.
planeteSigne.g|Gémeaux:
The Saturn in Gemini generation needs to learn how to process underlying skeptical and critical tendencies. There could be some communication problems with brothers, sisters, neighbors, or even with teachers. It is either that you are not heard right or you do not hear things the way they are meant. You may have made a slow start in school or college, and if this is the case, it is often compensated for by being a sure and steady learner -- not an excited one. You may feel lonely at times because you do not fully participate in your interactions with others. This is due to an unconscious fear of being disappointed or deluded.

On the other hand, Saturn in Gemini can offer a certain practicality and logical thinking. In such cases, you may be very committed and disciplined in your thoughts and judgments when tackling written tasks or when solving problems. You like to evaluate new concepts in terms of their potential or proven usefulness.
planeteSigne.g|Cancer:
The Saturn in Cancer generation needs to learn how to overcome any inherent feelings of insecurity. You have a deeply rooted need for recognition and respect from others. There could be karma with your mother, feelings, residence, and/or security. Your early upbringing could have been dull and difficult -- or there may have been a disciplined parent with strong moral views. You should be alert for metabolic disorders which may lead to obesity and water retention, or in a few extreme cases, to malnutrition.

Saturn is detriment in Cancer because the sign of Capricorn, which is ruled by Saturn, stands opposite to Cancer in the zodiac circle. This planet's position here indicates a threat to domestic security and family life. You may therefore have worries about your home life, and it probably relates to why you prefer to have some degree of seclusion at home. You will tend to guard very strongly anything under your care. For this reason alone, you can be very shrewd in business.
planeteSigne.g|Lion:
The Saturn in Leo generation needs to learn how to project warmth to others in a sinCeres and honest way. Persons with this Saturn position often need to be recognized and respected. Perhaps you focus too much attention on yourself. You have a strong drive to be in control of your close surroundings. There can be karma with your family, some creative endeavor, or with power and authority.

In addition, in Leo there will be karma with the father or children. You take your responsibilities as a parent seriously, but if Saturn is under stress, you may act emotionally cold and fail to achieve the necessary understanding of your children. You may even feel inadequate as a parent. Saturn can be something of a killjoy for the pleasurable qualities of Leo. Much will depend upon the aspects to Saturn in this sign as to how these energies combine overall. If appropriate, try to work on your self-esteem.
planeteSigne.g|Vierge:
The Saturn in Virgo generation needs to learn how to be tolerant of themselves and others. This combination also deals with work structures and how to control ambitions. You must maintain your health and a conscious effort towards being of service. Should this not be the case, your well-being may suffer more readily than most. There may be a tendency towards backaches and other spinal problems. You should be careful that you are not too strict or become disheartened simply because you find yourself crushed by professional pressures and other responsibilities. Learn to relax occasionally, and try to develop a sense of humor. This will help keep potential intestinal and nervous system problems at bay.

If Saturn in Virgo is under stress, you should be aware that your tendency for perfectionism threatens your relationships at all levels. By sticking rigidly to rules and regulations, you make it hard for others to get along with you amicably. You may drive and overwork yourself and others too hard. An excessive preoccupation with frivolous details may cause you to lose sight of the big picture.
planeteSigne.g|Balance:
The Saturn in Libra generation needs to learn specific lessons in love or relationships. A lack of balance between yourself and partners indicates that this is indeed a lesson here. Some of the problems that can manifest concern an obsession with being married. However, you may be one of the many who subsequently get divorced. It is not therefore surprising that the 1952 generation of Saturn in Libra commands the highest marriage and divorce rate known in the US.

If Saturn is under stress, there could be a persecution complex. In extreme cases you may avoid close relationships altogether. If you do marry, it may be for security, rather than love. You tend to expect too much of others and may thus develop the dubious reputation of being a slave driver. You should try to show acquaintances sufficient love and consideration. Be wary of false pride which could tempt you to take on too much responsibility or obligations resulting in an excessive effort on your part.

Saturn in Libra is associated with the laws that govern human coexistence. Thus, Saturn can be very powerful in this position because it is also associated with social sensitivity and responsibility. If Saturn receives beneficial aspects here, you will likely acquire financial security or social recognition. This planetary placement can help offset any tendency for indecisiveness. You tend to follow each letter of the law, but may on occasion lose sight of the initial purpose for the law. Justice and fairness are quite important to you, and you will defend them to the last. However, the way that you perceive justice is greatly influenced by your personal disposition.

The intellectual air sign of Libra is also a cardinal sign, so you may find yourself involved in some form of business. This could extend to organizational planning, agreements, negotiations, and the delegation of work between members of a team.
planeteSigne.g|Scorpion:
The Saturn in Scorpio generation needs to learn specific lessons regarding intimacy and emotions. As with any water sign, emotions can be numbed or restricted. You will likely be strongly disciplined, which can give way to a denial of social and/or sexual activities. This is because of a preference to pursue a quest for monetary security. If you take religion seriously, you may hold dogmatic views. You can be very unforgiving if you feel that you have been deceived and may plot and scheme for revenge. You are seemingly incapable of forgiving and forgetting even the slightest of insults. The resolution for this placement lies in transforming desires into soul growth by way of group and partner relationships.

Any challenging aspects to Saturn in Scorpio may indicate disputes concerning inheritance, taxes, or communal financial resources, which could even end up in court. It may be easy for you to be celibate, and there may be some insecurity or obsession with death or problems dealing with others dying. With the planet Saturn well-placed in this sign, you show common sense, are responsible, and have an ability to administer financial matters. This may include corporate finance, taxes, matters of inheritance, insurance, or trust funds. You may be extremely good at negotiations. You enjoy being in a position of authority and are prepared to fight to make your way, but be careful that your methods remain fair.
planeteSigne.g|Sagittaire:
The Saturn in Sagittarius generation needs to learn specific lessons concerning consistency of attitude. Saturn's need for security and consolidation conflicts with the Sagittarian energy for freedom and expansiveness. There could be karma concerning philosophy, freedom, religion, justice, travel or lack of it, and sometimes being anchored to one's life, work, job, family, or home -- i.e., responsibilities in general. Sometimes the lessons concern happiness or a contraction (or limiting) of happiness. This is why you may find yourself getting very moody and depressed. You normally take education and philosophy seriously, and if you do not go to college, you will feel guilty about it for the rest of your life. You may adopt a strong moral code related to a particular religious belief.

Many Saturn in Sagittarius individuals tend to feel happier by middle age. Under affliction, you are not very sporty and can be critical of others. You may self-righteously attempt to force others to accept your philosophical or dogmatic beliefs. There may be difficulties both in planning and traveling on long journeys. With Saturn well-placed, you may be honest, fearless, able to defend your moral position and maintain a strong sense of justice. You constantly seek the truth, including the underlying concepts which govern your social behavior. As a result you can be a good teacher, but you are also afraid of rejection or criticism and are insulted when you feel that you have been treated unfairly. Your good reputation is of great value to you.
planeteSigne.g|Capricorne:
The Saturn in Capricorn generation needs to learn to embrace specific principles concerning unconditional love. This placement may also epitomize karma with one's career, authority, practicality, and ambition. There is often an active pursuit of power, influence, and authority in many areas, including scientific or political ones. You want to consolidate your personal security so that you can achieve a comfortable position in life without having to take risks. Unless contradicted by other influences in your chart, you tend to be ambitious, reserved, self-reliant, and passionless.

If Saturn is challenged here it is likely that you will attempt to control others. You run the danger of being insensitive to human needs, perhaps in part because you take life very seriously, viewing it as a constant struggle. You lack a sense of aesthetic appreciation and often judge things according to their price or external appearance. You can become overly depressed and take on more than is good for you. If you build a life based on power and prestige without compassion and integrity, you will fall hard. Perhaps you lacked a father image in your early years. You should cultivate humility and a sense of humor. Also, try to develop a set of values that extend beyond any materialistic fixation.

If Saturn is well-placed, you feel that no one has the right to advise others or to take on political or economic responsibility if their affairs are not in satisfactory order. You are aware that everything has its price, that everyone should contribute to progress, and that they should also reap what they sow.
