Eventually, when you have reached the height of your career, you help others get on their own two feet. In later years, you may forget any conflicts and difficulties of your earlier youth and re-embrace certain youthful activities.
planeteSigne.g|Verseau:
The Saturn in Aquarius generation needs to learn how to integrate their feelings and establish a role in life. You are concerned with truth as well as scientific and social matters. Social connections play an important role for you. You like to use lessons gained from personal experience to help others. For better or for worse, the karma here concerns groups, friends, goals, and the organization of and direction in life. Although you may make many acquaintances, there will probably be a few lasting friends. To obtain your goals, you need to work hard and be patient. If you learn your lessons, there will be great rewards in later life.

If Saturn has challenging aspects, you should be careful about being too obstinate, indifferent, and arrogant. You might want to control those around you, expecting them to dance to your tune so as to serve your own purposes. In personal relationships, you need to be aware of appearing cold and arrogant.
planeteSigne.g|Poissons:
The Saturn in Pisces generation needs to learn how to focus on and nurture feelings of hope and fortitude. Here the planet of karma stands in the sign of karma. This may be interpreted as a life full of problems, but this is not necessarily the case. It will depend on how Saturn is aspected. One thing is common, though: you must serve humanity or suffer health problems.

If Saturn is adversely aspected, this would epitomize a karma with yourself, in that you can be your own worst enemy. This is a very emotional karma, indicating self-pity or self-destruction and hidden events. Remember, hidden events are not readily visible -- they can result from avoiding a decision or commitment and have a lasting effect on your life. There can also be karma with [hidden] enemies, humanity, institutions, and hospitals. By learning and practicing meditation, you may be able to bring order and balance into your life.

With Saturn well-aspected in Pisces, you are modest and sensitive. You are prepared to help and assist anyone in need, particularly those who are suffering. If your thought process is straightforward, you may be talented as a psychological advisor. You require an objective picture of yourself in order to recognize your strengths and weaknesses. This is a first step to overcoming any problems. Should you find that personal problems (such as a lack of faith or some other inhibition) prevent you from assisting others, work on leaving the past behind and taking an active part in forming the present.
planeteSigne.h|Bélier:
1927 -- 1935
Individuals from the Uranus in Aries generation are pioneers of social reform. The freedom to act autonomously is of prime importance. You are of a brave, determined, and enterprising group that shows much initiative. However, if Uranus has challenging aspects in Aries, you can sometimes be impetuous and unpredictable. In addition you may be politically zealous, too independent, and glib in your denial of the past.

An extra dose of nervous energy is often a part of this planetary placement, which does not make you content to sit around waiting for something to happen. You like to make your own decisions and draw personal conclusions without interference from anyone else. You want to change the world in unique ways, rejecting the old order of earlier generations. Without some major crisis, you are not very cooperative with others.

You may travel more than past generations and thus contribute significantly to newer means of transport. Relationships may be more erratic, where you make many friends and then lose them. You should learn to be more considerate of others. Try to embrace the higher vibrations of this planet to enable worthy inventiveness and appropriate ethical ideas that have a long term value.
planeteSigne.h|Taureau:
1935 -- 1942
The Uranus in Taurus generation promotes new ideas concerning the acquisition of wealth. However, some of these ideas cause some individuals to lose this wealth very quickly. This is because Uranus finds its fall in Taurus, creating complications with material possessions. A wish to change your economic situation too quickly can create difficulties, and close domestic ties may restrict your opportunities for free personal expression. You may resist taking advice from others -- this is quite a profound effect of Uranus in this sign.

You may experience difficulty in processing some of the spiritual impulses that you receive. If Uranus is well-aspected, you could get some financial breaks, and you might also possess an impressive voice. Should Uranus be under stress, you could be very obstinate, nervous, or even vindictive.
planeteSigne.h|Gémeaux:
1942 -- 1949
The Uranus in Gemini generation possesses the ability to develop a new age of thought. This is significant in that Uranus rules Aquarius; as we enter the new Age (2000 years) of Aquarius, you are part of a generation that is mindful of this energy. Many individuals from this generation paved the way by developing and promoting new forms of science and technology. As you are always searching for something new, you inVesta time and effort in building up new social contacts and exploring new aspects to life. As a consequence, you broaden your intellectual horizons and perceive alternative ways of living.

If Uranus is under stress in Gemini, you may be rather restless and rarely have the patience to complete a self-initiated task. Greater self-discipline is required if any of your ideas are to come to fruition. You should be mindful of being too detached and eccentric. If Uranus is well-aspected, you may have a capacity for ESP, inventiveness, and quick thinking.
planeteSigne.h|Cancer:
1949 -- 1955
Uranus in Cancer indicates a more intuitive and sensitive generation. Hence, you may want to experience new and original forms of stimulation through expressing your feelings. In a desire to free yourself from your rigid parental authority, you implement unconventional methods regarding family life. Other generations will see the benefits and disadvantages of such methods. Unfortunately, these disadvantages will cause a large number of displaced youths in our society. This generation is probably more nationalistic and patriotic than most, and it may be an influencing factor in the rise of nationalism towards the end of the twentieth century.

With Uranus under stress in Cancer, there can be over-sensitivity and a tendency to suffer nervous indigestion and stomach ailments. Your impulsive temperament may cause violent mood swings or obsessions, and whether you are male or female, certain females may initiate a dramatic change in your life. With Uranus well placed, creative endeavors and humanistic tendencies are likely. You may be directly involved in a successful enterprise or with the underprivileged.
planeteSigne.h|Lion:
1955 -- 1962
The Uranus in Leo generation promotes the need to establish an egocentric form of identity. Your attitude towards sexual relationships will probably vary with traditional norms. This is because it is difficult for you to stay on one emotional level for very long. You might be a supporter of free love. The planet Uranus is in detriment in Leo, which may lead to stress and tension. Much of this tension is caused by an ego-centered focus. Social standing and career play too important a role over other matters, such as family. Some individuals learn rather late in life that this energy focus needs to be attuned to a higher level of consciousness and not the lower ego conscious.

With Uranus in Leo under stress, there is a possibility that you are too selfish, dogmatic, uncooperative, and irrational. A head-strong and self-willed manner may prove problematic to compromising or cooperating with those around you. A reckless disregard for convention suggests that you will not be a good example for younger people. With Uranus well placed, creative and artistic endeavors will have significant originality. Self-confidence and enthusiasm will be enhanced, enabling you to complete necessary tasks. For some, leadership qualities may be expressed.
planeteSigne.h|Vierge:
1962 -- 1968
The Uranus in Virgo generation will promote new ideas for industrial relations, environmental problems, and health issues. Individuals born between 1964 and 1967 have a Uranus-Pluto conjunction in their natal horoscope and may have a notable reforming influence in these areas. This generation will be intensely concerned with the restructure of civilization as we know it, in order to further prepare humanity for the new age of Aquarius -- which is ruled by Uranus.

Many new technological discoveries, including the computer, were made while Uranus transversed the sign of Virgo, to which the planet Mercury, the lower vibration of Uranus, is assigned. With Uranus in Virgo under stress, there is a possibility that your manner is abrupt and unsettling. You may be nervous, have nervous habits and an erratic mind which can isolate you from coworkers or subordinates. With Uranus well placed, you should have a good business sense and an ample supply of practical ideas about how work and its related processes may be efficiently organized.
planeteSigne.h|Balance:
1968 -- 1974
The Uranus in Libra generation will promote new concepts regarding sexual relationships and social behavior. You prefer a more liberal, or in some cases, an open type of partnership. You believe that a man and woman should be allowed to bond without the need for a legal contract. Some individuals with Uranus in Libra will try out new lifestyles, such as living in a commune. If you are politically active, you may promote legislation that makes marriage more difficult and divorce easier. Whichever way Uranus is placed here, your personal and social life are likely to change from time to time.

With Uranus in Libra under stress, there can be a constant battle with relationships. The faithful and harmonious energies of Libra contrast sharply with the independent and reforming ones of Uranus. This is what causes disruptions in personal relationships. If Uranus is well placed, you will possess intuitive knowledge about the motivation of people. You may also help develop new and unusual styles of art or music.
planeteSigne.h|Scorpion:
1975 -- 1981
The Uranus in Scorpio generation will instinctively want to feel power in a variety of situations. These situations may include glorification in a chosen profession, control in a covert or lawless activity, or engaging in uncontrolled passion and sensuality. The planet Uranus is often referred to as the planet of dramatic change, and thus its effect may be very powerful when it is situated in Scorpio, the sign of transformation. Uranus is said to be exalted in this sign.

There will be some individuals who will seize the opportunity to contribute to the development of a new world system towards the end of the first quarter of the twenty-first century. Many from this generation will be action-oriented to a greater degree than others and have less patience for inactivity or laziness. If Uranus is challenged in Scorpio, you may have a tendency for violent outbursts of anger, where you try to force change at any cost, without regard for the destruction it may cause. This may be reflected in the high level of violence experienced during the 1990's in many cities and towns. If Uranus is well-aspected, you can be full of ideas, demonstrating inventiveness in such fields as science and technology. You may feel a strong attraction to metaphysical subjects and pursue knowledge about life after death.
planeteSigne.h|Sagittaire:
1982 -- 1989
The Uranus in Sagittarius generation promotes the development of new attitudes towards theology and education. With this constellation of Uranus you may become a pioneer of new forms of religion, spiritualism, or education. You have a desire to integrate the basic principles of science and the occult into a doctrine or faith. This could include reincarnation, astrology, and metaphysics. On the lighter side, it may involve new or renewed forms of education. This generation will have a strong interest in learning first hand about distant people and cultures. Sudden and spontaneous yearnings for adventure will take you upon strange and distant journeys, where you will experience unusual events with the local people. During such visits, you will be fascinated by their religions and philosophical beliefs.

Should Uranus be challenged in Sagittarius, you can be unreliable and a crap-shooter. Your ideas may be inconsistent, and you may have a dislike for formal education. If Uranus is well-aspected, you can be full of philosophical ideas, generous, and a considerate explorer. You want to raise the consciousness of the world through further education and enlightened thinking.
planeteSigne.h|Capricorne:
1989 -- 1995
The Uranus in Capricorn generation promotes the need to implement major changes in the apportionment of political and economic power. Formal yet structured changes are required to insure a higher level of security for the future. You see an excessive division of such power as a curse to humanity. You are likely to be quite ambitious and strive for success. You have original ideas concerning science and business, as well as the business of science. You really like to find new ways of using old ideas. If Uranus in Capricorn has unfavorable aspects, you may experience career and job changes more than most. Your motives behind your goals may be questionable.
planeteSigne.h|Verseau:
The Uranus in Aquarius generation promotes an enhancement of Aquarian energy. This is because Uranus is in its own sign, and thus its influence here is particularly strong. With this constellation, you are more suited for working with groups and organizations whose focus is in humanitarian activities. Your strong will and intellectual independence may contribute to your being more of a bohemian who dresses differently and finds new forms of excitement. On a more refined level, you understand spiritual energies and metaphysical fundamentals in a scientific context. You are probably quite inventive.

You will abandon old ideas and methods if they cannot be logically proven. Your sensitive perception enables you to make interesting prophecies. Should Uranus be challenged in Aquarius you can be anti-social and strongly reject ordinary customs. You can be tactless, erratic, and lacking in principles. If Uranus is well aspected, you can be loyal, friendly, and sincere.
planeteSigne.h|Poissons:
1920 -- 1927
The Uranus in Pisces generation possesses intuitive talents and a scientific interest in the effects of the subconscious. This is because this combination brings about two rather strong intuitive forces. Thus, there will be a greater propensity to tap into the unseen forces that shape our lives. As a member of this generation, you also show a greater tendency than others to free yourself from the mental and spiritual influences of the past. There is a mental struggle to conquer any materialistic leaning from the past while seeking a higher level of spiritual awareness. This should be a more loving and service oriented generation which recognizes the need to assist others rather than pursue personal comfort. If Uranus has unfavorable aspects in Pisces, you may be unreliable and exhibit a deceptive behavior towards your friends. Your ideology can be unrealistic, and disillusionment may plague your life.
planeteSigne.i|Bélier: The Neptune in Aries generation has high ideals. Individuals from it may possess an extra dose of imagination, but unless balanced by other chart factors, they can be confused more readily.
planeteSigne.i|Taureau: The Neptune in Taurus generation will be either more honest or deceptive. Many from it will feel the need to connect with the sea. This generation may be more confused regarding values and security.
planeteSigne.i|Gémeaux:
1888/9-1902
The Neptune in Gemini generation may be more introspective and gossipy. This is a good time for poets and fiction writers, who will be inspired by Neptune's influence.
planeteSigne.i|Cancer:
1902 -- 1914/6
The Neptune in Cancer generation may experience some unusual events in childhood. Establishing a sense of security with the inner self will be a focus for many with this placement. You are likely to possess a high level of sentiment, and some will be rather nostalgic.
planeteSigne.i|Lion:
1914/16 -- 1928/29
The Neptune in Leo generation suggests a need to learn how to serve others rather than just oneself. A few will rise to prominent positions and will have misguided optimism. Perhaps this is why more revolutionaries are born during such a period. Others may turn their attention towards the arts, becoming involved in music and acting. Your creative talent will be strong and inspired (in-spirit-creation) by higher levels of consciousness. You are romantic and idealistic in affairs of the heart. With Neptune under stress, you may be self-deceptive in love and extravagant in pursuit of pleasure. Neptune was residing in Leo during the reckless speculations on the stock market during the twenties, which led to the great depression and subsequent financial ruin for many people.
planeteSigne.i|Vierge:
1928/29 -- 1942/43
The Neptune in Virgo generation needs to learn how to process their psychic gifts. Without serving humanity in some positive way, work and health problems can occur. The planet Neptune is in detriment in Virgo, indicating that whole groups of people can be restricted by material factors. This occurred in the thirties when it was difficult to find work. The Neptune in Virgo generation later developed unfavorable nutrition with the addition of chemical additives and substitutes to our foodstuffs. For those with Neptune in Virgo under stress, you can be rather cold, apathetic and in extreme cases, a hypochondriac. Some may be sharply critical, causing a lot of grief to others. With Neptune well placed, you are drawn to help the suffering of others, especially the young and old who are disadvantaged.
planeteSigne.i|Balance:
1942/43 -- 1955/57
The Neptune in Libra generation is focused on social compromise and reform. Those who experienced an early spiritual awakening became part of the "love generation" or "flower power" people. Neptune in Libra emphasizes emotional and social change, which in its limited form leads to blind liberalism. Social problems often have long term solutions and require careful and rational understanding. Providing laws based on emotional reactions with short term solutions rarely work -- they turn out to be illusions (Neptune). The principle of mutual social responsibility is based on a conscious awareness rather than on the implementation of new man-made laws. This generation is very idealistic and sensitive. If Neptune is well placed, compassion, empathy, and humanistic tendencies will be strong.
planeteSigne.i|Scorpion:
1955/57 -- 1970
The Neptune in Scorpio generation needs to learn a unique awareness of the power of spiritual transformation. Neptune represents the unconscious higher mind, while Scorpio has the energy potential to transform a vindictive reaction to a saintly state. For some, the experience which functions as a catalyst to this transformative energy does not occur, while for others it can happen in a number of ways. At its worst, this combination reveals problems with drugs (Neptune) and sex (Scorpio) in highly exploitive ways. Those born between 1963 and 1969 have an extra Pluto factor with the Uranus-Pluto conjunction in Virgo. This magnifies a disdain for pretentiousness and insincerity. You have high ideals and feel badly when you yourself do not live up to them.
planeteSigne.i|Sagittaire:
1970 -- 1984
Neptune in Sagittarius suggests that this generation needs to develop higher ethical and spiritual values. This generation will have a unique sense of humor and a naturally philosophical outlook. Individuals from this generation will find that much about their expression will be idealistic, and therefore many may not be suited to strong leadership positions. This may be obviated with chart configurations that support decisiveness. Your intuitions will be strong and when combined with your ability to see the big picture, you will be able to predict the consequences of many situations. Meditation will significantly enhance your intuitive talents and enable further understanding of the power of the spirit within all things.
planeteSigne.i|Capricorne:
1984 -- 1998
The Neptune in Capricorn generation is concerned with appropriate and efficient use of earth's resources. Individuals from this generation also need to understand the deeper meaning of love and true balance in relationships. Neptune is the planet of the higher mind, compassion, higher love, and the illusion of love. Capricorn is somewhat cold, stoic, and security centered through work. Hence this is not a happy combination. Without balance and focus, depression, insecurity, and worry may plague your life. With Neptune well placed, you will be quite admired for your reasonable efforts to find solutions. Be careful, though, not to live solely by the letter of the law.

With Neptune in this placement, the illusion of communism and dictatorial governments will be realized. A sense of spiritual responsibility and discipline will develop from this chaos and suffering, resulting in realistic negotiations and agreements. Humanity will be forced to find new political concepts and different forms of government. The end of this period may establish the seeds for a world government, and the increasing importance of the United Nations is already an indication of this trend.
planeteSigne.i|Verseau:
1998-
Neptune's entry into this sign emphasizes a special element of the age of Aquarius. A greater use of our higher senses can be used to assist society for humanitarian purposes. Science will embrace new forms of technology that are more friendly to our environment.
planeteSigne.j|Gémeaux:
1883/4 -- 1912/3
The Pluto in Gemini generation needs to transform their thinking from that of the superficial conscious mind to that of the higher, more spiritual mind. This is generally a period in which old doctrines are swept away or seriously questioned. Rather than confine their thinking by perpetuating limited doctrines, individuals from this generation should expand their thoughts to embrace a bigger picture of things. This generation tends to internalize thoughts a bit more, which can lead to some mental restlessness. Overall, they contributed significantly to the growth of the newspaper industry and many other forms of publishing and communications.
planeteSigne.j|Cancer:
1913/4 -- 1937/8
Individuals from the Pluto in Cancer generation must transform their need to belong to that of a higher sensibility. This is because they have a tendency to draw upon an emotional security rather than a spiritual one. This was the generation that required a long career with a steady job.

This planet's position here can mark a period of cultural change, in which many people's lives are changed by war, economic conditions, and nationalistic tendencies. During the above period, there were revolutionary changes in agriculture due to the discovery and use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. National programs created the energy necessary to build many dams, bridges, and weapons of war. Many homes were dramatically transformed through the introduction of local services, electricity, appliances, etc.
planeteSigne.j|Lion:
1939 -- 1957/8
Individuals from the Pluto in Leo generation need to transform their sense of self leadership into a collective leadership. This is not a collective leadership where decisions are difficult to make, but a collective leadership of self responsibility and balance. For many, there can be a focus on individuality to the point that without transformation, it leads to conflict.

In practice, during the twentieth century this energy has been one of domination, where many countries want to overpower others. This intense energy contributed to the creation of the Atomic bomb. The exceptionally brutal conflict of the second world war also began during this time. In the following years, a long "Cold War" continued. Those who have risen to their spiritual callings and embraced humility by transforming their egos will probably play a major role in the formation of a new world order during the early part of the twenty-first century.
planeteSigne.j|Vierge:
1957/8 -- 1971
Individuals from the Pluto in Virgo generation need to transform their nervous energies of worry and insecurity by being of service to people and nature. This generation has already done much to reduce the exploitation of workers and eliminate servants. Virgo is a sign that is associated with health, work, and the practical application of natural sciences resulting in new technologies. The transition of Pluto through Virgo marked an era characterized by revolutionary changes in industrial relations, production methods, and medicine. Computers gave new life to science, trade, and industry. Trade unions emerged as powerful political agitators, and the packaging and preservation of foodstuffs was introduced. The use of automation in the production of industrial goods made much of the drudgery of human manpower superfluous. There were great medical advancements due to the many exciting medical discoveries made. The use of hallucinogenic drugs in the early sixties introduced new, but uncontrolled, levels of consciousness, which led to a social revolution amongst the young.

Pluto is assigned to Scorpio, the sign of sexuality, and Virgo is the sign of health, so this period saw the introduction of new methods of contraception and the development of new forms of sexual ethics. A dramatic increase in the chemical pollution of foodstuffs became a major problem and led to a new movement supporting natural and organically produced foodstuffs.
planeteSigne.j|Balance:
1971 -- 1983/4
Individuals from the Pluto in Libra generation need to transform their sense of identity within a social context. This includes learning a sense of balance in relationships. During this period, much was spoken about equality. Humanity has to learn that this term is limited to mathematical and logical constructs: there is no equality (People are not the "same"; one person does not equal the other). Ultimately, we need to learn balance and recognize the uniqueness of all things.

Libra is the sign of justice, human connections, social politics, and harmony. Pluto represents transformation. The effect of major world catastrophes during the period in which Pluto was in Libra allowed mankind to effectively modernize its sense of mutual responsibility within society. New concepts of marriage, partnerships, law and justice were developed along with this renewal. Personal, national, and international relationships that were not sufficiently renewed during this period caused many situations to come to a head when Pluto later passed through Scorpio. If civilization as we know it is to advance, and not decline, we must learn how to settle personal and international conflicts peaceably using laws and arbitrators.
planeteSigne.j|Scorpion:
1983/4 -- 1995
Individuals from the Pluto in Scorpio generation need to transform their sense of powerlessness to reveal the higher power within themselves. Events can occur during this period that allow individuals and societies to purge themselves of negative karma and acquire positive karma through the achievement of spiritual goals. During the period of Pluto in Scorpio, worldwide conflicts reached a culmination. Destroy the old and build the new, inference of Scorpio, typified this. There is no other planet on its own in a zodiac sign that contains such a potential for dramatic global change. Its effect is made even more prominent with the culmination of the last days of the age of Pisces. To date, the will of humanity has instituted its own fate, and there will be no alternative but to face the consequences. During this period, people are forced to reevaluate political structures and change direction. That which has expressed itself in negative ways for the detriment of societies will find itself in a state of collapse. This will include governments, financial institutions, and organizations that exploit the common person.
planeteSigne.j|Sagittaire:
1995 -- 2009
Pluto in Sagittarius suggests that this generation will focus on making unique changes to the way society behaves. This will be done by attempting to transform the judicial system and the way in which truth is revealed. Events can occur during this period that allow individuals and societies to acquire a deeper understanding of religious, political, and philosophical concepts. Inherent and further truths will become more apparent -- particularly in relation to these concepts. Because of this, many illusionary and delusionary perceptions will be dissolved.
planeteSigne.Asc|Bélier:
You are perceived as being dynamic, direct, and keen to move forward. You could be somewhat self-centered, competitive, and perhaps you feel as though you need to prove yourself. If there is a lot of fire in your chart, you may lack patience, preferring new projects; otherwise, you become easily frustrated. If you have a lot at stake in some business and acquire patience, you can adapt and do well. You like to be known for your individuality and intelligence and require a firm family foundation in a comfortable residence. However, you may marry out of impulse or without considering all of the necessary factors.

If you keep secrets from any partner, conflicts and problems are likely, especially with money. You will likely follow conventional socioeconomic, political, and spiritual beliefs. You may not be comfortable with committing yourself to any long term association with a group, but will support its ideals. You may need to work at creating a bridge between your conscious and unconscious mind.
planeteSigne.Asc|Taureau:
You are perceived as being stalwart, practical, and having an affinity for the good things in life. You are probably not very adventurous, preferring to settle down within a lavish home in which you take great pride. You are quite affable and compassionate with friends, but a bit suspicious towards strangers. You may become disillusioned if you make poor choices of friends or if you expect too much loyalty without returning it in kind. You have a warm fondness for your personal possessions. You work hard to gain financial security and apply diversity to your investments.

You may have a parental attitude towards those in your immediate neighborhood as well as any siblings. You could show perfectionist traits towards social conformity and may be critical of romantic encounters, whether they are your own or others'. You seek a cordial environment with your peers, as well as those who have an affinity for power and status. Your work in general is connected with larger corporations or the professional groups that deal with them. You have a tendency to be rather traditional and conservative with respect to religion and philosophy; you are impatient with or reject events of a mystical or esoteric nature.
planeteSigne.Asc|Gémeaux:
You are perceived as bright, nervy, and inquiring. You can be "fleet-of-foot" due to a need for constant variety in life. There is a tendency to be continually cultivating new friendships. You make acquaintances quickly for you are good at communicating ideas and concepts, which are often creative. Since you tend to identify yourself with your ideas, your best form of expression is intellectual, although occasionally it may be practical.

You derive a good deal of pleasure from music and balanced social gatherings. Some may need to apply their minds in an intense manner to ensure good health. There is an emphasis on religious and philosophical values with the formation of any close relationship, even though you are probably open minded regarding the views of others. You seem to have a talent with personal resources and a need to store funds for an extreme emergency. The acquisition of wealth is earned the old fashioned way, through hard work! Your line of work may be unusual and out of the limelight. Unconscious material desires can sometimes overwhelm you.
planeteSigne.Asc|Cancer:
You are perceived as being sensitive, nurturing, and moody. You would like sympathy at times, but may be too protective of your emotions to obtain it. There are often strong roots to the past, a place, or group of people, etc. Given this, patriotism and close family ties are quite common. Even though you are able to express yourself with precision, your verbal delivery can be emotionally dramatic. Try to avoid being overly critical of siblings and neighbors. By making the right choices, you could obtain a position of authority in which you realize your financial goals. There is an intense amount of zeal and energy directed towards work. Since you can be very sensitive to the way you are treated, you would rather own your own business.

If your chart supports it, you could easily attract wealthy individuals and financial resources to finance your goals. You work towards maintaining a balanced home environment and can be emotionally attached to certain household artifacts. Even though you are quite generous and emotional with your offspring, any excessive worry regarding your children may result in attempts to dominate their lives. While you are cautious in the way you form close relationships, once formed you like them to have an intense and tenacious bond. You are probably very faithful. Public relations and being in the public eye for too long can overwhelm you. A friend who is in danger, or dies, stirs deep emotions within you which you decline to show outwardly. Even though there is a natural mystical insight, this is not usually consciously accepted or sought. However, such insight serves you well in solving many problems.
planeteSigne.Asc|Lion:
You are perceived as being enthusiastic, giving, warm-hearted, and as someone who understands the big picture. You also try to dominate life. You project a strong will, a sense of dignity, and do not hesitate to offer your opinion -- whether it is asked for or not. You love natural, yet not overdone, forms of luxury and dislike mundane things. You can be prudent in money matters, preferring to work as a team concerning investments and financial deals. In social circles, you can express your ideas with a certain grace and literary intellect. If you are a writer, you're probably one of the few writers who likes to work with a complimentary partner.

You are incredibly protective of your home and family, and even though you occasionally "roar" at home, you dislike any form of complaining within the family. In essence, you want to love -- and be loved. If you have children, you will do your best for them and consider spiritual or philosophical concepts that will assist them. There is often a need to have your own area where you can meditate, pray, or reflect quietly. You take whatever form of work you do quite seriously and will verbally "maul" anyone who ridicules your efforts. You like to earn sufficient money to support your lifestyle and insure future security.

Although you like freedom in a close relationship, you often need to work on giving your partner the same (rather than demanding to know the truth of his or her whereabouts). Your zest for a long and full life is powerful, and if the Scorpio/Pluto elements are not strong, you may try by any means possible to postpone death. This may provide the reason for taking a lot of pills? Your philosophy is rather individualistic, and you tend to reject dogmatic influences of society and religion. You choose friends and groups who can assist you in your endeavors.
planeteSigne.Asc|Vierge:
You are perceived as being undemonstrative, analytical, sometimes critical, friendly but distant. Part of you recognizes a need for structure and order -- you want things to be perfect. Given this, you are thorough, tidy, and keen on personal efficiency. You take an analytical approach to life and like to process facts logically. Although you are generally shrewd, you may on occasion be extravagant. You prefer succinct forms of communication and strive to verbalize your own creative and resourceful thoughts in such a way.

You like your home to be well-organized, with enough space for things to have and be in their rightful place. Even though you may have a very strong sex drive, most people perceive you as sexually cold and prudish. Much of this may have to do with your high standards for a mate and a strong commitment. In your work activities, you can be very methodical and may be drawn to some form of humanitarian activity, perhaps within the field of communications. For you quality, not quantity, is your motto.

You probably attract people who are not as well-organized as yourself, but they seem to assist your understanding of others' emotions. There is often a very practical approach towards religion with this ascendant, and you are probably not very open-minded on this topic or with political matters. You like to be somewhat nurturing to loyal friends. Hidden egotism and expectations may be your greatest challenge.
planeteSigne.Asc|Balance:
You are perceived as charming, kind, affable, and easy-going. You love to talk, play music, read and generally seek peace, love, interaction and equilibrium in your surroundings. Although quite romantic and sentimental, you generally need reassurance from friends. A greater comfort is felt with balanced relationships, and you generally prefer to keep your sex life discreet and private. Your partner will likely be in the same area of work or profession. There is a unique resourcefulness about you, particularly in the ability to add value to some item or cause.

The degree of indecision you have comes from the way in which you process opposing views for a specific outcome. Social ideals may energize you, but your greatest challenge may be to perceive a bigger picture of events. This is because you get stuck in wanting to solve social problems immediately and also worry about trivial things. As you become involved in social issues, philosophy is more likely to attract you, rather than religion.

You are able to work unselfishly, but if you take on more than you can handle, psychologically based health problems can easily ensue. You like to run a well-organized house that can act as a base for any community operation. The arts and the theater often play an important role or interest. A love of beauty may extend to items of adornment that in a few cases are the height of luxury. You like to cultivate friendships with influential people who can assist you in your own endeavors.
planeteSigne.Asc|Scorpion:
You are perceived as strong-willed, intense, bossy, yet somewhat introspective. You tend to act in a subtle and secretive manner and may be a loner. Life is a serious event in which you apply a deep concentration on ideas, activities, and people. With an all or nothing attitude, there is often an intense devotion to the right person or cause. A higher degree of luck in financial matters is not uncommon, and you may be associated somehow with this area.

In general, your expression is a cautious one, but when revealed, it is precise and sometimes penetrating. While you prefer to have friends visit, they will perceive your home to be unique or unusual. You are deeply sentimental regarding intimate relationships and children, although unrealistic expectations can be a source of disillusionment. With a strong will and an ambitious approach, you could easily attain a position of leadership. You eagerly provide help and assistance to those who need it, but not continually as the recipient must learn to go it alone.

There is a tendency to seek a spouse who is financially secure and inVesta in that person to help them look and be their best. However, too deep a desire for luxury could be your undoing. You have strong ideas about joint finances and a talent in this area. There could be a challenge for you in matters concerning mysticism and death, as your logical mind may not initially adapt easily to processing this. You may cling to traditional family religions and philosophy.
planeteSigne.Asc|Sagittaire:
You are perceived as sincere, optimistic, frank, and wholehearted. Although good at making friends, you need to stay independent. The way you influence others often results in a special advantage for you. You seem to have some luck about you, which is useful since you love to travel and explore. However, you should be careful not to take too many things for granted. You are normally quite responsible when it comes to finances and in extreme cases, very frugal. When it comes to new ideas, they have to have a practical basis and appropriate value.

You prefer privacy in your home, which can function as a retreat. Love in the bedroom can be hot and aggressive. Providing you do not over-imbibe, your health should be robust. Relationships might come and go as you desire new experiences, but the person you settle with is likely to be a friend or a friend of a friend. You are often the greater beneficiary in joint partnerships, yet you plan your affairs well for those you leave behind after you die. Secret affairs and suppressed resentments may cause your undoing. There is a tendency to be moralizing at times, and in a work environment you can appear rather cold and aloof.
planeteSigne.Asc|Capricorne:
You are perceived as reserved, cautious, down-to-earth, and in extreme cases, a snob. Being out of the limelight in youth often means that you gain confidence with experience. You take life seriously -- applying an efficient, punctual, orderly, and moral approach to it. With an absence of excitement, you can be pessimistic at times and depressed, yet you strive to maintain a cool and self-contained demeanor.

Income may be generated in rather unusual and original ways, often through large groups or corporations. You prefer to be alone when working on ideas and plans, and you probably communicate better on paper rather than verbally. Your skill at persuading and influencing people in power allows you to succeed. You also form fraternal groups within your organization for security and power. The formation of such a group of people, who are often aggressive and dynamic, serves to provide you with agents to carry out tasks you yourself are too reserved to handle. Your emotional inhibition with close relationships and family members can lead to some tension.

You choose partners who will be emotionally dependent on you, which can sometimes backfire, and such partners are often in the same line of work. You prefer to be in control of joint resources and can often find yourself as an executor of an estate. Your home is usually equipped with a variety of gadgets, and you may look to your spouse for its general condition and upkeep. You take pride in your children and want them to have the best in life. You can be critical of philosophies that are not consistent and may tend to reflect on them when you are relaxed and alone in your own world.
planeteSigne.Asc|Verseau:
You are perceived as humane, optimistic and friendly -- in an impersonal way. You like to be reasonable, and if you appear a bit oddball at times, it could be that you need the whiff of freedom in your veins or that you are somehow obstinate with certain out-of-the-ordinary ideas. Because you essentially want to love the world, and perhaps raise social consciousness, you like to contribute to the common good and will dislike being the focus of praise. If you have brothers and sisters, you were probably the odd-ball or black sheep.

There could be some naiveté in financial matters, but due to your generous nature, others will probably bring you luck regarding money. You like to be in a comfortable home, with soft furnishings and special art. In close relationships, you may not be comfortable with highly emotional people. There is a tendency to attract self-made or domineering individuals, and this can work out, providing you are given enough freedom to pursue your own responsibilities. However, a number of Aquarian's prefer friends rather than lovers. Your health is commonly a reflection of your emotional state and perhaps this is why you are insurance-minded.

Your work may involve some social, civic, or supportive role. You do not generally seek recognition in your sphere of work and may feel uncomfortable in an environment in which there is a strong authoritarian structure. Any involvement with religion or philosophy has to have a humanitarian emphasis. You will feel at home in a large organization in which you have many friends.
planeteSigne.Asc|Poissons:
You are perceived as kind-hearted, easy-going, and sensitive. Unless Neptune is particularly strong, you may convey a false impression to others. If Neptune is strong, you could be impressionable, vague and rather dreamy at times because the world of fantasy that you escape to does not integrate well with this physical reality. This escape could be one of the main influences in any indecision on your part. On the plus side, if you can control your vision into other dimensions, you can be prophetic and artistically creative. Such mystical insight is a gift which will give you a deeper understanding human nature and events.

When it comes to finances you can spend money impulsively, often because you do not want to endure a long period of indecision. There is a constant search for new ways to make money. However, once you have made up your mind on something, you will stubbornly resist changing it. You like to maintain communication with all family members and may want to act as the central hub of information. You will either have a library or an extensive collection of reading material. In order to bring information back to the home, you probably flit in and out -- these trips being fairly local. Although you may not want to show it, you are very sentimental regarding loved ones. Rich food could influence your body weight.

Within the workplace, you may have a feeling of influence or desire for it. You will require some practical energy to succeed in many positions of authority, but perhaps less so if you are in the field of education or religion. It is not uncommon to be something of a crusader for a religion or special cause. There is often an unconscious need to serve humanity. You are attracted to a mate who is practical, disciplined, and organized, although much in the way of mutual understanding may be required for this type of relationship to work. You will seek friends who are essentially stable and conservative because they bolster your security.

planeteMaison.a|1:
The Sun is close to or has embraced a new day at the hour during which you were born. Thus, the fertile strength of daylight was overpowering darkness. If your Sun is well-aspected by other planets, you should sustain this energy during your life in order to achieve great things. You like to take charge of situations as a means of fulfilling your destiny. Accordingly, there is usually a self-centered confidence and a robust constitution present. If you were encouraged to express your individuality during childhood, it is unlikely that others will overlook you. You sense you need to make your mark on life and that you must win respect and recognition through self-initiated achievement. Some individuals with this placement may perceive they must serve as a role model to others, attracting attention and radiating strength and warmth. It may be that you exemplify the power of a healthy self-esteem, and at a higher level, it may be that you radiate a spiritual identity.

If the Sun and the ascendant both occupy the same zodiac sign, the characteristics of this sign will be strongly emphasized. The Sun depicts ego, and the ascendant depicts your projected personality. Thus your character represented by this sign will be intensified. Either way, you will probably focus much attention on personal affairs. You should carefully examine other areas of your chart to establish where you may need to balance this powerful influence.

If the Sun is afflicted, health problems may arise as depicted by the zodiac sign and aspected planet(s). In addition, any selfishness, vanity, or belligerence will make others feel uncomfortable. With an afflicted Sun, you may find that an overly dominant personality and a strong sense of self-importance drives you towards power and authority. Rejected and unable to realize your goals, your pride is crushed. You may become cynical and embittered, but instead of blaming those around you for not unconditionally accepting your importance, you must realize that you are responsible for your reputation.
planeteMaison.a|2:
The second house promotes attention on personal wealth, which includes money, material possessions, and the necessities of life. There is also a focus on personal security. The Sun will portray how you apply your sense of free will in this area. You will be driven to obtain some form of security because you want to be financially independent. Your need for self-projection and your shielding of an inner insecurity generates extravagance and a desire for status symbols. Although you can be charitable with money, you generally expect some sort of service in return. Your ability to acquire money and material possessions will depend on how the Sun is aspected in your chart. If you acquire wealth, it will give you feelings of strength and self-worth.

If the Sun is under stress, there can be greed, possessiveness, and a tendency to over-moralize. Also, you may feel that you need to prove yourself through the acquisition of wealth, which could become an obsession. Conversely, a well-aspected Sun should bring good fortune. This would indicate that you are fairly secure and have the ability to share your wealth wisely. In addition, your strong character will support you in worldly matters. However your Sun is aspected, you will ultimately be able to release the material in favor of spirit.
planeteMaison.a|3:
This position of the Sun emphasizes your activities and personal expression with brothers, sisters, and neighbors. You like to learn things and pass this information on to others. In doing so, your self-confidence and pride is given a boost. At a higher level, you are seeking to establish an effective spiritual communication of love. People with this placement have a strong need to be noticed and at the center of attention. In youth, this can sometimes lead to conflicts with siblings and peers who either require your attention or are otherwise busy.

If the Sun is aspected awkwardly here, your early school years may have been difficult. Even though you may be quite intelligent, your manner of communicating does not easily synchronize with others. It is as if you have somehow assumed they already know certain things. The resultant interchange is fragmented, leaving others bewildered. Frustrated due to a lack of patience and an over-active mind, you may seek your own form of learning in order to outwit others. Instead, you should try to develop your communication skills and writing abilities. Also, you should develop your ability to understand others who may be quite different from yourself, but be sure to test your understanding of others in a polite and humble way.

A Sun well-aspected by other planets should promote the ability to communicate and write eloquently. You may enjoy a meaningful relationship with any brothers and sisters you may have, lead a sociable lifestyle, and work at a job where you deal with others. You seem able to establish a mental rapport with a number of people.
planeteMaison.a|4:
This position of the Sun emphasizes your home life, family property, a nurturing parent, and emotional security. The Sun will portray how you apply your sense of being towards these areas. This placement enhances the memory of early childhood experiences and acts as a guide toward future conduct. You are perhaps quite traditional in outlook. Unless you were the only or youngest child, you would have been keen to look after brothers and sisters. Any tendency towards introspection may spring from a need to find yourself and establish who and what you are. It's likely that material acquisitions are less important to you than your mental development and spiritual growth.

Some individuals with this placement experience either a strong father figure or an absent one. Should either of these scenarios be the case, you will need to process the Karma associated with it and balance the masculine potential within yourself. You will feel a need to build your home life in such a way that you are in control and earn respect. It may be, too, that you feel your best when you work at home. The influence of the fourth house often means you will have to wait until the second half of life to experience security and contentment. Whatever life's experience, try to recognize that the spirit is one's true home.
planeteMaison.a|5:
The principle energies of the Sun are at their strongest in the fifth house. Here, you can attain the expression of your being by committing yourself to things that provide you with pleasure in life. If you fail to achieve this expression or take on too much, illness may ensue. Try to remember that it's not the quantity, but the quality of your activities and the degree of pleasure they provide which is important. Your ability to experience a spiritual and emotional release is your way of developing creative potential for your unique expression. Ultimately, you can turn towards spiritual nurturing of yourself and others.

Romances and erotic relationships will make you feel more alive and improve your self-confidence, especially when sex has its playful and fiery moments. You will likely have a personal interest in entertainment, amusements, sports or arts and other leisure activities. There is a strong pride in the way you approach life and relate to children. You relate to children because you are closely in touch with the childlike part of yourself, and some may consider you to be exactly that. As a parent, you should avoid trying to achieve unfulfilled aspirations for fame and respect through your children, i.e., living your life through them. This would include displaying your child like a work of art merely to gain recognition for that which you have created. Sometimes you may feel like a spoilt child whose only concern is to demand attention.

A challenging planetary aspect to the Sun in this house could lead you to resort to dishonest or exaggerated means to gain attention. You may consider that even contempt is better than indifference. Your desire to be the center of attention may be overly pronounced, where you will assert that you can do anything better than someone else. Try not to overindulge in food and gambling. In extremely serious afflictions, scandal and depravity may occur.
planeteMaison.a|6:
This position of the Sun emphasizes activities related to personality growth, routine tasks, health, and career. You will have a strong sense of pride in the manner by which you achieve in these activities. Obtaining balance in these areas may be a challenge for some individuals. How you experience difficulties and react to small mistakes helps to point the way to physical and spiritual growth. Many of these difficulties may revolve around avoiding service oriented work. Much of the energies of this house demand that a person with planets here be of service or suffer health problems. When you recognize that you need to be of help to other souls, life will take on a new meaning.

You will feel comfortable when you are able to organize the necessary daily tasks so that they do not interfere with your day-to-day life. Accepting restrictions and routines will enable you to perfect and refine your zest for life. Your sense of being will be strengthened when you learn to handle practical tasks skillfully. You could probably generate great ideas while performing mundane work.

If the Sun receives hard aspects from other planets in this house, the above challenges will be emphasized more. It is also likely that you will encounter more than your fair share of difficult bosses. However, a well-aspected Sun will provide a warm, dedicated, energetic duty to yourself and others. In fact, you can find self-realization by serving others.
planeteMaison.a|7:
This position of the Sun emphasizes the way you manage partnerships and interpersonal relationships. This house serves to bring other people into your life with whom you can strengthen your personality. Shared activities confront you with questions which will encourage you to recognize and express yourself more clearly. You are able to use comparisons to perceive things more clearly, especially in regard to your personality. You take pride in your ability to make a favorable impression on others and in caring about their feelings. For you, quality of life is more important than mundane matters; in particular, you may like to have your own brand of sex.

The seventh house also shows how you approach and deal with society in general, and it is possible that you hold a position that is concerned with human relationships. If the Sun receives challenging planetary aspects here, you may be either a bit dithery and frustrated, or excessively domineering. Avoid hiding behind the identity of others or being subordinate to them, since they will suppress your radiant energy. A well-aspected Sun denotes charm and an easygoing nature. In such cases, you will easily be able to initiate balance in a relationship and quite likely will have a successful marriage.
planeteMaison.a|8:
This position of the Sun emphasizes an interest in mysteries, sex, finance, and the use of resources, etc. Instinctively, you are trying to connect to some mystical force so that you can reach out beyond the boundaries of your being. You sense that you can achieve this by coming together and interacting with other people. This occurs in a variety of ways and at all levels of consciousness. You may try to strengthen your identity and self-confidence by benefiting from other people's resources, but not necessarily in inappropriate ways.

Some individuals find themselves involved more than most in the financial affairs of others. As such you may have a job that supports this. Others may be involved through some legacy or will. The eighth house has much to do with sharing and collective value, which may not be limited to material things. There is often a strong association with sex and the transformation of values. Transformation may occur due to a painful experience that serves as a catalyst for growth. Many will seek a deeper connection through a sexual relationship that goes beyond emotions. Others may have strong moralistic views.

If the Sun receives challenging planetary aspects here, you may be possessive, jealous, and inclined towards lower realm witchcraft. Some astrologers equate the eighth house with criminal tendencies, but the whole chart should be examined for this. A well-aspected Sun suggests a resourceful, dignified, and humanistic type of person who aspires to use his or her angelic and psychic abilities.
planeteMaison.a|9:
This position of the Sun emphasizes a wide range of interests and activities. The ninth house represents religion, philosophy, and long journeys. Providing your chart does not indicate a tendency towards dogma, you view life as a type of journey. It may be a pilgrimage in which one examines a variety of esoteric directions, philosophies and religions, without being tied to a prescribed doctrine. You will probably travel and enjoy intense literature that deals with the philosophical exploration of the meaning of life. You like to get away from home, meet new people, and to travel far-even abroad. Should you opt for it, you can be successful with further education.

You should try to balance your life and avoid becoming too preoccupied with complicated interactions and theories. You may have broad ranging solutions for the ills of society but be unable to find the answers to personal dilemmas. You probably enjoy an occupation that provides the opportunity to cultivate interaction with large groups. One of your many occupations could be working at a travel agency, doing market research or training work. Your inventiveness and enthusiasm enable you to motivate others. If the Sun receives challenging planetary aspects here, you may have a self-centered view of life and feel defeated by circumstance. A well-aspected Sun suggests an open mind willing to consider all points of view. At a higher level, there will be a creative expression with spiritual teaching.
planeteMaison.a|10:
This position of the Sun emphasizes ambition and making one's mark on the world. Many individuals with this placement consider their career is of prime importance, particularly in relation to their personality. If you are married, this ambition can place a heavy burden on your family. The tenth house denotes your activities in the world and authority in society. Here, the Sun seeks to express your sense of being in such activities by the type of sign in which it is positioned. Such seeking may have made you rather precocious as a child.

You have an interest in politics and business and probably hold a position that places you in the public eye. With the Sun in the tenth house, you feel a strong need for recognition. You may experience conflicts between your private and professional life, where your feelings of self-esteem and/or self-confidence may be too heavily dependent on your position in public. If the Sun receives challenging aspects here, you may be too egotistical or an arrogant leader who is obsessed with power and ambition. A well-aspected Sun suggests that you are generous, self-disciplined, and paternal. On a higher level, you possess an ability for creative expression with metaphysical concepts.
planeteMaison.a|11:
This position of the Sun emphasizes interaction through social, humanitarian, or political enterprises. You perhaps sense that the foundation of your existence is somehow connected to the larger group's. If you attain recognition for your group activities, you may play an important role or exercise some far reaching influence in an organization. The type of organization will depend on the zodiac sign the Sun is in and its aspects within the overall chart structure. You like to be friendly, but not possessive, towards other people. Care should be taken that you do not identify too strongly with a group whose philosophy is characteristically dogmatic; otherwise, you will completely lose your independence.

The friendship you receive from participating in group activities is important for your personal development, regardless of whether you are asserting yourself or receiving support from them when carrying out your own enterprises. If the Sun receives challenging aspects here, you may be insensitive to the needs of others and exploit them for all you can. You should also avoid setting unrealistic goals. A Sun well-aspected by other planets suggests that you have a genuine desire to help your community or special interest group. At a higher level, the eleventh house is the house of social conscience. As such, you could be involved at a metaphysical level in assisting others.
planeteMaison.a|12:
This position of the Sun indicates vulnerability, sensitivity, and some psychic qualities. There is something of a contradiction in this placement in that here the ego-centered energies of the Sun are faced with twelfth house energies that seek to overwhelm and dissolve that individuality. In the world of spirit, the expression of the soul is dominant. In the physical world, the ego is dominant. Hence, some individuals may have a misplaced sense of being. Perhaps through meditating and achieving a sense of balance in your life, you will realize your purpose.

You are sensitive to the needs of others, which may be why many individuals with this placement are in the medical profession. You want to help humanity, but you may lack the tough-minded resources to do so. You are so sensitive that you easily absorb signals from others in your close surroundings. Therefore, you must withdraw to a reasonable distance to enable you to clear your thoughts and reinforce your personal boundaries. This is often the reason why you feel the need to be alone.

If the Sun receives challenging planetary aspects here, you may be full of fantasies, forgetful, and overly secluded. In extreme cases, misfortune through loss may occur. A well positioned Sun suggests a compassionate, kind individual who wants to serve humanity. At a higher level, you are able to spiritually project love and light.
planeteMaison.b|1:
Any planet in the first house tends to be strengthened and even more so if it is close to the Ascendant. As the Moon represents your instincts and feelings, they are likely to be quite stimulated. You will likely possess a sensitive demeanor which is readily noticed by others. Also, many people probably find quite attractive your receptive and innocent demeanor.

Unless the Moon is afflicted, you will probably have a close relationship with your mother or a mother figure; its placement in this house tends to bring about harmony with the matriarchal principle and with your immediate surroundings. The effect for some, however, is over-dependency on others. Should this be the case, learn how to sense and interpret the responses from others in an objective manner. There can be an even greater challenge if the Moon is afflicted. Some Moon challenges in this house can result in your having had a difficult birth. In life, you may find that limited reasoning gives way to tenacity and obsessive dependence. Try to focus on developing your reasoning skills as best you can.

With a Moon well-aspected by other planets, you should possess an inherent awareness that enables you to know how to react in most situations. This is because you sense opportunities, foresee dangers, and are able to perceive hidden events. If you focus on the higher mind, you will grow spiritually, becoming more independent and balanced.
planeteMaison.b|2:
The Moon in this house can promote a feeling of contentment with material possessions. It also governs personal values towards money and personal goods. This is where a deeper personal attachment to material things is usually expressed. You may feel strongly sentimental about inanimate objects such as family heirlooms. Some of these objects bring back memories of important people and events in your life. You may also feel an affinity for antiques and old memorabilia.

According to your mood, you can be mean or generous (children with a Moon in this house should be positively encouraged to share their toys with friends). Some may experience a constantly changing financial situation, often due to the phases of the Moon. You could find yourself in occupations such as banking, the food or hotel industry, or similar public service activities. If you find yourself placing too much emphasis on material things, use your inner sensitivity and instinctive receptivity to administer to the needs of others. Thus you will embrace a higher spiritual purpose in rising above materialistic needs.
planeteMaison.b|3:
This position suggests that you often change your mind when it comes to ideas, perhaps from changeable circumstances in early education. You seem to pick up what others are thinking, which makes it difficult for you to differentiate between your own thoughts and outside influences. Your emotive feelings exert a strong influence on how you perceive a situation. If you feel optimistic, you experience things positively, but if you are too sensitive the same situation will easily offend or upset you.

You like to express your feelings and be the center of attention, but not necessarily as the leader. There is often a significant amount of activity connected with brothers, sisters, cousins, etc. Either you feel the need to seek comfort and security from close kin, or you had to look after others as a child. Your mother, or a mother figure, may have played the role of an older sister at some point. Aided by creative influences elsewhere in your chart, you will possess certain literary and oratory talents. Use techniques such as meditation to try to understand your higher self and so to communicate a higher love.
planeteMaison.b|4:
The Moon is strengthened in this house and will be expressed by strong, emotive feelings and a deep nurturing sense. You tend to feel secure in your own domestic environment, where you can seek protection from the stresses of life. The choice of home is particularly important for you because of the way in which it forms much of your center. Many fourth house Moon individuals are drawn to older or more mature homes in order to maintain a sense of continuity with the past or because they are attracted to a place that has a soul. You would like to work from home, given the opportunity.

For better or worse, there will be a strong link to parents and family. You identify with masculine security and material comfort from your father and nurturing comfort from your mother to a greater degree than many people are prepared to accept these days. You may still be searching for a father figure who can provide you with some stability. If by middle age you have not found your own stability and security, you should endeavor to do so. The constant change caused by restless feelings will likely generate a lot of stress-leading you to seek a new home, new land, and even relationships. This occurs because you need security to have a sense of belonging. Stomach problems are often the bodily result related to such stress.

Certain events in life seem to encourage you to revert to youthful behavior. It is as if your soul wants you to be aware that you have endured restrictive behavior for too long and that now is the time for you to let yourself go for a while. You may have a strong interest in your ancestry and a desire to live near water. If you can identify and understand your feelings and feel comfortable with yourself, you will be able to embrace the spirit within as your true home.
planeteMaison.b|5:
Here the emphasis is on seeking fun, entertainment, and other aspects of the recreational side of life. You are fond of children and may appear or behave somewhat childlike. This Moon placement usually enhances a desire to have children. However, if you are highly sensitive, you may be plagued by the feeling that your children do not love you. This form of self-consciousness may extend to a sensitivity in terms of the way other people feel about you. You probably like to be the center of attention and love to win prizes and gain honors.

With a well placed Moon, you sense your natural and unique individuality and do not feel the need to prove it. If you are a fun-loving, easygoing person, others will be strongly attracted to you. These characteristics will be enhanced if your Moon is in one of the fire signs (Aries, Leo, or Sagittarius). Some individuals will be very interested in sporting activities, and the placement of the Moon here is often seen in those people who achieve fame through sport.
planeteMaison.b|6:
You have an instinct towards taking care of the daily tasks in life concerning health, fitness, and hygiene. The daily rituals that you attend to provide you with a sense of continuity and contentment. However, if you experience mood swings, the extent to which your ability to cope with daily tasks in life exerts an important influence on your state of health and fitness. In addition, you may find yourself suffering strange illnesses or stress should you choose not to be of service in some way. The sixth house is essentially a transition house from the self to the outer world of experience. The nature of this service could be volunteer work, taking care of the sick, working with the public in some way, or working with nature. You may have experienced health problems as a child, and if so, this would be the source for your sensitivity to health in general.

You should be aware of any hereditary diseases or susceptibility to particular conditions in order to take the necessary precautions. You should also pay attention to your diet because of a sensitivity to certain food and drink. However, your body generally knows what's good for it, and you should listen to what it is telling you. Your sensitivity at work can easily generate a lot of stress and worry, and you may have feelings of inadequacy or a fear of failure that you have yet to accept. You prefer occupations which bring you into contact with other people and dislike working in isolation. You will tend to worry rather excessively when things are not right, and some people might perceive you as a worrywart. Should this be the case, give some thought to the following, "Is this worry going to extend my life?". When you are able to let things go that hold you back and embrace the Great Spirit within, life will be very rewarding. As an exercise, face the Sun each day and recite "I am part of the Great Spirit, nothing can affect me."
planeteMaison.b|7:
You are very much a people-person, and if you possess a restless emotional temperament due to some uncertainty concerning your true identity, you may rely on others for emotional support and direction. This house is the house of relationships, so the feelings of the Moon play an important role with friends and close partners. You are very receptive and adaptable to the needs of your partner. It is also possible that you seek a mother figure in your partner. Marriage tends to be an important element, and you will probably feel like a fish out of water if you are single.

You seek lasting relationships because they offer security and a feeling of belonging. Rather than rushing into a marriage, why not test the waters first by waiting or living together for a while. If you find yourself being obsessive or too needy with a partner, there is quite likely some challenging aspects with your Moon. You may also experience a fluctuation of moods and emotions either by or towards your partner. Try to understand why you attract a certain partner. It is important that you strike a sense of balance in your relationships for ultimate growth. Dominating or being dominated will only invoke a karmic legacy that has to be resolved in this life or later.
planeteMaison.b|8:
The eighth house has much to do with your involvement with what other people own and transfer, be it possessions, big business, wills, legacies-even sex. There is also an association with mystical matters and rituals. With the Moon, your feelings and instincts interact with the affairs of this house. The extent to which the affairs of this house are exercised depends on many factors that are outside of the scope of this text. However, you will probably become emotionally involved in the deeper issues of life, death, and the afterlife. Such an interest could be in religion or psychic spirituality. Psychic abilities may focus on the affairs of this house, and such gifts will require proper training.

As a child, you were probably quite sensitive to many of the supernatural vibrations at work in and around your home environment. Processing perceptions of the subliminal moods, emotions, and frustrations of your mother may have been difficult. If you still carry these experiences with you, it is important to free yourself of them. If there were early experiences in connection with sexuality or death, this is often a strong indicator that you need to understand the deeper meanings associated with such events.

You like to react sensitively to the sexual or emotional desires of your partner and adapt willingly to them. You may also possess a natural ability to promote feelings of increased self-confidence in others. If you find your life to be one emotional crisis after another, the Moon is quite likely receiving some challenging aspects. Try to realize that crises and collapse often lead to a release of overwhelming forces, which can in turn cause a person to transform and grow. Try not to attach too much sentiment or possessiveness to people and objects.
planeteMaison.b|9:
The Moon in the ninth house indicates a natural receptivity for many areas of philosophy and ethics, as well as an intuitive ability to interpret symbolic expressions of universal concepts. This lunar position renders access, via your emotions, to things which cannot be understood on a purely intellectual level. Travel, ancient history, and archaic languages may hold some interest. An archaeologist may have this placement as he or she is able to study such areas with tenacity. However, your involvement with travel, adventure, or work with the esoteric side of life should not become a means to escape from physical reality.

Some individuals with this placement like to contemplate the meaning of life, meditate in a Buddhist monastery, take a long trip, or start a bold enterprise. You may also feel the need to be a preacher of sorts, whereby you can express your philosophical or spiritual knowledge. You like to enlighten and inspire others with the idea of abstract thinking-possibly spreading the good word! There is a strong sense of justice, to the point where you may find yourself being righteously indignant. You may find it hard to settle in a domestic situation for long. It is possible that you will establish relationships with people from other countries who will be able to broaden your philosophical and spiritual horizon.
planeteMaison.b|10:
The tenth house has much to do with your activities in the outer world, as distinct from your domestic life. For many, this involves a career in some prominent or influential position. With the Moon positioned here, you are likely to be emotionally involved in your career or public activities. As such, you like to make a favorable impression on the public. Any fame may be short- or long-lived, but either way there will not be much of a private life. Your feelings about people in authority or prominence will be reflected in much the same way that the Moon is well or poorly aspected.

It is possible that if as a child you were strongly dependent upon your mother's emotional and spiritual expressions, that you may take care of your mother later in life. Your gestures and conduct underline a strong identification with her. Some occupations may include teaching, nursing, and positions that allow you to relieve the worry and stress of other people.
planeteMaison.b|11:
The eleventh house is the house of group consciousness and social reform. It also relates to one's involvement with special groups and organizations. At a higher level, it represents communion with a higher consciousness. The Moon in the eleventh house suggests you seek emotional security through your friendships and through belonging to groups or organizations. If you are easily influenced you should be careful of the group(s) you choose. You like to care for your friends and expect support from them when you are in need of it.
