You may find yourself in the position of influencing the emotions of large groups of people. However, try to be aware that you don't set personal goals simply to suit your current emotional state. Also, avoid being too highly influenced by what other people think would be good for you.

If the Moon in the eleventh house receives challenging aspects, you may have experienced certain problems with your mother or other children when you were young. Any unresolved problems from your early years may manifest in relationship difficulties with women later in life. In such cases, you will use group activities and social gatherings as a chance to recover from these conflicts.

You may enjoy close friendships that have taken root in your childhood and grow well into your later years. It is quite likely that you will become involved in activities which serve a worthy cause of particular importance for you. You like to take on a nurturing role within a group and to ensure the well-being of other group members. It is quite possible that you offer up your home as a meeting place.
planeteMaison.b|12:
In the twelfth house, a person either (1) goes to sleep spiritually, (2) taps into the power of the unconscious self and possibly becomes a medium, or (3) faces the consequences of some past life karma which was connected to selfish higher ideals.

The Moon enhances sensitivity and vulnerability here, especially for those who sleep spiritually. You may be initially shy in company and prefer an uncomplicated, easygoing life by accepting normal customs and beliefs. There is a tendency to live in the world of imagination, and you are rather evasive.

Those who can tap into the power of the spirit have a natural gift of psychic abilities and could become a medium. Both require proper development to avoid unpleasant experiences.

Those who face the consequences of a past life have the greatest challenge as there is a tendency to sidestep any tasks and become rather lazy. In extreme cases, the use of drugs and/or institutionalization can occur.

In general, this Moon position can often indicate an unusual relationship to your mother or grandmother. As a child you were probably very receptive to her emotional world and remained so even as you developed your own way of life. It is possible that even after the death of a close family member, you maintain a close relationship to this person by way of dreams, mediumistic experiences and visions. Many twelfth house Moon individuals can be very escapist in mood and find themselves literally soaking up the vibrations of others around them. You may then mistake such transferred emotions for your own feelings. You should develop the means to protect yourself against such influences without totally renouncing your sensitivity. Meditation (grounding) is one method that would help you to retain your sensitivity, instead of allowing it to be exploited by others.
planeteMaison.c|1:
With Mercury in this position, there is often a strong inclination to gather information from a variety of sources and to communicate this information to others. You could be a natural spokesperson, spreading ideas and information amongst your fellows. You are lively, quick-thinking, and garrulous, but when you analyze situations you may make the mistake of being too critical of yourself and others. You should carefully assess the zodiac sign in which Mercury is located because those qualities are likely to be enhanced. You like to gain knowledge about yourself, but try to be aware of any excessively self-centered thinking.

Because you have a large amount of intellectual energy, you must try to focus it in a positive way. Blaming others and being prejudicial will limit your potential. Consistency may not be your strong point, but by seeing the bigger picture of things, you will improve dramatically. You may have experienced many changes in your surroundings during childhood, which provided an early opportunity to view the world from many different perspectives.
planeteMaison.c|2:
This promotes an interest in financial dealings, and if Mercury is well placed, you should be able to make money through negotiation. You might work as an agent, a trainer, or hold an appropriate position in business. If Venus is in an air sign, you could be an aggressive salesperson. Your occupation might be linked to the communications or transportation industry, or the distribution of goods. It is also possible that your work is connected to new products and production techniques or is such that you strive to enhance the quality of existing products.

Should your interest in financial advancement be too keen, you may over-commit yourself by making promises that you are unable to keep or deliver. In terms of communication, try to develop your ability to be precise and eloquent, since this will provide you with the rewards you desire. You are capable of expanding your general knowledge and may be drawn to understand the basic material structures of the world. Finding out how things work provides a feeling of security. With greater skill, you will have the talent for making good business deals and to arbitrate in seemingly deadlocked situations.
planeteMaison.c|3:
Mercury's position in the third house is strengthened; this house is assigned to Gemini and Mercury rules this zodiac sign. Mercury's aspects and location in a sign reveal much about the way that you think, learn, and process your experiences. In general, you are rational and garrulous, but when you analyze situations you may be rather critical. You should carefully assess the zodiac sign in which Mercury is located, because this planet is an imitator that adopts certain characteristics from the sign in which it's found. If other planetary aspects to Mercury in this house are challenging, you should ensure that any problems between you and your siblings are cleared up. This will enable you to understand certain behavioral patterns which may have caused you problems. You may have experienced learning difficulties as a child because you have a unique way of thinking which was not in accord with conventional teaching methods.

If you have a tendency for nervous tension, the resultant worry will cause some physical problem(s). If the aspects of Mercury in the third house are not too challenging, you will possess a quick and lively mind which enables you to communicate intelligently. In addition, you probably have a good eye for detail. You can be particularly smart when it comes to presenting your arguments convincingly. There are probably few topics upon which you would not be able to comment.
planeteMaison.c|4:
This indicates a mental activity associated with nurturing, the home, and patriotism. It may indicate that your need for affection and physical intimacy has been suppressed in favor of rationality and reason. One of your parents, or both, was either particularly expressive, eloquent and critical, or simply unreliable. Your spiritual attitude may have been significantly influenced by your father. It is possible that you moved house often at some stage. If Mercury in the fourth house has challenging aspects from other planets, it is possible that domestic arguments and aggravations play a large role both during childhood and later years.

Your sense of nurturing is likely to be strong, and you may have a strong domestic bent. If Mercury is well-aspected by other planets, you may engage in home improvements and you probably like to cook. You prefer to study and work at home, and this may be very influential for any spiritual activity and education. Perhaps you express yourself well among acquaintances, rather than among strangers or in a large group. Your sense of patriotism will be reflected by Mercury's aspects and the zodiac sign this planet is located in.
planeteMaison.c|5:
With Mercury in this house placement of your birth horoscope, you will seek self-realization and a deeper understanding of the world through creative and erotic relationships. Physical impressions help you to learn, think, feel, and communicate. You prefer games which require strategic thinking and intelligence rather than those involving chance. If you engage in sports you may prefer to participate rather than watch because you like to be involved with the team. You will gain a deep sense of fulfillment if you develop your communication skills and your ability to share ideas. You may experience some restlessness and consequently a constant need for change, reflected often in a turbulent love life. The flame of love will certainly burn deeper and longer if your partner is spiritually stimulating.

As a parent, you will focus much attention towards the education and development of your offspring. In general, you should have the ability to get on well with children and young people. More often than not, your relationship with any young child will become much more interactive when they reach an age at which they can express themselves. You greatly prefer a stimulating or lively exchange of thoughts rather than small talk. You have an interest in educational concepts and may be quite vocal about such matters. You may have an occupation that relates to entertainment, leisure, or instruction. Your mind may occupy itself with pleasure, love-making, artistic creation, and/or children. Other effects of this placement include the "thinking gambler," where you are convinced that you possess the technique which will enable you to win. Many people will generally perceive you as being young at heart.
planeteMaison.c|6:
On a practical level, Mercury's placement in the sixth house is strengthened. You seem to be constantly energized by the duties of the day. Hygiene, food, health, and work have a greater focus than for most people. You are highly sensitive to the tensions which surround you, and this may induce unnecessary worry. Should you be prone to anxiety, try taking up relaxation exercises or a form of grounding meditation, which can help counteract any physical and mental overexertion.

The sixth house indicates how you use your time, and with Mercury placed here its effect is more practical. Thus, you may feel more comfortable with certain routine work such as clerical and secretarial. Working in the service of others or with nature is recommended if you have strange illnesses. Often, such problems are the result of insufficient self-esteem or applying yourself in an area that is not suited for you. It is important that you set priorities and try to balance your involvement with the task in hand and time spent with others. Avoid any sort of gossip and seek your own truth. Take reasonable care of your physical senses and remember that an over-zealous drive for perfection is equivalent to frustration!
planeteMaison.c|7:
This placement governs your interaction with others, particularly in partnerships. You like to learn from others and provide the same in return. This is because you enjoy having a good rapport with people, so you might spend some time trying to find out what others think. You have a natural desire to communicate and exchange ideas with as many different types of people as possible. Others who pick up on your energy like to talk to you. Faced with an argument, you may tend to give way rather than endure a long battle.

You not only look for an intellectually stimulating partner, but also one who is consistent in providing this stimulation. Perhaps you encounter a variety of different people who are interesting and have difficulty in selecting a specific one. This is because you find that any one individual is not interesting enough. It could be that you expect a partner to think, talk, and make decisions for you. On the other hand, you may attract people who are unreliable and elusive. Although this may be painful, its side-effect is that you are rarely tied down. Try not to be too critical of the little imperfections your partner may have. Instead, talk your concerns over with your partner in order to gain mutual understanding, and do not forget to maintain a sense of humor. For you, balance is important, and a gift you should already possess or easily develop. If you find yourself obsessed with relationships, it is likely that other planets form a hard aspect to Mercury. On the plus side, you will be able to identify your own needs and those of others.
planeteMaison.c|8:
The keywords for this placement are investigation and discovery, especially of intangible subjects. The eighth house deals with death, regeneration, wills, legacies, taxes, big business, other people's possessions, and crime. Therefore, you will be interested in one or more of these areas-perhaps in assessing, investigating, or researching a particular topic. You like to observe everything that goes on between people, whether in the workplace, at the supermarket, or behind closed doors. Maybe you have chosen an occupation in the world of finance or follow the stock market; perhaps you inVesta your time in psychology or the occult. There can also be, however, a particular interest in the secrets of sexuality and death.

With this placement, there could be certain deep-rooted emotions that are easily aroused by others. A few individuals seem to know exactly how to push sensitive buttons. You experience most things at a deep level and digest your experiences thoroughly. You should be able to stay calm and objective when dealing with things that would frighten others or make them lose control. Make sure of a mutual understanding in any business arrangement and carefully scrutinize any contract with which you are involved, whether verbal or written.
planeteMaison.c|9:
With the planet Mercury in this house, you take a broad-minded approach to things by observing them from a detached perspective. You tend to believe that life and the universe can be understood by their symbolism and the orchestration of basic laws and principles. You may be drawn into investigating various philosophies. You should follow your inclination to expand upon your intellectual ability by studying, reading, or traveling. However, you should take care that you do not over-exaggerate the importance of certain ideas. If you acquire some specialized knowledge, you will enjoy preaching or imparting to others what you have experienced and discovered.

Should Mercury be challenged by other planets, your views may be dogmatic and old fashioned. With Mercury well placed, you may have a flair for languages and seek further education. At another level, you may teach spirituality to others. Many individuals with this placement hold a position linked to publishing, advertising, or the travel industry.
planeteMaison.c|10:
For this planet to operate well in this house, you need an occupation that is intellectually stimulating. Without it, you may find yourself restless and changing jobs often. A position in the media, publishing, or telecommunications might work well for you. If Mercury is in an air sign, professional sales are worth considering. You are talented at solving logistical problems involving society. You can get to know yourself through dedicating yourself to your work and following your instincts. You want to be considered clever, intelligent, and industrious; you enjoy impressing others with these characteristics.

The tenth house is associated with career, ambition, and reputation. Mercury will influence the perception you have of these associations, as well as your attitude about people in authority. If Mercury in the tenth house receives challenging aspects from other planets, you may experience problems with communication and understanding concerning your work and other areas of your social life.
planeteMaison.c|11:
This is the house of friends, clubs, societies, and higher consciousness. The contacts that you make in this area are mental ones rather than emotional. Such intellectual friendships expand knowledge of yourself and the world. The security or enjoyment which comes from being with other people stimulates your learning. The social environment is a source of refreshing ideas from others. You like to ponder the various ways in which the conditions of society could be improved. Whatever the link you may form to a particular group or organization, you consider a group stronger than the individual. Should you hold a position of authority in a group, be mindful of the interests of all group members.

If the planet Mercury in the eleventh house receives challenging aspects from other planets, you may have a tendency to be hypercritical and cynical of the motives of others. On the other hand, too much responsibility may induce mental strain or a slump in your involvement. Should this be the case, try to balance your perception through meditation or prayer.
planeteMaison.c|12:
The imagination and intuition of the twelfth house do not always blend well with the practical and rational energies of Mercury. The key to exploiting this combination is to build a bridge between your conscious and subconscious worlds. In forming this connection with your inner being, take care to avoid becoming too involved with yourself since this could hinder your activities in the real world. You may find a significant benefit in utilizing the techniques of meditation in order to search your soul and determine the forces that influence you. Practicing meditation will also assist in your being more emphatic, decisive, and instinctive.

Some twelfth house individuals can be telepathic, where they either send or receive vibrations more strongly than others. If you are a strong receptor, you may have difficulty in perceiving your own limitations. You may wonder whose thoughts you are actually thinking. Your receptivity to other people's thoughts makes it hard for you to differentiate between your own and those of others. The energies of the twelfth house are not strongly egotistical. If the opportunity presents itself to support other people, you should consider doing so. This may help you become more balanced by allowing for a spiritual focus outside of yourself.
planeteMaison.d|1:
The placement of Venus in this part of your horoscope indicates that you welcome and appreciate with open arms all that life has to offer. You feel quite natural in giving free reign to your sensitivity and appreciation when dealing with other people. You generally find self-reconciliation because you are balanced and adaptable, although there is a danger of being overwhelmed in that you may try to be all things to all people. You want to like others and be liked in return. You must both value and respect yourself if you want to love and understand better those around you. When you recognize your own value, you will be able to recognize the value of others, and if you can accept yourself, you will find it easier to accept other people as they are. If you do not first begin by coming to terms with your own self-worth, you may try to manipulate others into providing you with what you miss in yourself.

Those who have Venus in the first house are often physically beautiful or there is something about them that others find attractive. Even if you are not beautiful in the classic sense of the word, your openness and lovable nature make you pleasant and attractive. If there was a tendency towards idleness during your childhood, you may wait for things to come to you. Some may consider this a sign of being spoilt, so try taking the initiative once in a while. Be aware that if you need excessive flattery, you are most probably vain. With a harmonious aspect to Venus, it is possible that you were able to enjoy a good upbringing which has given you self-confidence and an optimistic attitude on life.
planeteMaison.d|2:
With Venus in this house, you like to make money in pleasant ways. You appreciate it not only because of the security it provides, but because money enables you to buy all the things you find beautiful and important. You have a sense of well-being when you are able to surround yourself with objects that reflect your style. You have an eye for beauty when it comes to material things, but this is not a reason to avoid everything that you find non-aesthetic or inharmonious. By contrast, these things can help you to develop your aesthetic view of the world.

planeteMaison.d|3:

You may need to balance such fondness for this could impede your individual expression. Most people find it easy to relate to you because they sense an atmosphere of caring attention that radiates from you. If you have brothers and sisters it would be unusual if you did not keep up close relationships with them, unless Venus in this house receives challenging aspects from other planets or is retrograde.

Your childhood was probably a happy one, and it is likely that you gained much pleasure learning to read, write, and solve mathematical problems. You feel a need to build up a good store of general knowledge and sometimes have a desire to express yourself through an artistic medium. In doing such, you are helped by your talent to easily adapt to a variety of circumstances and surroundings. You like to discuss romance and enjoy being able to share loving feelings with others.
planeteMaison.d|4:

You are content when you have a comfortable home and can carry out improvements on it. As long as no challenging aspects exist between Venus in the fourth house and other planets, you can expect comfortable living conditions in the second half of your life.

Venus always affects the perception you have of a person or thing you value. For some individuals with this placement there can be, as a child, what is known as an Oedipus complex. Perhaps you belong to the lucky ones whose childhood involved artistic influences.
planeteMaison.d|5:
With Venus well-aspected by other planets in this house, you have a natural desire to express yourself creatively through art. Even if you are not professionally involved in the arts, there are other kinds of creative activity you can become involved with which will help you feel more fulfilled and content. Such creative areas may include artistry, digital typography, graphic arts, etc. In times of stress you can regain your balance quickly if you focus on some creative expression. The motto for Venus in the fifth house individuals tends to be "If I am going to do anything then I'm going to make sure that I do it well." Take care to avoid allowing subconscious rivalry to develop between your children or between yourself and your children. planeteMaison.d|6:

You like to promote harmony in your work environment and will avoid any ugly or dirty work. You appreciate taking care of the routine tasks of daily life because hygiene and health are important to you. Cleaning your teeth can be glorified into a fancy ceremony! Artistic tendencies are focused more towards precise crafts such as needlework, drawing, tailoring, and dressmaking. Try be aware of any of compulsion behavior, particularly as you enjoy tasks that demand a high degree of accuracy.

You gain pleasure from developing and refining your talents and abilities. It is not enough for you just to merely carry out a task, it also has to be done well and look good. You appreciate having a good body, but may be a keep-fit fanatic. Should you suffer health problems despite your efforts, they may stem from nutritional deficiencies or from leading an unbalanced lifestyle. If Venus has challenging aspects in this house, you may be a hypochondriac.
planeteMaison.d|7:
A well-aspected Venus in this house provides you with an ability to project a picture of what you find to be beautiful and lovable to those close to you. It is possible that you feel more lively, happy, and content when you are in a relationship with someone else. You recognize your own beauty and value this quite readily when it is mirrored in somebody else. This is an indication that you have the ability to live harmoniously with others and will have a happy marriage.

If Venus is not well-aspected or not in a congenial sign, the same desires are present, but it is unlikely they will be fulfilled. In such cases, digest the disappointment that you feel and avoid criticizing your partner too strongly. Your relationships will not be one bed of roses after the other, and you should learn that it can take a lot of effort and hard work to make a partnership successful. The seventh house can also describe the social framework in which you circulate, and with Venus positioned here it is likely that due to your love of beautiful surroundings, you would feel particularly at home in an elegant ballroom or something equally as grand.
planeteMaison.d|8:
With Venus in the eighth house you stand to gain through your partner's financial standing or inheritance. Sexual relationships are usually harmonious, but some may prefer to follow a more spiritual path. You enjoy sharing your experiences with others and want them to appreciate a pleasant and enjoyable feeling as well. Opportunities should arise for you to enter into business partnerships, and if favorable, they will make it easier for you to acquire material possessions.

You have the ability to give and take in a way that puts others at ease. Consciously or subconsciously you awaken a need in others to give you something. In such cases, you will need to learn to forgive and let go of whatever it is that binds you.
planeteMaison.d|9:
You may be spared the endless analysis of religious and philosophical subjects because you possess the ability to attain happiness and contentment through the way you view life. You find it uncomfortable to project anything unpleasant into this area. Your perception of God is often a reflection of the age of your soul. Perhaps you are professionally involved in an area that relates to teaching or the use of educational concepts. Your interest in a topic is easily transferred to your audience because you easily find glowing terms to describe what interests you. If you are involved in creative writing or art, your creations will say much about your philosophy and the way that you view life.

It is possible that you will achieve some success in foreign countries and/or with people from abroad. A harmonious Venus aspect in the ninth house indicates that you use tact and diplomacy when dealing with others. However, there can be disappointment if Venus is not well-aspected by other planets. In such cases, you may need to learn not to judge and how best to appreciate someone else's view.
planeteMaison.d|10:
This suggests that you want to make a good impression on the world and be recognized for your charm, taste, and style. You want to dress smartly, and you have an interest in fashion. You appreciate a professional lifestyle and prefer an occupation which gives you visibility and the opportunity to show yourself from your best side. The aspects of Venus may provide an insight into other characteristics which may oppose the achievement of these goals.

Venus in the tenth house can be an indication of a special relationship to your mother, not necessarily without its problems. If you project Venus onto your mother, you may have experienced her as being a person of great style who possessed a strong feminine values. If Venus is not challenged here, you will likely enjoy a good relationship with your parents.
planeteMaison.d|11:
Venus in this house should promote a natural inclination to come together with others in friendly relationships and in group situations. You appreciate the freedom to be involved with groups or organizations and are able to exert a positive influence in any type of group situation, although challenging planetary aspects to Venus in this house can indicate obstacles to this. You have a love of cultural events and of life at the community level. However, you must be careful not to overexert yourself, exhausting your strength.

You like to relate a lovable and beautiful picture of worldly things to a friend or group. Perhaps you only experience a sense of well-being in the right social group where you can see and be seen. You might try to foster your social advancement by selecting particular groups or friends who can be of assistance to you in reaching your goals. You may also be interested in groups or organizations which have set for themselves the goal of improving life in one way or another. You inVesta much energy in friendships or group activities, but you should not be too disappointed if your efforts are not returned to the same degree and friends do not live up to your expectations.
planeteMaison.d|12:
Greek mythology tells us of the strange circumstances surrounding Aphrodite's birth. Saturn castrated his father Uranus and threw the dismembered phallus into the sea. Aphrodite emerged from the white foam which formed on the waves. It may be difficult to accept that the life formation of the goddess of love and beauty was the result of such a gruesome act; but in the twelfth house it is often this metaphor that comes into effect. Sometimes life is made sweeter by experiencing pain, loss, and suffering.

With Venus in the twelfth house, you have an inherent need to get in touch with some force greater than yourself. Venus promotes a love of abandonment, of devoting oneself to something vast and great. You may be striving for an intangible ideal of affection and grace which promises fulfillment or perhaps a rekindling of a long past state of contentment. You will try to quench this desire by seeking such bonding and affection in another person, and you long to dedicate yourself to someone you love. This is not only an indication that you expect too much from one person but also that you have a deep-rooted feeling that it is not enough to love one person alone.

On a practical level, you may find contentment when you are alone or in a quiet, secluded place. Some may be drawn to the theater where you might find employment as a scenery painter, wardrobe mistress, or as a make-up artist. You enjoy mysteries and are attracted to mysticism. Ultimately, you will need to learn to positively integrate your unconscious feelings with those of your surface conscious mind.
planeteMaison.e|1:

You should not fight out your conflicts on a physical level or let your aggression loose on the next best available person. It would be better for you to channel your energies into physical training or sport, particularly the practice of T'ai chi, trance dancing, or Wushu (Kung Fu).

Persons with this placement usually have a strong jaw line. You make an honest, dynamic, and refreshingly open impression. Be sure to act with frankness and conviction. Learn to set your own priorities with enough importance that you do not find yourself playing a role for the sake of gaining attention from others. Being impulsive, you are just the sort of person to jump into life at the deep end. You do not sit around and wait for something to happen, you like to grasp the initiative yourself. It is perfectly acceptable to take what you want from life instead of trying to gain what you want through manipulative behavior. You have a strong desire to control your own fate and are prepared to tackle any obstacles in order to get what you want. If Mars receives some challenges from other planets, certain errors may crop up that lead to much frustration. If you overtax your strength, headaches are likely.
planeteMaison.e|2:
The planets in a house offer an indication of how you can best exploit opportunities in a particular area of your life. With Mars in the second house you tend to act with aggression, self-confidence, and daring as far as money matters and possessions are concerned. You may have to risk something to get what you really desire. Be careful not to act too impulsively and impatiently, since your determination could have a restricting effect on the outcome of your activities. A person with this placement often has a loud and powerful voice.

Mars is the planet of desire, and the second house represents money and personal goods. Therefore, you will have a desire to acquire and enjoy all that the material world has to offer. When you want something, you want it immediately. You are very courageous and willing to take the initiative; you may shine in activities which require these qualities. You will apply yourself and defend the things that are important to you, but take care that you do not force your opinions upon others. You often spend money as fast as you earn it. Money and material possessions may represent concrete symbols to you of your power and strength. Perhaps you emphasize and solidify your zest for life by showing those around you how well you manage to achieve the goals that you have set yourself. If Mars is challenged by other planets, there could be problems associated with possessions. Should this be the case, try to rise above materialistic needs.
planeteMaison.e|3:
This infers an aggressive keenness with respect to educational or literary pursuits. You like to gain the attention of others by projecting your views and opinions. Persons with this placement often have a lively mind and a quick wit. However, you may have some difficulty in expressing your feelings. If your intellect and emotions appear to collide, try to be a little more tactful and aim to strike a balance with rational and sensitive forms of expression. With this placement, there is sometimes the danger of overwhelming those around you with your thoughts, although you are capable of inspiring others into activity. In one way your intellect acts like a sharp knife, and it may be very useful if handled correctly, but if you are careless with it, it can be dangerous and destructive for all concerned. Whatever planetary aspects to Mars exist, it's up to you how you use your intellectual capabilities.

You tend to investigate a number of topics and somehow make them more interesting. You also feel a need to talk about or write down everything that moves you; writing things down helps to release some of your pent up energies. When somebody has annoyed you, it would be advisable to write them an angry letter but do not forget to tear it up before you send it. If you have a tendency for restlessness or suffer from nervous tension, you should try to gain more self-control and perhaps to burn up excess energy through sport. You were probably something of a vigilante in youth, particularly if siblings needed protection. You always seem to be on-the-go and may be perceived as a risk taker.
planeteMaison.e|4:
You work hard around the home and get involved in home repairs and possibly car maintenance. Many people just feel the need to relax at the end of a hard day's work, but you might prefer exactly the opposite--that's when you really get going. Perhaps you develop a great vitality on the domestic front or in your private life. However, this is where your domineering and aggressive characteristics are most readily displayed. You should therefore take care not to let the aggressions that you have built up during the course of the day to be projected onto your loved ones. If you want to release your tensions at home, then do it by digging in the garden or something similar.

This energetic force may initially take on the form of great anger and manifest itself in volcanic outbursts which surprise you as much as those around you. However, if you are too impulsive, there may be difficulties experienced when moving house. A well-aspected Mars will suppress some of these aggressive tendencies, particularly if Neptune is involved.
planeteMaison.e|5:

Provided your intensity doesn't scare off your chosen one, the planetary aspects and constellation of Mars will be influential in the manner by which you pursue romance. You do things in a fiery, dramatic manner. Your natural vitality and enthusiasm (characteristic in everything you do) should be regarded as positive. Even though you are fond of children, remember the song, "I want to be like you dad."
planeteMaison.e|6:

Headaches are an indication that you are directing your pent up aggressions against your own body. There are many excellent techniques for relaxation and meditation, which would enable you to bring more peace into your life if you so desire it.
planeteMaison.e|7:

If you manage to curb your tendency to release your aggressions on your nearest and dearest, you will be able to achieve a state of relative harmony. In addition, the praise from others that you need so badly will not be far behind.
planeteMaison.e|8:
You like to do research, which may involve areas such as finance, insurance, and mysticism. With Mars in this house, it is possible that you will encounter certain feelings like envy, greed, or jealousy in yourself or others. Whether you find it necessary to transform any tortuous emotions into more positive forms of expression depends to a large extent on the aspects of Mars in this house. It would be beneficial to concern yourself with the techniques of relaxation and meditation, particularly as you have a strong interest in the supernatural. However, you should exercise caution when investigating or experimenting with such things.

On the other side of the coin, you may defend your convictions by trying to challenge or manipulate those who do not share your views.

This position of Mars is often accompanied by strong sexual passions, which may be used merely as a means to release physical tensions. Try not to allow it to become a form of competition, in which you would like to feel superior. Lovemaking will have its ultimate expression when made from the heart.
planeteMaison.e|9:

On the other hand, you may prefer to have some justification from a higher source for everything that you do.

If you are a woman, it is possible that you have a strong attraction for a man who came here from a foreign country or that you fall in love with somebody who offers you the opportunity for expansion in one way or another. Foreign cultures could play a major role here. You strengthen your power and position by assimilating knowledge in a few selected areas. Therefore, you may be comfortable in an occupation which has something to do with report writing, publishing, law, or the dissemination of knowledge.
planeteMaison.e|10:
Mars in the tenth house of your horoscope indicates that you are very ambitious. You will expend a lot of energy into each day's work. You want to be regarded as powerful, strong, and self-confident, and you will seek a career which enables you to use and develop these characteristics. Everything you do has to be noticeable, preferably in a positive and honorable fashion. Be careful that your striving for power does not take on thoughtless motives which lead to situations where you feel justified in using any means available to achieve your goals.

If Mars in the tenth house receives challenging planetary aspects, it is possible that you experienced a more turbulent childhood. Perhaps you experienced a parent as domineering and argumentative. 
Your early experiences with this parent will influence the way you deal with your life in later years. You should come to terms with this or you may later experience difficulties with authority figures. Also with this challenge, your attempts for fame and recognition will quite likely cause suffering for yourself and others. If Mars is well-aspected, success and possible fame is likely.
planeteMaison.e|11:
If Mars is well-aspected to other planets, people with this placement often have a keen desire to act in the best interests of friends or groups in general. However, the basic character of this planet represents personal initiative and it may feel ill at ease in the group oriented eleventh house. Thus, you can enthuse about teamwork and cooperation, but you will often experience difficulties in adapting your highly independent views and opinions to those of your fellows in making compromises. This can be dangerous if you ignore the interests of the people around you and try to force your own way. Groups, whose members strongly identify with the group's goals and ideals, are formed on the basis of common interests. If we identify ourselves too strongly with the community, our independence is threatened and the desire to redefine our personal boundaries arises instinctively.

Therefore, it would be a difficult task for you to unite yourself with others who share a common goal without losing your own personality. For this very reason, it would be of immense value if you would try to achieve this task. With Mars in the eleventh house you may also adopt other roles. You may have the ability to stir groups into action. On the other hand, activity within a group or in an organization provides you with the necessary justification to do things that you wouldn't allow yourself to do as an individual. In this way you could make the group carry your personal responsibility. If you engage yourself in a cause which aims to bring about some kind of legal improvement, you should be careful that your warlike approach does not bring about more harm than good.
planeteMaison.e|12:
You are quite secretive and tend to act for the benefit of others in unrecognized ways. In the twelfth house your natural aggression may be concealed by a vague dissatisfaction with life, but nonetheless, it is one to which you may be resigned. Something is wrong, but you are not quite certain what it is. Perhaps you are inclined to sulk and complain about everything. If you refuse to take constructive action, you will remain dissatisfied. However, once you manage to make somebody else express your frustration for you, it is possible that it will then disappear. Your dreams are vivid, so you would benefit greatly by investigating and interpreting them, clearing up a number of hidden problems.

With the planet Mars in the twelfth house, you must constantly reaffirm your authority and your personality. Strangely enough, you sometimes achieve this by subordinating yourself to another person or idea. You are able to replace the egocentricity normally associated with this planet through altruism and a willingness to help. The problem with Mars in the twelfth house is not so much that you lack a fighting spirit, but that you may channel your energies in the wrong direction. Much of this is due to the way in which your energy can build up in the psyche but fail to find an adequate outer expression.
planeteMaison.f|1:
The closer Jupiter is to the ascendant, the more you will probably exhibit a boundless optimism. If Jupiter is well-aspected by other planets, you can be a naturally cheerful and good-humored type who likes to travel. This is a fortunate placement for this planet, providing you with quite a lucky streak throughout life. You have an innate aptitude for philosophy and try to find the answers to life's important questions. Whatever you do, you have the ability to inspire, to awaken an interest in life, and to tackle a new task with enthusiasm. It is possible that you are employed in an environment where you can provide inspiration to others. You are always sure of what is the latest hit, familiar with the newest fashions, and know where you should let yourself be seen. You are a friend of nature and love to climb the highest mountain peak to view broader horizons.

Hard aspects to Jupiter can indicate how your personality might be limited or restricted. Be careful not to develop too high an opinion of yourself. Sometimes you are so convinced that you have numerous valuable and sensational contributions to make, that you cannot keep any of it to yourself. Overestimating yourself may mean that you also overestimate your potential. You may have wonderful ideas and inspiration, but failure can occur with insufficient discipline and concentration. There is also the danger that you will be influenced by the extravagance of Jupiter and lead the life of a risky adventurer or gambler. Should Jupiter be highly challenged, you could be blindly optimistic and overindulgent.
planeteMaison.f|2:
This is an excellent indication for financial success if Jupiter is well-aspected by other planets. You have good business acumen and the resultant motivation probably means that you experience material success. The second house represents what security means for you. With Jupiter is in this house, you may seek security through an excess of material possessions and through acquiring higher knowledge. Strangely enough, you feel at your most secure when you know that you have the freedom to pack up and leave whenever you wish. Your inherent qualities include enthusiasm, the ability to inspire others, and the belief that your life has a practical purpose. It is possible that you believe there is some higher justification when you feel there is something you must have or own. This means that you are never troubled by feelings of guilt when you are trying to satisfy your inexhaustible needs.

If Jupiter is challenged by other planets, there could be financial carelessness. There is a possibility that you will become a servant of the filthy lucre (riches) or that financial and material success could take on near religious dimensions for you. Perhaps you regard money and possessions as a symbol of your own value. As you possess an extravagant streak with possessions and money, you should take care not to spend your hard earned cash too thoughtlessly and quickly. Try to keep a level head as far as investments are concerned, unless you know exactly what you are doing. However, even after a financial setback you have the ability to free up new financial resources quickly. Just as everything seems hopeless you get the saving idea.
planeteMaison.f|3:
If Jupiter is well-aspected by other planets, you can achieve success through education, writing, and communicative matters. If you express your thoughts and words using inspired energy, others will be stimulated, enlivened, and encouraged to more openness. It's possible that you tend to babble away without pausing for breath, that the quantity of your words is more important to you than their quality. Occasionally you take a break to enjoy the effect your brilliant speech has made. Jupiter in the third house also indicates a broadening of spiritual horizons. You fit all the new impressions you collect into your bigger picture and have the ability to see things in their entirety or from a higher perspective. Even when you are concentrating on one particular thing, you do not lose sight of what is going on in the background or in your surroundings.

The planet Jupiter is principally concerned with achieving greater fulfillment. In the third house Jupiter may cause you to feel, on occasion, that knowledge is a responsibility that can provide happiness and security. This may mean that you are driven by an insatiable desire to learn new things. You see life as a giant jigsaw puzzle and are happy when you can find and fit in new pieces. You probably feel a need to travel all over the world to search for additional information. Everything around you gives you the opportunity to grow. It may be beneficial for you to write, teach, travel, and to learn foreign languages. If Jupiter in this house receives challenging aspects, it is likely that you experienced a lot of sibling rivalry during your childhood.
planeteMaison.f|4:
Provided that you are not too tied down by your domestic situation, you will decorate your home very pleasantly, in accordance with the nature of Jupiter in the fourth house. You spend much time and effort on the interior decoration of your dream home, making sure that you leave enough room to move around in it. It might be beneficial for you to leave the crowded city in favor of more natural and open rural surroundings where nothing disturbs your view.

Through your parents, foreign cultures may play a role in your life. Even if this is not the case, your domestic surroundings will inspire you to consider ethical and philosophical questions or to travel. It is possible that you travel from one country to another looking for your spiritual home, and that instead of striving for public or professional recognition, you dedicate yourself to spiritual matters and your own internal growth.

Should Jupiter have challenging aspects from other planets, you may lack a proper prospective on things. If Jupiter in this house receives harmonious aspects, the depths of your spirit will be filled with optimism and trust in life. These characteristics often manifest themselves most strongly in the later years of your life. You probably had a good relationship with your parents, and your present home situation should be pleasant and comfortable.
planeteMaison.f|5:
With Jupiter well-aspected by other planets, you will experience success, pleasure and happiness through all enjoyable means of sport, lovemaking, children, and creative pursuits. You may be good with certain financial speculation such as the stock market, but beware of becoming excessively optimistic. You can be fun-loving and like to make people feel happy. You have a good time being with children-whether they're your own or somebody else's. You like to express your philosophical or spiritual inclinations and feel a certain need to broaden your horizon through travel. You are naturally fond of romantic feelings and enjoy being involved in affairs of the heart. You probably do not find it difficult to pursue love affairs and artistic activities. Provided that you give yourself enough time to digest these experiences and activities, you will find them stimulating and satisfying.

However, if Jupiter receives challenging aspects, it is possible that your own subjectivity and exaggerated enthusiasm distort your sense of perception. If this happens, you may have difficulty starting relationships. Gambling could also be a problem. The fifth house is always involved with the joy of self-presentation, although when Jupiter is situated there, self-presentation is likely to involve a great deal of showing off. You should try to discover the inner principle within yourself by expressing your personal creativity. A degree of playfulness will help you here. The fifth house is also the house of entertainment, and Jupiter is a player. Provided that you are in charge, you are more than prepared to undertake common activities with others. You may consider that your opinion is the most interesting, and when you feel something is right, it is the best thing for all concerned. Even if you borrow an idea or two from one of your friends, you will keep expanding on it and changing it until it becomes, to all intents and purposes, your own.
planeteMaison.f|6:
The sixth house is concerned with health, adapting to the necessities, and coping with everyday activities and routines. With Jupiter well-aspected by other planets, you will experience plentiful and lucrative work. You feel satisfied and content by developing and refining your talents. You are proud of what you achieve at work, which might involve the travel industry or advertising, and you put a lot of energy into carrying out your duties. Although you may be of the opinion that things can only be done right if you do them yourself, your contact with workers will be congenial and beneficial. Should you take on too many responsibilities and abuse your body, you will likely suffer health problems. You seek to find a purpose in life by serving or trying to help others. Whatever manner you choose to spend your time, you always make the best of things.

It is possible that you ardently pursue health matters or strive to remold your body into a better receptacle for your spirit. Perhaps you see illness as the only means of justifying demands for attention. With Jupiter in the sixth house you are more or less forced to grow, expand, and develop in various areas of life. If for some reason you do not manage to do this, your body may react with tensions or begin to show symptoms of illness. Fortunately it will not be difficult for you to understand the symbolic meaning of illness and to incorporate it into the overriding patterns in your life. In the course of your recovery, you may fundamentally change your way of life and your philosophy. As a result, you are in a position to encourage others to look for constructive opportunities for self-help.
planeteMaison.f|7:
With Jupiter well-aspected by other planets, this is an excellent placement for marriage, business partnerships, and professional relationships. This infers that whatever your needs are in terms of maintaining your freedom, you should attract the right partner. You need freedom to get to know all the different facets of life, but you have an equally strong need for security. A partnership for you also means generosity, warmth, creature comforts, optimism and a heightened consciousness. Such a relationship can be quite congenial for both partners.

Should you find relationships to be a challenge, you might need to apply some give and take. Finding the right person who is willing to give you the personal freedoms you seek might also be an interesting task. You should definitely avoid the possessive kind of partner. Some individuals might find themselves swapping roles with their partners in areas such as assertion and personal freedom. The resultant dilemma could prove to be something of a strain. You should try to understand your true needs in a partner and whether or not you really want to commit yourself in the first place. Jupiter also determines the relationship a person has to the society in which he or she lives, and so you may need to guard against becoming too detached. You should not ignore social interaction but view it as a natural way of expanding and enriching your life.
planeteMaison.f|8:
The eighth house has much to do with your involvement with what other people own and transfer, be it possessions, big business, wills, legacies-even sex. Jupiter in this house indicates an opportunity to create wealth using the resources of others. You could come into an inheritance or find yourself in a financially rewarding partnership, be it of an erotic or professional nature. Provided the aspects of Jupiter are not too challenging, you can trust your sense for future market developments. Promote and listen to your intuition when deciding the direction for the development of an enterprise. People respond to your trustworthiness and openness by feeling relaxed and comfortable in your presence. With challenging planetary aspects to Jupiter in this house, you may need to focus on your own resources rather than exploit those of other people. You should also be careful not to allow your strong sexual urges for new experiences to become a principal factor in your life. Try to search your conscience for the motive that drives you in this area.

The eighth house also has an association with mystical matters and rituals. Perhaps you seek a partnership as a way of transcending your own individual boundaries and limitations. For Jupiter, the ritual of sexual intimacy can formulate the fusion of two individuals into something greater than either of the parties could ever achieve on his or her own. On a purely spiritual level, you seek expansion and fulfillment in life by sharing and exchanging your environment and opinions with others who are receptive. You often recognize certain valuable and noble qualities in other people which no one else can see. You like to concentrate on esoteric and philosophical subjects in your search for the meaning of life. You like opening doors that others prefer to leave closed, precisely because the answers to life's great mysteries may lie behind them. You can cope well in a crisis and manage to emerge from periods of tension and change with a positive approach. Such events are opportunities for change and growth.
planeteMaison.f|9:
In mythology, Metis was the Goddess of Wisdom and the first wife of Zeus. When she was carrying Athena, Zeus received a prophecy that he would be deposed by a child of Metis. To elude this fate he engorged Metis, together with the unborn Athena. As a result, Zeus assimilated the highest wisdom. He later gave "birth" to Athena (not coincidentally, she was the result of a splitting headache and sprang fully clothed from his head), becoming not only one of his favorite children, but also the new Goddess of Wisdom.

This story tells much about the way in which Jupiter expresses itself in the ninth house. You like to integrate philosophical and spiritual knowledge and pass it on to others. You may possess the wisdom to see reason and meaning in almost unbearable suffering. You will not rest until you have discovered the laws and wisdom upon which you can further your own spiritual pilgrimage through life. If you can avoid the temptation to lock yourself up inside of abstract thoughts, you will be able to inspire others with your farsightedness and opinions. You see travel and higher education as an opportunity for raising your level of consciousness and for finding meaning in life. If you have always dreamed of undertaking a great journey, you should take heart and follow this dream. A job in the travel industry would suit you, although you would also be well-placed as a teacher, in the judiciary, or in advertising.

Many lecturers and philosophers have this placement, although it is not the only placement. Should Jupiter receive some challenging planetary aspects, your inclinations may be the same but generally unfulfilled. In such cases, try to balance your life through understanding and meditation.
planeteMaison.f|10:
In ancient Greek mythology, there were those who believed that a person who saw Zeus in his full glory would be so dazzled that he would disintegrate into his constituent parts. With Jupiter in the tenth house it is possible that you like to best show yourself off as dazzlingly powerful ruler of some position or other. When you venture out in public, you like all eyes to rest on you! If Jupiter's position is strengthened here, it is an excellent indication for success in worldly affairs, such as professional, business, political, and social life.

You seek to give your life meaning through your career and through attaining status and recognition. Many opportunities are open to you, and whatever job you chose you will approach it with drive and enthusiasm. Your farsightedness and skill make it possible to help other people in organizing their lives. You enjoy working with people but function better when you can give voice to your authoritative side. Your qualities are valued everywhere, and few obstacles should block your path to success. You are in a position to brush aside those which do occur with relative ease. Your attitudes to authority and responsibility may have been shaped during your early years by an important and influential family. If Jupiter is challenged by other planets, you may have some interesting lessons to learn about your role in public life.
planeteMaison.f|11:
One of the duties of the mythological God Zeus is to ensure the well-being of his people. In the same context, the planet Jupiter reminds us to further develop our consciousness for the great social complexes in which we exist. With Jupiter well-aspected here, you have a natural ability to achieve this. You are able to make friends easily and become popular in a club or society. Hence, you can enjoy many good friends and acquaintances. You have a gift in being able to bring people from different cultures together and share the same humor.

Your philosophical understanding will be greatly enhanced through social cooperation. You might have an interest in groups and organizations which have devoted themselves to humanitarian ideals and work towards the growth and expansion of all concerned. Jupiter in this house may ensure that your circle of friends is constantly extended by people from all walks of life. It is possible that you only see your life as meaningful when your agenda is quite full and you can dash from one engagement to another. You may become so involved in your own social activities, or in the lives of others, that there is a danger that you will overexert yourself in some area of your life, which could prevent you from paying attention to other important factors.

Both Jupiter and the eleventh house are associated with expanding personal and group boundaries. Therefore, you should not suffer from a lack of worthy goals, and you may be way ahead of others with your plans-much to the annoyance of your fellows who find it hard to keep up with your suppositions. You should sensibly limit your objectives so that you can fully dedicate yourself to a task. Challenging aspects to Jupiter in this house may be an indication of disappointed expectations, particularly when the group does not succeed in solving all of your problems or rapidly reducing suffering in the world. However, if you are aware of the latest movements and are in tune with progressive trends, you will bounce back looking for a new ideal or a different group, hoping this time to have found the real thing.
planeteMaison.f|12:
At its best, this placement engenders the philanthropist or the spiritual teacher. Many who work in medicine have Jupiter in the twelfth house. In general, you seek happiness in private and are not much concerned with public success, but you can make a good impression among friends. You seem to be one of those people who always has a guardian angel at your side. You are greatly strengthened and encouraged by your deep seated belief in all that is good and meaningful in life, as well as by your openness and readiness to take things as they come. You can turn negative experiences into positive ones. Always thinking the best of people, you may be a genuinely religious person, filled with a natural goodness.

The open universe and spiritual perspective that you seek can be found in the limitless depths of your soul. Certain meditation techniques, or art and music, could be the vehicles that take you there. If you keep focused, you should be able to connect with the forces you seek, although there is a danger that you look everywhere for fulfillment except within your soul. It's possible that you possess psychic gifts and that you volunteer with certain charitable organizations. In times of trouble you take a broad view of the situation, which not only offers you hope and comfort, but provides stability for others.
planeteMaison.g|1:
Of all the houses for Saturn, this can be one of its more difficult placements, particularly if it is close to the ascendant. Saturn is the Lord of Karma, and it often represents restriction or, at best, consolidation. The key to working with Saturn is to focus on its power for consolidation. The First House is the rising sign house and the childhood house. Saturn in this house under stress (square, opposition or inconjunct to other planets), will often reflect a karma with yourself or with childhood. This usually means a lesson with self-esteem, appearance, even vanity. In other words, a personality karma, a character karma, or an identity karma, and especially during childhood, leading to unprocessed experiences. Some of the common experiences, but not always, are the loss of a father or a father who did not provide the necessary parenting for you. There may have been little or no encouragement to develop your ability to express yourself and as a result your creative drive was dampened. You may have been burdened with certain problems that were overwhelming. Many experience a lot of rejection in youth.

You therefore approach life hesitantly, full of mistrust and expect the worst. It seems that you must keep proving yourself, and an element of perfectionism creeps in. You take life very seriously and want to remind people and society of their irresponsibility. Whatever you do does not seem good enough. The resultant frustration drives you deeper into a problematic hole. Although you think that others are constantly criticizing and correcting you, it is really you who is doing it, and your self-criticism is really your biggest problem. Aided by any challenging aspects from other planets, your self-esteem probably has the greatest opportunity in the world!

You perceive your personality as inadequate and your social behavior awkward. As you find it so difficult to be easygoing and relaxed, you may appear to be inhibited, stern, and reserved. You dislike making a fool of yourself and therefore take pains to behave in a dignified fashion. When your fellows start to interpret your inability to trust others as coldness and unfriendliness, it is high time to start to working on that self-love and self-esteem. Basically, you want to prove your worth and be respected, and you should use your strong sense of responsibility to achieve this. You can be ambitious and show an iron determination to make something of yourself. This means that you are prepared to work hard.

Saturn in the first has much to do with taking responsibility for one's actions. You need to get to a point where you can let go of all the negative baggage of the past. Hypno-therapy techniques can be useful for some individuals. If you have any support from other areas of the chart, look to some of those qualities that can contrast the stern and rigid effects of Saturn. Experience more comedy and be open to the numerous techniques that will allow your inner love to radiate in a powerful and consolidated way. The deep pain from youth and the resultant growth can ultimately be used to assist others in a similar predicament.
planeteMaison.g|2:
Saturn is the Lord of Karma, and it also often represents restriction or consolidation. The key to working with Saturn is to focus on its power for consolidation. The second house represents money and worldly goods. If Saturn is afflicted by other planets in this position, it can depict karma with self-worth. You can be mean and thrifty and have anxieties about money and possessions. On the other hand, you may experience a feeling of being unable to deal with money matters and things of value. Even if large sums were to come from another source, you are probably more satisfied with money earned by yourself. However, in times of financial difficulty you will have the necessary drive to develop the necessary means to earn a living. If you were to acquire material wealth and possessions through inheritance or the like, you would very likely still feel insecure. At its worst and in extreme cases, there can be obsessions and insecurity with money and certain goods, personified by the character "Scrooge." However, even Scrooge rose above such problems, the potential of which is in all of us.

The experience here often involves karma concerning money (mostly), value, self-worth, love, or what is important in this life-cycle. There may been too much emphasis on materialism in past lives. On a deeper level, you may not be sure of your own value and have insufficient faith in your ability to deal with the material world. Being agnostic or obsessive with material goods separates you from the real meaning and experience of love. In other words, the spiritual side is of often lacking. Possessive attitudes must go, since they induce worry rather than enjoyment. If you find this to be so in your own life, try to learn to share with others. You do not have to prove your worth with conventional status symbols, such as acquiring a Mercedes, to make friends. When you energize your inner power sources, you will realize that you are a careful planner who acts with tact, stamina, and patience. You will have grown significantly when you develop these characteristics. Wherever Saturn is positioned in your horoscope, you always have the opportunity to overcome difficulties. By developing your own value system, you will find it easier to reach the goals you have set yourself. By learning to deal with the challenges of the material world, you will learn to love life more and more.
planeteMaison.g|3:
Saturn in the third house challenged by other planets sometimes indicates a psychological karma or mental stress if a person is not strong enough to handle the experiences imposed by Saturn's position. Certain communication problems may be evident with brothers, sisters, neighbors, or even in teaching. It is either that you are not heard right by others or you do not perceive the situation at hand correctly. This extends to relating things that are incorrect to other people. You may have made a slow start in school or college, even though you could have been a persistent learner. If there are communication limitations, you may feel lonely. Accordingly, you may not fully participate in any interactions with others, because of your unconscious fear of disappointment and delusion. If communication poses a major problem for you, you may benefit significantly from a special therapy or technique. Gestalt therapy can allow you to address various forms of movement and mobility that were denied to you earlier for one reason or another.

Having to take responsibility for siblings, especially in youth, is not uncommon for persons with this placement. Your insecurity about your own intelligence and ability to communicate may bring about a wide variety of consequences. To compensate, you may try to develop a precise and exacting method of speech and thought, which may manifest itself in a serious and orderly pattern of thinking. You may hide your awkwardness in dealing with matters of the third house by adopting an anti-intellectual standpoint and by condemning others as eggheads or pseudo-intellectuals.

Saturn in the third house should not mean that you are restricted to a life of silence. Difficulties are there to promote your development. You will literally be challenged to develop profound and steady opinions and to perfect your ability to communicate with others. Ultimately, you might discover what a pleasure it can be to learn. Should Saturn be well-placed in this house, you will exhibit caution and common sense in all matters of communication, education, and literary work.
planeteMaison.g|4:
Saturn in this house with afflicted planets can depict karma with the mother, feelings, residence, and general security. The fourth house also signifies past lives, so when someone pushes your button and there is no logical reason why you react the way you do, it could be that your response stems from a past life. Early upbringing could be dull and difficult-or there could have been a disciplined parent with strong moral views. You probably have a strong sense of history and like to learn about such things in the seclusion of your home. There is a tendency to worry somewhat about the home. A strong tie usually exists to your mother-for better or worse.

On a more concrete level, Saturn in the fourth house indicates duties and responsibilities on the domestic front; it may also indicate difficulties in either setting up or maintaining your home, where you are attempting to build up something lasting and stable. It is always worth putting in hard work where Saturn is situated, to consolidate and make the best out of a restrictive situation. It may take some time for you to develop your inner strength and identity, but when you do it will be strong and lasting.

Saturn in this house may present certain challenges with regard to the family. It's possible that you did not feel at ease in your childhood surroundings, that they may have seemed cold, loveless, or in some way restrictive. Perhaps your basic need for love and security was not fulfilled to your satisfaction, and you could not help avoid developing the notion that there was something wrong with you. You need to get to a point where you can let go of all the negative baggage of the past. Hypnosis and hypno-meditation may assist in releasing some of this. Try to be open to the numerous techniques that will allow your inner love to radiate in a powerful and consolidated way. In time, you will be able to discover strength, stamina, and feelings of worthiness within yourself. If you succeed in this, Saturn in the fourth house will become a secret benefactor. Once you have reinforced your sense of self-esteem and value, nobody will be able to take it away from you.
planeteMaison.g|5:
Saturn in this house with afflicted planets could indicate a karma with children, creative endeavors, or with love affairs. It is also connected with pets, personal enterprises and competitive events. Although you take your responsibilities as a parent seriously, you may not be aware that there is some distance between you and your children. Saturn often has the effect of restricting or limiting the energy it combines with, so that which the fifth house represents could be restricted. This limitation could also apply to love affairs and entertainment. Many individuals with this placement find it hard to relax. A few individuals may be sexually puritanical, treating sex as separate from love and affection. Somehow, you need to learn to find that warm glow of love within you and learn to project warmth to others.

You may need to find ways in which you can consolidate your creative expression. There are generally difficulties in giving free rein to your individuality and expressing your creativity. You long to be loved for your originality and uniqueness, but at the same time you sense that it is exactly this originality which keeps others away. Perhaps you have suppressed the playful child within you, one which you were not allowed to show. As a child you only felt loved and accepted when you acted as your parents desired. You did not dare to revolt and were denied your individuality in order to meet your parents' expectations. It is probable that you have directed your energies towards what you "should be" rather than allowing yourself to develop according to your true nature. The discrepancy between the real you and this superimposed identity leaves an unhappy and insecure aftertaste in many activities. It is your challenge to find ways to free your locked up creativity. You should allow yourself to let the hidden and playful child that is buried inside you to come to the surface occasionally.

For example, become involved in that hobby you were not allowed to pursue as a child. This could help you achieve that extra joy in life you need to develop your individuality still further. Try to embrace activities or techniques that will open your heart. Love is the spice of life, and it gives a person the feeling of being important, something special. With Saturn in the fifth house, you may not feel that you are sure enough of yourself to really enjoy such an emotion or to take what you need when it's offered. Fear of rejection possibly means that you are so busy making sure you do not do anything wrong that you cannot relax in such situations. For you, even having a good time can be hard work.

Perhaps you also live with the fear that everything you create is inadequate and find the challenges and restrictions of raising children unacceptable. It would be a shame to avoid having children for this reason because they enable you to see and understand creation at a more intensive level. It would be advisable, however, to carefully consider exactly when to start a family. Note that if Saturn is well-aspected, the effects described here would be largely neutralized.
planeteMaison.g|6:
Sixth house Saturn with afflicted planets epitomizes major karma concerning work situations, health if not maintained, and service due to a lack of activity. You may be very critical of your colleagues or fear that they or your boss do not find you adequate. Saturn in this house can restrict or delay the rewards for expending your talents and abilities. This can be improved in the area of service, but it still tends to be limited. Applying yourself in such a way as to be selective and efficient will allow for better organization of time, particularly for the tasks that offer the potential for greater rewards. The key here is to balance the service-oriented application of one's efforts in relation to the tasks that can yield the best rewards. You will have to work hard to achieve this and be prepared to learn new lessons in life. While many individuals may have a problem maintaining their health, this placement of Saturn seems to amplify the problem. Health also seems to be an issue if you do not dedicate yourself to some form of service to others. Petulance and worry may further compound your well-being. Most of your anxiety is connected with health and work insecurity. There is a tendency towards stomach and back problems.

You should treat any symptoms of illness as symbols or messages from your body trying to point something out to you, encouraging you to change the way you live your life. You should try to balance your physical, mental, and your spiritual well-being. Be careful to avoid excessive inflexibility or anxiety. Face up to your problems; it will not only make you stronger but also wiser. Your constant need to organize your surroundings may, however, indicate fear and a mistrust of life, which should be recognized and analyzed. As a conscientious worker, you are well able to finish a task correctly, but you may be obsessed by detail. You must not expect others to work as hard or to grasp the essential details as you do. Without any challenge imposed on Saturn, much of this description will be neutralized. If Saturn is well-placed, you probably have organizational and administrative talents as well as a good eye for detail.
planeteMaison.g|7:
Seventh house Saturn with afflicted planets would epitomize lessons in love or relationships. A lack of balance between you and partners indicates another type of karma too. Some of the problems that can manifest here relate to an obsession to get married, but then finding yourself in divorce, cycling back to marriage again and then divorce. Much of this may be due to a tendency to marry for security--rather than love. Hence, you may get married to an older person. A persecution complex would be an indication of a heavier kind of karma. Such difficulties in relationships with others is precisely what demands examination and development from you. You might try to evade the issue by maintaining that you just haven't met the right person, or you might complain about the shortcomings of your partner, putting all of the blame on him or her. Instead of always blaming others, you should examine the reasons for this frustrating situation by looking first at your own issues.

The position of Saturn shows where you will experience inhibition, restriction, and fear. Some examples would be going to any length to avoid committing yourself because you are afraid of becoming too involved with somebody. Perhaps you fear the sacrifices that might have to be made and want to avoid dependency at any price. It might be that you are afraid of getting hurt and will not allow others to get too close. If any of the above apply to you, it would be beneficial for you to examine earlier relationships to uncover the cause(s) of these apprehensions.

It could be that your relationship with your parents was problematic, and you have convinced yourself that they do not love and accept you. Persons with Saturn in the seventh house may have been subjected to influential people (perhaps a parent), who dampened their "perception" of being able to live happily with someone. There is always the possibility of learning from their mistakes, so people with this placement should continue to persevere. Be aware of these problems, for on the way to finding conflict resolution strategies you should be in a position to find out much about your relationships and life in general.
