The reward for such effort with Saturn is consolidation. As a result, you could marry somewhat later in life and yet find contentment in a relationship even at a great age.
planeteMaison.g|8:
Eighth house Saturn with afflicted planets would show a major lesson in life concerning sensitivity, deep emotions, love, sex, intimacy, or the inability to transform and change. It's often easy for these people to be celibate as their focus lies elsewhere. You may experience conflict in sharing your financial means with others and in making the compromises that a close relationship demands. Getting too wrapped up in somebody else would mean the end of your isolated personality. This may initially be a terrible idea to you, because you set store on the things that you own and certainly don't want to give anything up. You may have a partner whose convictions and values differ or contradict your own. Alternatively, you may choose a partner who is in some way a burden to you. However, it may just be that caring for someone else is what you need for your own personal development.

Others may perceive you as having restricted emotions. Consequently, you may find it difficult to interact with them in a relaxed, open, and warm manner. Getting to the root of these problems would help you to discover your true self. You may need to be more open in order to find out who and what you are. This is one way to deepen your knowledge and form your personality. Some individuals may experience difficulties with legacies, either from the family or from an event in earlier years. You can be strongly disciplined, particularly if there is a quest for monetary security. Your determination can make you proficient at holding your own in negotiations. There may be some fear, obsessions with death, or problems dealing with others dying. Some individuals take religion very seriously and may hold dogmatic views. If Saturn holds any limitation as described here, your desires should be transformed into soul growth by way of meaningful rituals involving group and partner relationships. Without any major challenges imposed upon Saturn, much of this description would be neutralized.
planeteMaison.g|9:
Ninth house Saturn with afflicted planets would show karma concerning philosophy, religion, justice, travel or lack of it. There may be certain difficulties both in planning and traveling on long journeys. Although you tend to take philosophy and religion very seriously, you may hold dogmatic views. Much of this occurs due to a fear of stepping outside comfortable boundaries. Such problems usually stem from the fact that your early interests were not encouraged, and perhaps you grew up in conventional religious surroundings, causing you to form your own strict conscience. It may have been drummed into you that there are set rules and regulations which tell a person exactly how to live. As a result, you have a subliminal sense that breaking these rules would bring disaster.

Perhaps you take an agnostic view and skeptically and cynically look at everything that appears to be governed by some higher system because you fear it. You only believe in what you see, feel, and can examine. It might be advisable for you to try to have an open mind in an attempt to make higher truths more tangible and understandable. You should have no fear of your own possibilities and overcome your reluctance to take risks. With a positive outlook you can maneuver your way through doubt and hesitation in order to reach your goal.

If you have an occupation that involves a good deal of traveling, you might not feel at ease on your journey. You are not keen on going a long way just to wait and see what happens next. You find it more comforting to have the future planned in advance. You probably take philosophy and education rather seriously, and you might always feel guilty if you wanted to and did not go to college. Without any challenge imposed on Saturn, much of this description will be neutralized. If Saturn is well-aspected, you are capable of serious concentration and can obtain good results. There is a tendency to feel happier by middle age. This placement suggests that you are not very sporty, and although you can be critical of others, you could also be a good teacher.
planeteMaison.g|10:
Tenth house Saturn with afflicted planets would show karma concerning the external aspects of life. This could include one's practicality, career, authority, and ambition. It is important that you develop humility, for if you build a life based on power and prestige without compassion and integrity, you will fall hard. It is also possible that you become depressed and take on more than is good for you, experiencing delays and obstacles as a result. Dangerous situations can arise if you feel that all means are justifiable to reach your goals, and you start to exploit others for your own advantage. It's also possible that some individuals with this placement rebel against an exaggerated dependency on society's moral system of values by breaking these rules. Because you feel the pressure for social adaptation so strongly, you revolt against it. You might have experienced a parent as a burden for which you were and may still be, responsible. If not, you may have lacked a father figure in youth.

President Nixon had Saturn and Pluto in the tenth house. His false accusations of competing candidates led to false accusations being directed at himself-along with his fall from power. The position of Saturn in its own house means it exercises strong influences. Whether you believe it or not, you are exceptionally sensitive about how others see you. You want to be seen as strong and reliable-even durable. You feel a need to achieve recognition and status in a respected profession. You may place too much emphasis on measuring success by following traditional values. Take care not to spurn people who dare to live outside the normal conventions of society. You will probably have to work hard to gain the respect and status you desire. With careful planning, you should be able to achieve your professional goals one step at a time.

Without any challenge imposed on Saturn, much of this description will be neutralized. If Saturn is well-aspected, it is possible to attain a position of prominence in society. In youth, you may have had a parent or someone else who acted as a model for Saturn's positive characteristics of patience, discipline, stamina, and determination. As a result, you tend to be ambitious, self-reliant, and independent.
planeteMaison.g|11:
Eleventh house Saturn with planets under affliction would epitomize karma concerning groups, friends, goals, organizations, and social direction in life. Persons with this placement often lack real friendship, humanity, and an ability to concentrate on objectives. In such cases, it could take some effort to develop the characteristics needed to be a good friend. Avoid being too stiff and formal in your dealings with new acquaintances. Your inhibition may be due to not wanting to put your foot in it or a fear of being exploited by the other person. Perhaps you perceive friends as a burden or restriction, that they require too much responsibility from you. If you feel lonely and isolated because you do not think you have enough friends, you should try to break down the barriers that create inhibition. This also holds true for your relationships with groups or organizations. Although you may not feel at ease in group situations, they are the best place to learn about yourself and others. Even if it is a struggle for you, you should learn to cooperate with others. After all, you too have your contribution to make to further the development and evolution of society. If you are patient and have stamina, you can reach your goals step by step. Success will not drop into your lap, but you will eventually find it.

By nature, Saturn can have a mixed influence in the eleventh house, in that there is an urge to consolidate this energy (social conscience) through groups or organizations. There could, however, be some limitations if personal barriers get in the way. On the one hand, you may feel drawn to all that offers you security and status, and yet the idea of opening up and breaking down your carefully constructed boundaries fills you with fear. The planet Saturn in the eleventh house may mean that you feel a strong need to join forces with others and to become a member of a group or circle of friends, but you may find such situations uncomfortable or threatening. Make sure that you do not shun social contacts, for this would deprive you of the opportunity for development in this important area of life. The friends you may feel most comfortable with are probably older than you. If lessons mentioned here are learned, there can be great rewards later in life.

Without any challenge imposed on Saturn, much of this description will be neutralized. If Saturn is well-aspected, you could play a responsible and lasting role in clubs and social organizations which have a serious purpose. To obtain goals, you need to be patient and work hard.
planeteMaison.g|12:
Twelfth house Saturn with afflicted planets would epitomize karma with oneself, in that you are your own worst enemy. It is a very emotional karma, indicating self-destruction and an afflicted subconscious. This placement has much to do with lessons concerning emotions. You may brood silently over lost opportunities. There can be difficulties from unknown people, institutions, and hospitals. You may sense some responsibility that is hidden away. You may have a fear of all that lies beneath the surface of your consciousness. You feel that you could be swallowed up by overwhelming feelings if you let go of the strict control you have over yourself. The idea of becoming involved with something greater than yourself makes you uneasy. The thought that your individuality could disappear fills you with fear. Due to isolating yourself from others in previous lifetimes, there is an unconscious desire to make restitution, but it is often consciously rejected. Should you decide not to serve humanity in some way, it is highly likely that you will suffer chronic health problems. If you feel that you can break down these feelings of guilt through providing service to others, you may choose an occupation at a hospital, a charitable organization, or any institution which is concerned with serving the needy.

More often, it is not somebody else who is trying to make life difficult for you, it is you who makes life difficult for yourself. If you continue to isolate yourself in an attempt to forget your dreams, you should perhaps try shore up your self-esteem because only then will you find an inner peace and be able to sleep peacefully again. You may feel that you can only develop your independence by withdrawing from the company of others, or you may fear that everything you do will end in disaster. If you experience these fears in terms of commitments to people, you should carefully unveil and examine your subconscious need to flee. Dissolving the fog and recognizing your purpose will provide rich rewards. Not only will you find subconscious or forgotten aspects to your personality, but you will also develop a feeling of oneness with the world. In the end, the positive characteristics of Saturn will emerge-an ability to recognize your own limitations, an acceptance of duties and responsibility, and a tangible, practical sense of how to help out in a difficult situation.

In conclusion, Saturn in the twelfth house infers a serious confrontation with all areas of your subconscious being; it is very important to find your own truth. Without any challenge imposed on Saturn, much of this description may be neutralized. If Saturn is well-aspected, you could play a responsible and satisfying role in providing assistance or service to others.
planeteMaison.h|1:
Your personality will tend to be out of the ordinary, particularly if Uranus is close to the ascendant. You are the sort of person who wants to discover things in your own individualistic, original, and freedom loving way! Because you are focused on concerns of the mind, you may pay little attention to appearance. As an exceptionally original and inventive human being, you are able to develop new perceptions and ideas in all areas that interest you. Many will be drawn to the field of science if the remainder of their chart supports this. You will need to act upon, not resist, instinctive desires that lead to self-discovery of your essential nature. You may be suited to a position of leadership, particularly as you do not enjoy playing a subordinate role.

If Uranus is challenged by other planets, you could be quite eccentric, and others will find it difficult to live with you. You seem to want to change or alter your course in life at a moment's notice!

You need considerable personal freedom in order to find yourself. Most people develop their sense of self by contrasting themselves to other people, i.e., wife, father, child, boss, or lover. With Uranus in the first house, these traditional collective aspects of identity are for you. Peer-to-peer relationships suit you well. It is possible that you always have the feeling you could be something different or better, and this feeling may present problems in clearly defining your own personality. Basically, you are happier if you are left in peace; you do not like interruptions. There is no point in trying to change that in you. You are not prepared to live according to conventional rules and patterns, and instantly you see through anything false or restrictive. Be careful not to shock society too much!
planeteMaison.h|2:
You may earn money in unusual ways, or there may be irregular fluctuations in income. Some individuals will experiment rather creatively with the acquisition of money and objects. People with this placement often have an urge to break free from any value system, lifestyle, use of resources, or circumstances that restrict or inhibit their personal development. If you do not achieve this independence, there could be major upheavals which threaten your finances. If you are not aware of your inherent need for freedom, you may seek situations in life that appear to offer security but turn out to be unreliable. In the event of changes in personal security, you will find new resources that will provide this necessary security and allow you to evolve.

Because you have a great deal of originality, are inventive, and open to new trends, you quickly understand things and are able to sum up a situation. If you foster these inherent talents, you should be successful in life. Should Uranus receive challenging aspects from other planets, there could be financial difficulties through unexpected changes.
planeteMaison.h|3:
You seem to experience interesting and unusual events while traveling within your local domain. This may be due in part to the fact that you like to do your own thing and want to understand your immediate environment. You are inventive, original, and capable of intuitive thought. You perceive your surroundings differently from other people. There is often a restlessness in your search for knowledge, and you may have eccentric ideas about education. Many of the subjects that you are interested in are out of the ordinary. You may have had some unusual relationships with relatives or siblings or experienced some form of separation. Perhaps you grew up in an uneasy atmosphere and had to move house or school frequently. You may have felt isolated from those around you or felt that you were different even at an early age.

You may possess a relaxed and clear manner of thought which enables you to quickly find solutions to problems. Sometimes your ideas are ahead of your time, as can be said of Albert Einstein who had Uranus in the third house of his birth horoscope. You want to investigate as many facets of life as possible and require plenty of room to maneuver. Sometimes you change your ideas so quickly that others are left confused and helpless. Be careful not to overexert yourself. If you do, it would be beneficial for you to learn meditation or relaxation techniques, which enable you to handle your energies more constructively. People with this placement have a need to break free from the restlessness and tension of life; they need to harmoniously integrate left and right brain thoughts concerning the physical world. If you gain an understanding of the oneness of things, you should be able to effectively communicate your inspirational thoughts.
planeteMaison.h|4:
People with this placement often feel that they miss out on opportunities if they put down roots. It is as if there is always a better or more suitable place within striking distance. Any unconventionality will probably be expressed in later years when you discover an interest for metaphysics, philosophical or political questions. At a certain stage in your life you will probably participate in activities that serve society in general or promote its development. If Uranus is well-aspected by other planets, you probably had an exciting and attractive family background. If not well-aspected, there might have been difficulties with family.

In general, you may have experienced an unusual childhood or a notably eccentric parent, and your life is probably not dependent on the traditional biological family unit. You may have an urge to remain free of commitments to either home or community and often need to break free from the feelings that compel you to belong to a particular person or place. Only when you are free to be at home with your true feelings will you be able to connect with the oneness of life and the universe. You may behave very restlessly on this search for your true spiritual home or family, and to accomplish this you will require a lot of space and freedom.
planeteMaison.h|5:
This can indicate an exciting or unusual social life. The same may be said for recreational pursuits and your love life. You seem to be torn between what your ego dictates and an involvement in socially relevant causes. You should free yourself from traditional or conventional methods of expression and let your creative personality flow into everything you do. You have no alternative but to be original and unusual. Sometimes inspiration hits you like a flash of lightning. Perhaps you are never satisfied with what you achieve and feel that you could have done it even better. Some individuals may develop an interest for things which others see as eccentric or strange, and you often become involved in unusual love affairs. When the initial excitement and enthusiasm has died down or you feel restricted, you look for a reason to end the relationship. Invariably, they end as suddenly as they started. Perhaps you should learn that you have to make compromises in relationships in order to form lasting attachments. It is pointless just to act out of lust.

With Uranus in the fifth house you look for alternative ways of expressing yourself. Your need to create will not be fully satisfied even if you have children. If you try to cling to your children or make them live out your own missed opportunities, they will respond by leaving home as early as they can. Uranus in this house will challenge you to find ways of expressing your creativity other than through having children. It is only when you can be free to consciously attune yourself to a higher source of creativity, that you can allow the egocentric sense of identity and purpose to be empowered and directed by this source. Once empowered, your life and vision can transform others through a powerfully creative and inspirational energy.
planeteMaison.h|6:
Your approach to work and earning a living is generally carried out in an unconventional manner. You are not suited to a career as a civil servant with a daily routine from nine to five. You are not inspired to work simply out of a need for security or a sense of duty. You want an intellectually challenging job where you can be stimulated in the tasks you have to carry out, and you should seek a form of employment which demands change, variety, inventiveness, and freedom of movement. It is also difficult for you to hold a subordinate position because you like to tackle problems in your own way, even if nobody has ever done it like that before. Generally speaking, you do not like being restricted by petty nuances and trapped by routine. You are somehow driven to make life more interesting and exciting. Your life may go easier for you if you become aware of which things are worth changing and then go about changing them in a way that is comfortable for you.

With Uranus in this house, you have an opportunity to break free from irritability with others and perfectionism (thinking that you are not pure enough). You must first, of course, discover that changes to your inner self will in turn change external matters. If you do not learn to control your impatience and irritation, you will quite likely suffer ill health. Once those with this placement learn to promote their self-purpose to others, there can be special healing abilities. If you do suffer from illnesses, they are likely to be very unusual, but they will respond to unorthodox methods of treatment.

Your interest in the relationship between mind, body, and soul should allow you to take a closer look at the many diverse forms of alternative healing. Occasionally you experiment with unusual diets and various programs of physical exercises. Try to avoid the tendency to overexert yourself and work at becoming less tense and agitated, so as to increase your physical resistance. You will benefit from every activity that helps you to relax physically. Various relaxation methods such as yoga, meditation, and T'ai chi would be a beneficial addition to your daily routine.
planeteMaison.h|7:
A common effect of Uranus in the house of relationships is the need for independence or an independent marriage. However, many individuals with this placement may find it hard to find someone who is willing to give them the freedom they require. Given this, you may experience a series of broken engagements. Your attitude towards others extends beyond conventional boundaries. Many people form and maintain a relationship because they seek security or are driven by a sense of duty. You would suffer greatly in a rigid partnership for whatever reason it is maintained. Unless a relationship is creative, enthusiastic, open, and honest, you will probably end it and look for something new.

If you are in a relationship where your partner cannot accept your internal restlessness or your need for unconventional structures in life, you should try to create an atmosphere in which both of you can openly express your feelings and moods, without the other taking it too seriously. Both of you must realize that each is an individual who needs independence and that neither of you are there solely to fulfill the needs of the other. Maintaining this perception requires a great deal of maturity, and you will probably have your best relationships when you are older and wiser and know yourself better. Hence, some of the lessons for Uranus in the seventh house include learning when to give and receive and stopping comparisons of oneself to others. You must effectively listen to others in order to identify and empathize with the true needs of yourself and others. If necessary, try to purify your motives in all of your activities.
planeteMaison.h|8:
You may receive money in unusual ways and have unconventional ideas about life, sex, and death. Your feelings may be erratic, but they are often stirred by passions like desire, jealousy, anger, envy, and revenge. You may show a determination to break free from certain instincts and overcome the feeling of being ruled by such emotions. In such circumstances, you will place yourself in challenging situations, where you are forced to rise above your instincts to achieve a tolerance and freedom of thought which does not engender such confusing feelings.

Some individuals with this placement like to explore the deeper meaning of our existence and discover the hidden forces of nature that govern life. You may be interested in such things as astrology, psychology, or other esoteric subjects. You may also have strong psychic feelings. On a more physical and less spiritual level, there may be sudden changes in your life. You could come into an inheritance or embark on a new business partnership. Individual phases in your life may come to an abrupt and final conclusion in that it seems that one chapter is ended and a new one is started overnight, due to some unforeseen occurrence that will change your life dramatically. Accidents can occur if you drive while angry. You need to free yourself from earlier conditioning in order to reach a higher level of self-awareness and security.
planeteMaison.h|9:
With Uranus in the ninth house, there tends to be a preference for vacations that are off the beaten track and away from the crowd. For you, travel broadens the mind. You could be quite liberal-minded in an anarchist sort of way. You may find yourself searching for deeper truths in a religious or spiritual sense and not altogether taken with conventional or orthodox views. You seek to find your own meaning in life or discover an ethical and philosophical system which can bring order to your life. In your search for this order, you will continually shed earlier indoctrinations and opinions. You often have unusual and unexpected experiences while traveling. Such encounters can awaken or inspire you towards new realms of thought and action.

You may have a reformist view on education, and on a personal level will most likely seek an alternative to conventional academic studies. Even if you follow traditional study, you may decide on the spur of the moment to change your area of study at various times. If Uranus is not challenged by other planets, you could have a remarkable sense for future developments. The placement of this planet here often invokes a desire to study metaphysics and religion. However, any excessive mental activity may cause some strain. This is because you need to learn how to break free from an excessive right brain focus which can lead to fatigue or stress of the intuitive mind. Once you learn to balance right and left brain thinking, you will be better able to both deduce and intuit truths in life.
planeteMaison.h|10:
If Uranus is well-aspected by other planets in this house, you want to bring original and progressive ideas out into the open. Your unique individualized nature allows you to live in the present and be involved in new things that affect the future. If there are sufficient planetary placements in the cardinal signs of Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn, you will likely start your own business. You do not want to be regarded as an average person but as someone who concerns him or herself with change, rebellion, or renovation. As the tenth house is the natural sphere of the sign Capricorn, you should be able to translate new ideas and opinions in an understandable way.

However, if your creative self-expression is suppressed, you will feel discontented and suffer inner tensions. In such cases, you will change jobs often in search of greater freedom. Try to develop an awareness of the difference between natural universal laws and man made laws. This will assist you in freeing yourself from conditioning and/or judgments that have been projected upon you. In time, you will be able to understand your real identity. Try to be more aware of the implications and long-term effects of radical political change. It would be of great benefit for you to take a closer look at the many forms of relaxation, since it would be useful for you to tackle certain things in a more relaxed manner.
planeteMaison.h|11:
Uranus in the eleventh house tends bring out the Bohemian in a person; you are unconventional and like to separate yourself from the group. This planet is in its natural house here so its effect is strengthened. The extent to which your relationship with others is erratic will largely depend on the manner in which Uranus is aspected by other planets. Should there be challenging aspects, you may stand for rebellious ideas or ideas which might be considered fringe by others. You tend to assert your independence within a group and argue with members about fundamental questions. You may expect too much from others and feel frustrated when they show a lack of social conscience. You seem to have a knack for shocking people, but your subconscious desire is to awaken them from their limited and mundane way of life. You could have a misplaced identity towards the place or country in which you were born, and this will be particularly so if Uranus is inconjunct (150 degrees) to a personal planet in the fourth house or challenged by the Moon.

Since the eleventh house is the house of group activities and social conscience, you may have a special bond with humanity and view the entire planet Earth as one big tribe which should concern itself with solving its problems and conflicts. You abhor religious and cultural indifference and long to be part of a society that dedicates itself to common goals and ideals. Your utopian values may encourage you to engage in a mental rapport with others who are receptive, provoking others into a discussion about solving the world's problems. Life should be rather interesting for you, but with the erratic energies of Uranus involved, it will be rather difficult to predict. You should try to balance and re-channel any erratic energies of sympathy and antagonism towards useful and productive action.
planeteMaison.h|12:
This placement can enhance intuition; for some it can enhance an egocentric nature. Unusual ideas seem to spring from your unconscious mind. You have access to many areas of your subconscious being and hence also have access to a wealth of experience. As with all gifts, however, it is important to develop such talents with spiritual training like meditation. Thus, you will gain a deeper understanding for the evolutionary processes and structures that determine our lives.

If there are hard aspects to Uranus from other planets in this house, you may experience disruption in your thoughts and dreams. It could be that harsh vibrations in the atmosphere easily disturb you. Certain opportunities seem to evade you because you might be too concerned with giving up your independence. It is as if you destroy any opportunity before you are able to grasp it. There is often a tendency with this placement to over-identify with this or some other aspect of your nature. You may know what isolation really means, but how you react to it will depend on the overall configuration of your birth horoscope. You may have an unexpressed fear that while shedding your limited and limiting ego, you may lose control; your mind seems to consume itself with certain thoughts. It is very important to get in touch with your higher self through hypnosis and meditation in order to be able to live in the present and mold your future.
planeteMaison.i|1:
If the planet Neptune is within eight degrees of the Ascendant, the characteristics of this planet will be significantly increased. In addition, any other planetary aspect will play an important influence. When a planet in the first house is close to the Ascendant it is referred to as a rising planet. Marilyn Monroe had Neptune rising in Leo. In a well-aspected chart, your strong imagination will work well for you in art, literature, and your chosen profession. Others may see you as a saint or an angel, admiring your sense of compassion. You could be clairsentient, which means you can actually experience the feelings of another beyond your own feelings. While your empathic gifts are strong, they will require development.

In a challenging position, Neptune will tend to defuse your personality so that you may appear indecisive. Should this be of concern, you should slowly and carefully develop a well-integrated personality and strive to have a clear direction in life. Perhaps a saintly Scorpio or someone with a transformed Pluto factor will assist you in this regard. However Neptune is affected, its placement here will enhance sensitivity and create high ideals. You can easily lose yourself in a world of imagination. There is often a strong psychic sensitivity which usually manifests as confusion until you evolve in certain spiritual terms. You tend to mold your identity on what others want and expect from you. If nurturing love and harmony was denied in your early years, you may spend your whole life looking for this complete harmony with another person, and you may change yourself to suit person after person to achieve a part of it. The problem is that nobody can really be enough for you if you are not enough for yourself.

One way to make use of this Neptunian energy is to reveal collective feelings and pictures through some artistic expression. These visions allow you to inspire people who cannot access such formless dimensions so easily. Neptune's broadness and depth enables you to sense what others are feeling and to give them support. Perhaps you will dedicate your whole life to saving and comforting others.
planeteMaison.i|2:
Here, Neptune expresses itself normally in two very distinct ways. You may have a high degree of freedom with money, or you may be idealistic and vague about money. There is either honesty or deception, and should the latter be true, you can experience losses through theft, fraud, and deception. Subconsciously, you may experience some guilt if you acquire wealth or cling to material possessions in the belief that what belongs to you belongs to everyone. On the other hand, you may also have the feeling that the world is there to look after you and that which belongs to others is also there for your convenience.

With Neptune in this house you are challenged to gain a deeper understanding of financial matters, durable goods, and other similar means. Whatever its placement in the horoscope, Neptune has a dissolving tendency, and in the second house all material and physical forms of security may be subjected to this influence. Any discontent you have with material possessions may compel you to acquire more. Perhaps you feel that money and possessions offer the key to a castle of dreams, or you consider that money is important because it enables you to pursue your fantasies. However, sooner or later you will discover that material riches cannot provide with what you are looking for-something is always missing. Rather than seeking riches within the physical world, you should seek security and well being in yourself. Only when you can tap into higher spiritual levels, will you find fulfillment.
planeteMaison.i|3:
With Neptune in this house of your horoscope, your mind can be used for creative expression or writing. Such presentations can be imaginative, and if other indicators promote it, you may write poetry. If you find it difficult to concentrate on academic work, you will need to apply discipline in order to do well. By encouraging yourself to think clearly, you should be able to develop a great understanding of the subconscious forces and subtleties within your surroundings. Because you are not particularly fond of the traditional methods of communication, you are more comfortable expressing yourself through dance, poetry, song, or other forms of imagery.

Neptune in the third house can sometimes indicate karmic obligations with relatives that need to be reconciled. You may have been shy during your early years, and you may have had to make many sacrifices during your childhood. Perhaps a brother or a sister had difficulties, and you had to be particularly sensitive to him or her because you may have felt responsible for everything that went on in your immediate surroundings. This placement is often seen in the charts of those who possess the ability to work and communicate in a special way with children who have learning difficulties.
planeteMaison.i|4:
This often indicates a close spiritual link with a parent or grandparent. Your childhood years are very influential, causing you to reminisce about the good old days. You enjoy the seclusion of your home, particularly if someone is around who shows tenderness towards you. Part of your personality may be too entrenched in the security of the family structure, and this can suppress your personal identity and limit your freedom. It is important in such cases to establish inner security based on reality and not on imagination. The price you pay for choosing family security over inner security will take shape in the form of sacrifices on the domestic front. In some cases, the family scene will be displaced by a special group or commune. If and when you are ready to do so, you should bring the subconscious indoctrination of childhood to the surface of your consciousness. Then you can bring about personal change. Although the public world may not be a focal point for you, it is important to carefully select the surroundings where you live-which may be near water.

You might consider pursuing psychic or psychological studies because taking a broader view of the world would be favorable to your development. It may be gratifying for you to offer your home as a meeting place for meditation groups or for groups of artists and musicians. If Neptune is not well-aspected by other planets, strange goings on to do with the home are kept secret. There could be misunderstandings with family and parents. There may be a disordered domestic life where you have unrealistic expectations of other family members. If Neptune receives harmonious aspects, you may have experienced a parent as a soft, sensitive individual of great feeling with a sense for poetry and romance. You should not idolize this parent too greatly, or you could be disappointed later in life when you come to see him or her more realistically.
planeteMaison.i|5:
You possess a lively and varied imagination and enjoy losing yourself in recreational pursuits. You like living in the fantasy world of romantic novels, science fiction, movies, etc. Your creative talent is often connected with the ability to express feelings dramatically or demonstratively. On the other hand, certain surroundings could force you to become what others need and want, rather than what you would choose for yourself. If both are true, you should compromise and provide what is necessary for others without worry, yet with sincerity. Exploiting these characteristics will bring you happiness and fulfillment in life.

Sacrifices may be required in which you have to give up an artistic focus in favor of a more balanced and stable existence. On the other hand, you may place your secure existence on the line in favor of an artistic career. Regardless of whether or not you are currently involved in an artistic occupation, you will gain much pleasure from your creative love affairs through which you can express your feelings and rich fantasy life. You are quite romantic and may idolize your lover. It is possible that you are vulnerable to falling in love with someone who is unattainable and may find yourself adoring and observing the chosen one from a distance. As the fifth house also includes the fun side of sex, you may have secretive sexual adventures if there are frustrations in your long-term relationships.

If Neptune in the fifth house receives awkward planetary aspects you may feel fated to suffer as a parent by having to make sacrifices for your children. It is possible that you idolize your child or glorify him or her as an important figure. You should allow your child the freedom to develop his or her inherent gifts and to live his or her own life. The spiritual growth offered to you by experiences with children is of great importance. The area of life in which Neptune is situated can sometimes indicate a type of suffering which has a sedating effect on you. Although this may not sound too positive, it should be mentioned that the experiences which involve suffering allow us to grow. Neptune in this house is also related karmically to needing to dissolve selfishness from a past life by being kind to others.
planeteMaison.i|6:
With Neptune in this house it is your purpose in life to establish your role and the boundaries that surround you. You may feel listless and out of synch at work unless the job involves serving humanity in some way. It is not uncommon for people with this placement to have unusual health problems, caused by these individuals holding the wrong job. Your nervous system is quite sensitive and reacts badly to many of the negative material forces that are common in businesses and industries. It is as if you are a psychic sponge that absorbs certain vibrations around you. You may have to make sacrifices regarding your job, particularly if you are sensitive to the atmosphere generated at work. It's possible, though, that your colleagues will turn to you at times for help and support. It is advisable for you to strengthen your nervous system with relaxation exercises and for you to be mindful of what you eat, noting what doesn't agree with you. Try to maintain a sense of balance in what you imbibe, especially concerning content, amount, and frequency. You should avoid potent gases, drugs, and toxic food!

For you, illness often has a psychological cause, and you tend to respond well to spiritual healing. Alternative medicine like hypnotherapy, homeopathy, and acupuncture are excellent choices for you since they offer the opportunity to quickly get to the root of your inner tensions. You should see illness as a warning that something is wrong in your life and that changes are required. Spiritual awakenings force you to change so that you can effectively focus on your purpose in life, which often has much to do with being of service to humanity or nature. You may possess the ability to heal and are deeply aware that the body is the vehicle of the soul. It's possible that you are not particularly interested in the daily necessities of life and that you always have an excuse to avoid boring chores like vacuuming the house or paying bills. On the other hand, you may carry out these daily duties without really thinking about them. A well-aspected Saturn or Pluto in your chart can balance the vagueness of Neptune and will negate much of this specific interpretation. It is always important to remember that disillusionment or painful experiences help us to recognize our limits and imperfections, which then provide us with the opportunity to raise our level of consciousness concerning life and self.
planeteMaison.i|7:
Your idea of a relationship could be that one partner should rescue the other. On a physical and mental level, you may sense a need for a religious or artistic partner. You might have an especially strong desire to find that perfect soul mate, indicating that perhaps you are too dependent on another person. Maybe in a past life you forced someone or others to be too dependent on you, and now you must learn the lesson of independence. It could also be that you have tried in many lifetimes to free yourself from dependency altogether. You can test this scenario by considering past relationships. If when you became too dependent on other people, they left you or the relationships broke down, you might want to ask yourself if you were too needy. In an ideal world, you truly love yourself first, and then have a relationship where you can offer deep affection, accepting your partner for who and what they are. If a separation does occur, there can be no reactive suffering or disappointment because you are happy for them. In this way, even suffering and pain can serve a purpose if it helps you to find your way to a certain type of completeness.

Depending on the nature of your total expression, you may approach life by latching onto something familiar, such as tradition, and deny any force larger than yourself. You could be agnostic, realizing that there is a force out there but resisting any association with it. Another way in which Pluto in the twelfth house might manifest involves attempting to learn how to expand your awareness to merge with the universal whole. Relatedly, you may perceive your individuality as an extension or element of the total consciousness. If you identify with tradition or are agnostic, you will likely experience strange dreams, cycles of emptiness or futility, disillusionment, and discontent. This occurs in order to induce you to a more active development towards a heightened consciousness. You should be careful about allowing emotional guilt patterns and feelings of self-persecution to gain the upper hand. The key to growth is to establish definite spiritual or higher consciousness attitudes in all aspects of your life. People with this placement will ultimately experience unity when they have a sufficiently heightened consciousness.

Many individuals with Pluto in the twelfth house will align themselves with work in human service. It is interesting to note that a significant number of the world's most gifted actors, writers, and composers have Pluto in this house.
